summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning and instruction-following capabilities, making them potentially powerful tools for time-series analysis. However, time series lie outside their native textual modality, raising a fundamental question: how should time series be represented so that LLMs can reason about them effectively? Existing work typically serializes raw numerical sequences or fine-tunes pre-trained LLMs on time-series data. These approaches place the burden of extracting temporal structure directly on the LLM, creating a modality mismatch that often degrades performance on long sequences and introduces substantial computational overhead. In this work, we introduce Time-Series-to-Structured-Program representation (T2SP), a deterministic, training-free method that represents a time series as a structured symbolic program. T2SP decomposes time series into trends, periods, and salient events, expressing them in a program-friendly format aligned with the textual and code-like modalities on which LLMs are natively trained. By shifting temporal-structure extraction from the model to the representation itself, T2SP enables off-the-shelf LLMs to leverage their existing reasoning capabilities for time-series understanding. We evaluate T2SP on three reasoning tasks -- editing, captioning, and question answering -- where it consistently improves performance, reduces reasoning time, and lowers failure rates compared with raw-string representations. Our results demonstrate that T2SP provides an effective interface between time series and LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 将时间序列表示为结构化程序以进行大语言模型推理
AI.tldr: 本文提出T2SP方法，通过将时间序列转化为大模型易于理解的结构化符号程序，显著提升了大模型在时间序列推理任务中的性能并减少了计算开销。
AI.motivation: 时间序列属于大语言模型（LLM）原生文本模态之外的数据，现有直接序列化数值或微调模型的方法会给LLM带来直接提取时间结构的负担，导致长序列性能下降并引入高昂计算开销。因此需要一种能让LLM更有效进行时间序列推理的表示方法。
AI.method: 提出“时间序列到结构化程序”（T2SP）表示方法。这是一种确定性的、无需训练的方法，它将时间序列分解为趋势、周期和显著事件，并将其表达为与大模型原生训练的文本及代码模态相契合的结构化符号程序格式。
AI.result: 在编辑、描述（captioning）和问答三个推理任务上的评估表明，与原始字符串表示相比，T2SP持续提高了模型性能，减少了推理时间，并降低了失败率。
AI.conclusion: T2SP在时间序列与大语言模型之间提供了一个高效且实用的接口，证明了将时间结构提取责任从模型端转移到表示端的可行性与优越性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出了强大的推理和指令遵循能力，使其成为时间序列分析的潜在强大工具。然而，时间序列并不属于它们原生的文本模态，这提出了一个根本性问题：应该如何表示时间序列，以便LLM能够有效地对其进行推理？现有的工作通常是对原始数值序列进行序列化，或者在时间序列数据上对预训练的LLM进行微调。这些方法将提取时间结构的负担直接压在LLM身上，造成了模态不匹配，这往往会降低长序列上的性能并带来巨大的计算开销。在这项工作中，我们引入了“时间序列到结构化程序”（T2SP）表示方法，这是一种确定性的、无需训练的方法，它将时间序列表示为结构化的符号程序。T2SP将时间序列分解为趋势、周期和显著事件，并以一种与LLM原生训练的文本和代码类模态相契合的程序友好格式来表达它们。通过将时间结构提取的负担从模型转移到表示本身，T2SP使现成的LLM能够利用其现有的推理能力进行时间序列理解。我们在三个推理任务（编辑、描述和问答）上评估了T2SP，结果表明，与原始字符串表示相比，它一致地提高了性能，减少了推理时间，并降低了失败率。我们的结果表明，T2SP在时间序列与LLM之间提供了一个有效的接口。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为T2SP（时间序列到结构化程序）的无需训练的表示方法，旨在解决大语言模型在理解非文本模态的时间序列时面临的模态不匹配和高计算开销问题。T2SP将时间序列分解为趋势、周期和显著事件，并将其转化为结构化符号程序，从而使现成的大模型能够利用其原生的代码和文本推理能力高效地理解时间序列。实验表明，T2SP在编辑、描述和问答任务中均能显著提升大模型的性能并降低推理延迟。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 时间序列表示, 结构化程序, 符号推理, 无需训练
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种非常巧妙的思路，即通过在表示层将时间序列转换为大模型擅长理解的“代码/结构化程序”格式，从而避开了多模态对齐或昂贵微调的难题。这种无需训练（training-free）的方法极具实用价值。不过，其效果可能在很大程度上依赖于前端启发式算法（如趋势、周期提取）的准确性，对于噪声极大或极不规律的时间序列，其结构化程序的构建质量可能会受到限制。

title: Scalable anomaly detection via a univariate Christoffel function
summary: Anomaly detection plays a critical role in identifying unusual patterns across domains such as fraud detection, network intrusion, and system fault diagnosis. Recently, Christoffel function-based methods, rooted in polynomial optimization, have emerged as promising alternatives to deep learning due to their strong mathematical foundations and computational frugality. However, their practical applicability is hindered by the need to invert a matrix whose size grows exponentially with the data dimension, rendering the method intractable even for moderate-dimensional datasets. This paper addresses the dimensionality limitations of Christoffel function-based anomaly detection while preserving its key theoretical properties, i.e., the on-off support dichotomy behavior and the accurate support shape capture. We introduce UCF, a univariate Christoffel function which is based on the squared distance between the query point and the support points. Extensive experiments on the ADBench benchmark demonstrate that UCF consistently outperforms 14 state-of-the-art baselines in terms of Average Precision. By resolving the scalability bottleneck of the Christoffel Function, this work expands the toolkit of anomaly detection methods with a robust, theoretically grounded, and universally applicable approach.

AI.title_translation: 基于单变量克里斯托费尔函数的可扩展异常检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于平方距离的单变量克里斯托费尔函数（UCF），解决了传统多项式优化异常检测方法在面对高维数据时的计算瓶颈，在保持理论优势的同时显著提升了计算效率，并在基准测试中超越了14种主流方法。
AI.motivation: 基于克里斯托费尔函数的异常检测方法虽然具有强大的数学基础和计算轻量性，但其需要对一个大小随数据维度呈指数级增长的矩阵进行求逆，这导致该方法在中等维度的数据集上就变得难以计算，严重限制了其在实际中的可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 UCF（单变量克里斯托费尔函数）的新方法。该方法基于查询点与支撑点之间的平方距离，在克服维度限制的同时，保留了克里斯托费尔函数原有的关键理论特性（如开-关支撑二分行为和精确的支撑形状捕获能力）。
AI.result: 在 ADBench 基准测试上的广泛实验表明，UCF 在平均精度（Average Precision）方面始终且显著地优于 14 种最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决克里斯托费尔函数的可扩展性瓶颈，本研究成功为异常检测工具箱增添了一种鲁棒、具有坚实理论基础且普遍适用的新方法。
AI.translation: 异常检测在识别欺诈检测、网络 intrusion（入侵）和系统故障诊断等各个领域的异常模式中起着至关重要的作用。最近，基于多项式优化的克里斯托费尔函数（Christoffel function）方法因其坚实的数学基础和计算轻量性，已成为深度学习的有前途的替代方案。然而，它们的实际应用受到了限制，因为需要对一个其大小随数据维度呈指数增长的矩阵进行求逆，这使得该方法即使在面对中等维度的数据集时也难以处理。本文解决了基于克里斯托费尔函数的异常检测的维度限制，同时保留了其关键的理论属性，即开-关支撑二分行为（on-off support dichotomy behavior）和准确的支撑形状捕获。我们引入了 UCF，一种基于查询点与支撑点之间平方距离的单变量克里斯托费尔函数。在 ADBench 基准测试上的广泛实验表明，UCF 在平均精度方面始终优于 14 种最先进的基线方法。通过解决克里斯托费尔函数的可扩展性瓶颈，本工作为异常检测方法库扩展了一种鲁棒、具有理论基础且普遍适用的方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于克里斯托费尔函数的异常检测方法在处理高维数据时面临的计算瓶颈，提出了一种基于查询点与支撑点间平方距离的单变量克里斯托费尔函数（UCF）。该方法在保留原函数优秀理论特性的同时，成功解决了维度灾难问题。实验表明，UCF 在 ADBench 基准数据集上的异常检测效果显著优于 14 种现有的先进基线方法。
AI.keywords: 异常检测, 克里斯托费尔函数, 可扩展性, 多项式优化, 距离度量
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于通过引入单变量克里斯托费尔函数（UCF），巧妙地绕过了高维矩阵求逆的计算瓶颈，将多项式优化方法成功推广到更高维度的异常检测任务中。其重要性在于为异常检测领域提供了一个兼具坚实数学理论支撑和高计算效率的非深度学习方案。局限性方面，摘要中未提及该方法在面对极度噪声数据或超高维稀疏特征时的鲁棒性表现，这可能需要进一步的实验验证。

title: Speculative Rollback Correction for Quality-Diverse Web Agent Imitation
summary: Training interactive web agents through imitation learning from expert trajectories has emerged as a highly effective approach. However, determining the optimal timing for expert intervention presents a critical challenge in this context. Delayed intervention often leads to the accumulation of early-stage errors, pushing the page state into an irrecoverable regime. Conversely, premature or excessive intervention causes the agent to become overly reliant on expert policies, trapping the model in local optima characterized by a single, rigid trajectory. We propose Speculative Rollback Correction (SRC), a branch-level imitation framework for resettable agent environments. Instead of requesting teacher labels at every visited state or correcting only after a completed trajectory, SRC uses fixed-horizon branch review: the student executes a short speculative segment before teacher review, and the teacher localizes the first harmful deviation only when local progress breaks. Rollback preserves useful prefixes, while successful rollouts are filtered by a hard verifier and retained in a lightweight quality-diversity archive. The resulting data supports next-action supervised fine-tuning on both localized corrections and verifier-passing trajectories. On WebArena-Infinity, SRC collects 977 verifier-passing trajectories and 9,183 next-action examples; fixed-horizon review improves the recovery-versus-query tradeoff over step-level review while retaining verifier-passing solution variants. Code is available at https://github.com/LongkunHao/SRC_gui_agent.

AI.title_translation: 针对质量多样化Web智能体模仿学习的推测性回滚纠正
AI.tldr: 提出SRC框架，通过“先推测、后审查、出错回滚”的分支级模仿学习机制，优化了Web智能体训练中的专家干预时机，实现了高效纠错并保留了多样化的成功轨迹。
AI.motivation: 在通过模仿学习训练交互式Web智能体时，确定专家干预的最佳时机非常困难。延迟干预会导致早期错误累积，使页面状态不可逆；而过早或过度干预则会导致智能体过度依赖专家策略，陷入单一、僵化的局部最优轨迹。
AI.method:
提出推测性回滚纠正（SRC）框架，采用固定步长的分支审查：
1. 学生智能体在教师审查前先执行一段简短的推测性动作片段。
2. 教师仅在局部进展中断时定位第一个有害偏差，并通过回滚保留有用的前缀。
3. 成功的轨迹通过硬验证器过滤并存入轻量级质量多样性存档中。
4. 利用定位纠正和通过验证的轨迹数据，对智能体进行下一步动作的监督微调（SFT）。
AI.result: 在WebArena-Infinity数据集上，SRC成功收集了977条通过验证器的轨迹和9,183个下一步动作样本。与传统的步骤级审查相比，固定步长审查显著改善了恢复效果与专家查询次数之间的权衡，并保留了更多通过验证的多样化解法。
AI.conclusion: SRC框架通过结合固定步长分支审查、回滚纠正和质量多样性存档，成功在WebArena-Infinity基准上实现了更好的恢复与查询权衡，证明了分支级模仿学习在交互式Web智能体训练中的有效性。
AI.translation: 通过专家轨迹的模仿学习来训练交互式Web智能体已成为一种非常有效的方法。然而，在这种背景下，确定专家干预的最佳时机提出了一个关键挑战。延迟干预往往会导致早期错误的累积，使页面状态进入不可恢复的境地。相反，过早或过度的干预会导致智能体过度依赖专家策略，从而将模型困在以单一、僵化轨迹为特征的局部最优中。我们提出了推测性回滚纠正（SRC），这是一个用于可重置智能体环境的分支级模仿框架。SRC不要求在每个访问的状态都请求教师标签，也不在完整轨迹结束后才进行纠正，而是使用固定步长的分支审查：学生在教师审查之前执行一段简短的推测性片段，只有当局部进展中断时，教师才会定位第一个有害的偏差。回滚保留了有用的前缀，而成功的滚出则通过硬验证器进行过滤，并保留在轻量级的质量多样性存档中。所得数据支持在定位纠正和通过验证器的轨迹上进行下一步动作的监督微调。在WebArena-Infinity上，SRC收集了977条通过验证器的轨迹和9,183个下一步动作示例；与步骤级审查相比，固定步长审查改善了恢复与查询之间的权衡，同时保留了通过验证器的解决方案变体。代码可在 https://github.com/LongkunHao/SRC_gui_agent 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对Web智能体模仿学习中专家干预时机难以抉择的挑战，提出了推测性回滚纠正（SRC）框架。该框架允许学生智能体先进行推测性执行，再由教师在固定步长内进行审查，并在出错时回滚和纠正首个偏差。通过结合硬验证器和质量多样性存档，SRC不仅提高了纠错效率，还收集了多样化的成功轨迹，显著提升了智能体在WebArena-Infinity上的微调效果和恢复-查询权衡。
AI.keywords: 模仿学习, Web智能体, 推测性回滚纠正, 质量多样性, 交互式环境
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的分支级模仿学习框架（SRC），巧妙地利用“推测执行”和“回滚纠正”机制，解决了Web智能体训练中专家干预时机（过早导致僵化，过晚导致无法恢复）的经典痛点。其引入的质量多样性（QD）存档不仅能提高数据利用率，还能保留多样化的任务解决路径，对于交互式GUI智能体和强化学习中的探索问题具有重要的启发意义。

title: An Empirical Study on Predictive Maintenance for Component X in Heavy-Duty Scania Trucks
summary: Condition-based Predictive Maintenance (PdM) for truck fleets has gained momentum in recent years. This maintenance strategy aims to minimize unplanned downtimes and reduce costs by monitoring the health status of vehicles and taking proactive action based on their condition. However, the implementation of condition-based PdM systems is challenging due to the large volume of data generated by the trucks, the inherent complexity of detecting failures through sensor data and the difficulties in finding cost-effective trade-offs in the solution's implementation. In this paper, we define and validate a condition-based PdM methodology built on the assumption that the wear-and-tear state of the monitored component can be represented as a monotonically non-decreasing time series. It involves selecting only the most recent observations from the time series and transforming them into a tabular format for classification using machine learning (ML) models designed for tabular data. Our results indicate that the proposed methodology reduces costs on the Scania Component X dataset compared to current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches, while also simplifying the modeling process through AutoML.

AI.title_translation: 重型斯堪尼亚卡车部件X预测性维护的实证研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对斯堪尼亚卡车部件的预测性维护方法，通过将磨损状态简化为单调时间序列并转化为表格数据，结合AutoML实现了比现有先进方法更低的维护成本和更简化的建模流程。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于工况的预测性维护（PdM）能减少停机和降低成本，但由于卡车产生的数据量巨大、传感器故障检测复杂度高以及难以在成本与效果之间取得平衡，导致其实施面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种基于工况的预测性维护方法。该方法假设被监测部件的磨损状态可表示为单调非递减的时间序列，通过仅提取时间序列中最新的观测数据并将其转换为表格格式，进而使用专为表格数据设计的机器学习模型和AutoML进行分类与建模。
AI.result: 在Scania部件X数据集上的实验结果表明，与现有的先进（SOTA）方法相比，该方法不仅降低了维护成本，还通过使用AutoML显著简化了建模流程。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功验证了所提预测性维护方法的有效性，证明了基于单调时间序列假设并结合表格机器学习与AutoML的方法，能够有效降低重型卡车的维护成本并简化建模复杂度。
AI.translation: 近年来，针对卡车车队的基于工况的预测性维护（PdM）势头强劲。这种维护策略旨在通过监控车辆的健康状态并根据其工况采取主动措施，从而最大限度地减少计划外停机时间并降低成本。然而，由于卡车产生的数据量庞大、通过传感器数据检测故障的固有复杂性，以及在方案实施中寻找高性价比折中方案的困难，实施基于工况的预测性维护系统面临挑战。在本文中，我们定义并验证了一种基于工况的预测性维护方法，该方法建立在被监测部件的磨损状态可以表示为单调非递减时间序列的假设之上。它包括仅选择时间序列中最新的观测数据，并将其转换为表格格式，以便使用专为表格数据设计的机器学习（ML）模型进行分类。我们的结果表明，与目前最先进的（SOTA）方法相比，所提出的方法在斯堪尼亚（Scania）部件X数据集上降低了成本，同时还通过自动机器学习（AutoML）简化了建模过程。
AI.summary: 本文针对重型斯堪尼亚卡车部件的预测性维护问题展开实证研究。为解决海量传感器数据及故障检测的复杂性，研究提出将部件磨损状态简化为单调非递减时间序列，仅提取最新观测值并转化为表格数据，从而利用表格机器学习和AutoML进行高效分类。实验表明，该方法在降低成本和简化建模方面均优于现有先进技术。
AI.keywords: 预测性维护, 机器学习, 自动机器学习(AutoML), 斯堪尼亚卡车, 时间序列
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种简化策略，将复杂的部件磨损过程假设为单调非递减时间序列，并仅提取最新观测值转化为表格数据，从而能够直接利用成熟的表格机器学习和AutoML工具。这种方法极大地降低了工业级预测性维护的建模门槛，具有很高的实用价值。其局限性在于对“单调非递减”这一假设依赖较强，对于存在状态波动或可自我恢复的部件可能不适用。

title: DynamicPTQ: Mitigating Activation Quantization Collapse via Residual-Stream Dynamics
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for efficient large language model inference, but reliably quantizing activations remains challenging when weights, activations, and KV caches are all quantized to 4-bit precision. A key difficulty lies in massive activations, whose extreme values dominate the activation range and amplify quantization errors. State-of-the-art methods mainly mitigate massive activations through transformation-based smoothing, such as orthogonal rotations and affine scaling, but overlook the cross-layer dynamics of the residual stream. In this paper, we show that massive activations emerge and disappear in a phase-wise pattern across network depth, triggering large residual changes. These changes cause newly injected layer-wise updates to dominate the 4-bit quantization scale and weaken historical residual information. To characterize this behavior, we introduce Jump Ratio and Historical Feature SNR. This suggests that static transformation-based smoothing cannot fully resolve dynamic quantization instability caused by cross-layer residual changes. Based on this analysis, we propose DynamicPTQ, a Dynamic Post-Training Quantization policy for phase-aware mixed-precision activation quantization. DynamicPTQ identifies quantization-sensitive layers from residual-stream dynamics and assigns 8-bit activation precision only to these layers, while keeping weights, KV caches, and other activations in 4-bit precision. It can be directly integrated with strong PTQ baselines such as QuaRot, SpinQuant, and FlatQuant. Experiments on LLaMA-2 and LLaMA-3 show that DynamicPTQ consistently improves perplexity and zero-shot QA performance under W4A4KV4 quantization, while achieving 1.05 to 1.07 times throughput improvement with modest memory overhead. These results demonstrate a practical path toward robust low-bit LLM inference.

AI.title_translation: DynamicPTQ：通过残差流动力学缓解激活量化崩溃
AI.tldr: 本文提出了DynamicPTQ，通过分析残差流动力学识别量化敏感层，并仅对这些层采用8-bit激活（其余为4-bit），有效解决了LLM在W4A4KV4极低比特量化下的性能崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: 在将大语言模型的权重、激活和KV缓存同时量化为4-bit（W4A4KV4）时，由于存在极端的激活值，导致激活量化极具挑战。现有的平滑方法忽略了残差流的跨层动力学。极端的激活值在网络深度中呈阶段性出现和消失，引起剧烈的残差变化，导致新注入的层更新主导了4-bit量化尺度并削弱了历史信息，从而造成量化崩溃。
AI.method: 提出DynamicPTQ（一种阶段感知的混合精度激活量化策略）。首先，利用新引入的“跳转率”（Jump Ratio）和“历史特征信噪比”（Historical Feature SNR）指标表征残差流动力学，并以此识别出量化敏感层；然后，仅为这些敏感层分配8-bit激活精度，而权重、KV缓存及其他层激活仍保持4-bit精度。该策略可直接与QuaRot、SpinQuant和FlatQuant等现有PTQ基线集成。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-2和LLaMA-3上的实验表明，在W4A4KV4量化下，DynamicPTQ一致地改善了困惑度（perplexity）和零样本问答（zero-shot QA）性能，同时仅带来微小的内存开销，并实现了1.05至1.07倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: DynamicPTQ通过结合残差流动力学，为大语言模型提供了一种鲁棒且实用的低比特（W4A4KV4）推理路径，证明了动态混合精度在缓解量化崩溃中的关键作用。
AI.translation: 后训练量化（PTQ）对于高效的大语言模型推理至关重要，但当权重、激活和KV缓存都被量化为4比特精度时，可靠地量化激活仍然具有挑战性。一个关键的困难在于大规模激活，其极端值主导了激活范围并放大了量化误差。最先进的方法主要通过基于变换的平滑（如正交旋转和仿射缩放）来缓解大规模激活，但忽略了残差流的跨层动力学。在本文中，我们展示了大规模激活在整个网络深度中以阶段性模式出现和消失，从而触发了巨大的残差变化。这些变化导致新注入的层级更新主导了4比特量化尺度，并削弱了历史残差信息。为了表征这一行为，我们引入了跳转率（Jump Ratio）和历史特征信噪比（Historical Feature SNR）。这表明基于静态变换的平滑无法完全解决由跨层残差变化引起的动态量化不稳定性。基于这一分析，我们提出了DynamicPTQ，一种用于阶段感知混合精度激活量化的动态训练后量化策略。DynamicPTQ从残差流动力学中识别量化敏感层，并仅为这些层分配8比特激活精度，同时将权重、KV缓存和其他激活保持在4比特精度。它可以直接与QuaRot、SpinQuant和FlatQuant等强PTQ基线集成。在LLaMA-2和LLaMA-3上的实验表明，DynamicPTQ在W4A4KV4量化下持续改善了困惑度和零样本问答性能，同时以适度的内存开销实现了1.05至1.07倍的吞吐量提升。这些结果展示了一条通往鲁棒低比特LLM推理的实用路径。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大语言模型在W4A4KV4极低比特量化下面临的激活量化崩溃问题。作者发现大规模激活值在网络层间呈阶段性起伏，从而剧烈干扰了残差流。为此，本文提出了DynamicPTQ，通过引入跳转率和历史特征信噪比来识别对量化敏感的层，并对这些特定层采用8-bit激活的混合精度策略。实验表明，该方法在几乎不增加开销的前提下，显著提升了LLaMA模型在极低比特下的精度与推理吞吐量。
AI.keywords: 训练后量化 (PTQ), 残差流动力学 (Residual-stream dynamics), 混合精度 (Mixed-precision), 大语言模型推理 (LLM inference)
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，它没有局限于传统的静态激活值平滑方法，而是首次从残差流的跨层动态变化角度，揭示了4-bit激活量化崩溃的根本原因。引入的“跳转率”和“历史特征信噪比”为量化敏感性分析提供了量化工具。其提出的混合精度策略（仅敏感层激活使用8-bit）在几乎不增加开销的情况下，显著提升了W4A4KV4极低比特量化的鲁棒性，具有极高的实用部署价值。

title: A Stationary (and Therefore Compatible) Representation is All You Need
comments: Accepted to TPAMI2026. Extension of the CVPR2024 version (arXiv:2405.02581)
summary: Learning compatible representations aims to learn feature representations that can be used interchangeably over time whenever a model undergoes updates. In this paper, we demonstrate that stationary representations learned by d-Simplex fixed classifiers imply compatibility as in its formal definition. This result establishes a foundation for future works and can be directly exploited in practical learning scenarios. We address the challenge of learning compatibility using $d$-Simplex fixed classifiers when the model is sequentially fine-tuned. Learning according to a d-Simplex fixed classifier with the cross-entropy loss aligns feature distributions at the first-order statistics. Consequently, it may not fully capture higher-order dependencies in the representation between model updates. To address this issue, we demonstrate that training the model using a $d$-Simplex fixed classifier through a convex combination of the cross-entropy loss and a contrastive loss not only captures higher-order dependencies, but is also equivalent to learning with the cross-entropy under the compatibility constraints. We confirm our findings with extensive experiments also considering a new scenario where a pre-trained model is sequentially fine-tuned and occasionally replaced with an improved model. We show that stationary representations enable uninterrupted retrieval services (without reprocessing gallery images) while improving performance during model updates and replacements, achieving state-of-the-art. Code at https://github.com/miccunifi/iamcl2r.
comment: Accepted to TPAMI2026. Extension of the CVPR2024 version (arXiv:2405.02581)

AI.title_translation: 平稳（且因此兼容）的表示正是你所需要的
AI.tldr: 本文证明了通过 d-Simplex 固定分类器学习的平稳表示天然具备兼容性，并提出结合对比损失的训练方法，在模型更新和替换时实现了无需重新提取特征的无缝检索，达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 在模型发生更新或替换时，如何学习能够跨时间互换使用的兼容特征表示（即兼容表示学习）。特别是在模型顺序微调时，现有的基于 d-Simplex 固定分类器和交叉熵的方法无法充分捕获模型更新之间特征表示的高阶依赖关系。
AI.method:
1. 理论上证明了通过 d-Simplex 固定分类器学习的平稳表示（stationary representations）在形式化定义上蕴含兼容性。
2. 针对仅使用交叉熵损失无法捕获高阶依赖的问题，提出使用 d-Simplex 固定分类器，并采用交叉熵损失与对比损失的凸组合（convex combination）进行模型训练。
3. 在一个新的顺序微调及模型替换场景下进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验证实，所提出的平稳表示方法在模型更新和替换过程中，能够实现不间断的检索服务（无需重新处理/提取画廊图像的特征），同时提升了检索性能，达到了最先进的水平（state-of-the-art）。
AI.conclusion: d-Simplex 固定分类器学习的平稳表示为兼容性表示学习奠定了坚实的基础。通过结合交叉熵和对比损失，该方法不仅能捕捉高阶依赖，还能在模型顺序微调和替换时提供不间断的检索服务，达到最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 学习兼容表示旨在学习特征表示，使其在模型经历更新时可以随时间互换使用。在本文中，我们证明了通过 d-Simplex 固定分类器学习的平稳表示在形式化定义上蕴含了兼容性。这一结果为未来的工作奠定了基础，并可直接应用于实际的学习场景中。我们解决了在模型进行顺序微调时，使用 d-Simplex 固定分类器学习兼容性所面临的挑战。由于使用 d-Simplex 固定分类器配合交叉熵损失进行学习仅能在一阶统计量上对齐特征分布，因此它可能无法完全捕获模型更新之间表示中的高阶依赖关系。为了解决这一问题，我们证明了通过交叉熵损失和对比损失的凸组合，利用 d-Simplex 固定分类器训练模型，不仅能够捕获高阶依赖关系，而且等价于在兼容性约束下使用交叉熵进行学习。我们通过广泛的实验证实了我们的发现，并考虑了一种新的场景，即预训练模型被顺序微调并偶尔被改进的模型所替换。我们表明，平稳表示能够实现不间断的检索服务（无需重新处理画廊图像），同时在模型更新和替换期间提高性能，达到了最先进的水平。代码开源于 https://github.com/miccunifi/iamcl2r。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了兼容性特征表示学习，证明了通过 d-Simplex 固定分类器学习的平稳表示在定义上即蕴含兼容性。针对顺序微调中交叉熵损失无法捕获高阶特征依赖的缺陷，本文提出结合交叉熵和对比损失的凸组合进行训练，并证明其等价于在兼容性约束下进行学习。该方法在模型更新与替换场景下实现了无缝的、不间断的图像检索，性能达到最先进水平。
AI.keywords: 兼容表示学习, 平稳表示, d-Simplex 固定分类器, 顺序微调, 对比损失
AI.comments: 本文将平稳表示与兼容性表示学习直接联系起来，并给出了理论上的证明，即通过 d-Simplex 固定分类器结合交叉熵与对比损失的训练，在理论上等价于带兼容性约束的优化。这为模型更新时的特征无缝兼容（如免去重新提取库图像特征的步骤）提供了坚实的理论支撑和简单有效的实用方案，具有很高的学术和实用价值。

title: Masked Neural Detection for Constrained Channel Coding in Molecular Communication
summary: Molecular communication (MC) suffers from severe diffusion memory because molecules released for one symbol may arrive during later symbols. Neural sequence detectors, especially sliding bidirectional recurrent neural networks (SBRNNs), can substantially outperform threshold detectors in such channels. This raises a central question for MC channel coding: does a code whose advantage was established under threshold detection retain it when both coded and uncoded transmission are evaluated with neural detection? This letter answers this question for run-length-limited ISI-mitigation (RLIM) codes, a class of constrained codes previously shown to provide large BER gains in MC. Across the tested operating points, the best RLIM-SBRNN receiver beats the best uncoded receiver, chosen between threshold and SBRNN detection, in $46$ of $59$ cases, with a mean gain of $10.36\times$ over those wins. We also propose an RLIM-tailored training mask for compact SBRNN detectors, improving the unmasked RLIM-SBRNN in $227$ of $236$ comparisons with $3.267\times$ mean gain when masking is beneficial. Finally, the compact masked RLIM-SBRNN is competitive with channel-state-aware MLSE despite using no channel knowledge.

AI.title_translation: 分子通信中受限信道编码的掩码神经检测
AI.tldr: 本文研究了分子通信中，受限信道编码在神经检测器下是否仍具有优势，并提出了一种优化的掩码神经检测方法。
AI.motivation: 分子通信（MC）存在严重的扩散记忆问题。研究的中心问题是：在神经检测（特别是滑动双向循环神经网络SBRNN）评估编码和非编码传输时，那些在阈值检测下表现出优势的编码是否能保持其优势。
AI.method: 使用滑动双向循环神经网络（SBRNN）作为神经序列检测器；应用跑长受限ISI缓解（RLIM）编码作为受限编码；提出了一种针对RLIM编码量身定制的训练掩码，用于紧凑型SBRNN检测器。
AI.result: 在59种测试工况中，最佳RLIM-SBRNN接收器在46种情况下优于最佳未编码接收器，平均增益为10.36倍。所提出的RLIM定制训练掩码在236次比较中的227次中改进了未掩码的RLIM-SBRNN，当掩码有利时，平均增益为3.267倍。紧凑型掩码RLIM-SBRNN在不使用信道知识的情况下，与信道状态感知的MLSE具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 在分子通信中，跑长受限ISI缓解（RLIM）编码与神经检测器（特别是SBRNN）结合使用时，可以显著提高性能，即使在神经检测器下也能保持其在阈值检测下的优势。定制的训练掩码进一步提升了SBRNN检测器的性能和紧凑性，使其在无需信道知识的情况下也能与先进的MLSE方法媲美。
AI.translation: 分子通信（MC）由于为某个符号释放的分子可能在后续符号期间到达而遭受严重的扩散记忆。神经序列检测器，特别是滑动双向循环神经网络（SBRNN），在此类信道中可以显著优于阈值检测器。这为MC信道编码提出了一个核心问题：在对编码和未编码传输都使用神经检测进行评估时，其优势在阈值检测下确立的编码是否能保持其优势？本文针对跑长受限ISI缓解（RLIM）编码（一类先前已证明在MC中提供大BER增益的受限编码）回答了这个问题。在测试的操作点中，最佳RLIM-SBRNN接收器在59种情况中的46种中击败了最佳未编码接收器（在阈值和SBRNN检测之间选择），在这些获胜中平均增益为10.36倍。我们还提出了一种针对RLIM定制的训练掩码，用于紧凑型SBRNN检测器，在236次比较中的227次中改进了未掩码的RLIM-SBRNN，当掩码有利时，平均增益为3.267倍。最后，紧凑型掩码RLIM-SBRNN在不使用信道知识的情况下，与信道状态感知的MLSE具有竞争力。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了分子通信（MC）中受限信道编码（RLIM码）在神经检测器（SBRNN）下的性能。研究发现，RLIM码与SBRNN结合使用时，在大多数情况下仍能显著优于未编码传输。此外，作者提出了一种针对RLIM定制的训练掩码，用于优化SBRNN检测器，该方法在提高性能的同时实现了紧凑性，并且在不依赖信道知识的情况下，其性能可与信道状态感知的MLSE相媲美。
AI.keywords: 分子通信, 神经检测, SBRNN, RLIM编码, 掩码训练
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过实证研究解决了分子通信领域的一个关键问题，即在引入先进的神经检测器后，传统编码方案的优势是否依然存在。其创新点在于将RLIM编码与SBRNN检测器结合，并提出了定制的训练掩码，显著提升了检测性能和效率。特别值得注意的是，其提出的紧凑型掩码RLIM-SBRNN在不使用信道知识的情况下，能与依赖信道知识的MLSE竞争，这在实际应用中具有重要意义，降低了系统复杂性。

title: Robustness Verification of Recurrent Neural Networks with Abstraction Refinement
summary: Certified local robustness verification for recurrent neural networks (RNNs) is challenging because approximation errors introduced by nonlinear relaxations can propagate through recurrent connections and accumulate over time. As a result, scalable linear bound propagation methods often become overly conservative and fail to certify inputs that are in fact robust, especially when many pre-activation intervals cross zero. We propose an abstraction-refinement framework for RNN verification that partitions such intervals to remove the dominant relaxation error: on each refined branch, ReLU becomes exact, and smooth activations such as tanh and sigmoid admit substantially tighter linear envelopes. To control the combinatorial cost of splitting in long sequences, we introduce a SHAP-guided timestep selection strategy that ranks hidden states by their contribution to the verification objective and refines only the most critical timesteps in temporal order. Experiments on CIFAR10 and MNIST stroke benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in verification success and robustness-margin tightness over abstraction-only baselines, while exposing clear runtime trade-offs between ReLU and tanh models.

AI.title_translation: 基于抽象精化的循环神经网络鲁棒性验证
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对循环神经网络（RNN）的抽象精化验证框架，通过对跨零激活区间进行分割并结合SHAP引导的时间步选择策略，有效减少了非线性松弛带来的误差累积，提升了鲁棒性验证的成功率。
AI.motivation: 循环神经网络（RNN）的认证局部鲁棒性验证面临挑战，因为非线性松弛引入的逼近误差会通过循环连接传播并随时间累积，导致可扩展的线性边界传播方法过于保守，尤其是在许多前激活区间跨零时，无法验证实际鲁棒的输入。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对RNN验证的抽象精化（abstraction-refinement）框架。该框架通过划分跨零区间来消除主要的松弛误差：在每个精化分支上，ReLU变得精确，而诸如tanh和sigmoid等平滑激活函数则能获得更紧致的线性包络。此外，为了控制长序列中分裂的组合成本，引入了SHAP引导的时间步选择策略，按其对验证目标的贡献对隐藏状态进行排序，并按时间顺序仅精化最关键的时间步。
AI.result: 在CIFAR10和MNIST stroke基准测试上的实验表明，与仅采用抽象的基线方法相比，该方法在验证成功率和鲁棒性边界紧致度上均有持续提升，同时揭示了ReLU和tanh模型之间明显的运行时间权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的抽象精化框架能够有效缓解RNN鲁棒性验证中的误差累积问题，通过选择性地精化关键时间步，在验证精度和计算成本之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.translation: 循环神经网络（RNN）的认证局部鲁棒性验证具有挑战性，因为非线性松弛引入的逼近误差会通过循环连接传播并随着时间推移而累积。因此，可扩展的线性边界传播方法往往变得过于保守，无法证明实际上是鲁棒的输入，尤其是在许多前激活区间跨零时。我们提出了一种用于RNN验证的抽象精化框架，该框架对这些区间进行划分以消除主要的松弛误差：在每个精化分支上，ReLU变得精确，而诸如tanh和sigmoid等平滑激活函数则允许更紧致的线性包络。为了控制长序列中分裂的组合成本，我们引入了一种SHAP引导的时间步选择策略，该策略根据隐藏状态对验证目标的贡献进行排序，并按时间顺序仅精化最关键的时间步。在CIFAR10和MNIST stroke基准上的实验表明，与仅采用抽象的基准相比，该方法在验证成功率和鲁棒性边界紧致度上都有持续的改进，同时暴露了ReLU和tanh模型之间清晰的运行时间权衡。
AI.summary: 本文针对循环神经网络（RNN）中由于非线性松弛误差随时间累积而导致鲁棒性验证过于保守的问题，提出了一种新型的抽象精化验证框架。该框架通过划分跨零的前激活区间，使ReLU激活函数在精化分支上变得精确，并为tanh和sigmoid等激活函数提供更紧致的线性包络。为了应对长序列中的计算复杂度，引入了基于SHAP值的时间步选择策略来优先精化关键时间步。实验结果证明了该方法在提升验证成功率和紧致度方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 循环神经网络, 鲁棒性验证, 抽象精化, SHAP值, 线性边界传播
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将抽象精化（abstraction refinement）引入到RNN的鲁棒性验证中，并巧妙地利用SHAP（沙普利值）来指导关键时间步的选择，从而在控制计算复杂度的同时显著降低了非线性松弛带来的累积误差。这对于解决时序模型验证中常见的“过保守”问题具有重要意义。局限性可能在于对于极长序列，精化分支的组合爆炸问题仍可能带来计算压力。

title: Net-Ev$^2$: A Generative Simulator for Network Event Evolution
summary: Reducing real-world trial and error has long been a central goal of decision making, and generative simulators advance this goal by modeling the evolution of future states. An even more challenging yet meaningful task is simulating how disturbance events (e.g., accidents) propagate their impacts across real-world networks. The existing approaches fall short of modeling both structured attributes and unstructured semantics of events, and capturing topological structures in simulating network event evolution. Therefore, we are motivated to propose Net-Ev$^2$ ($\underline{\textbf{Net}}$work $\underline{\textbf{Ev}}$ent $\underline{\textbf{Ev}}$olution), a novel generative simulator that jointly leverages event cues while preserving network topology in simulations. Specifically, the framework consists of two stages, namely structure-guided masked pre-training and topology-aware diffusion process, which is achieved by U-Net-like graph downsampling and upsampling during denoising. At inference time, Net-Ev$^2$ can generate simulations using natural-language event input only, with greater flexibility for practical usage. Furthermore, we introduce Net-Ev$^2$-6.5M, a multimodal benchmark of aligned event and network traffic data across four large-scale road networks, as well as a new topology-aware metric, namely JL-MMD, to evaluate topological fidelity in generated network dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization ability of Net-Ev$^2$. Code is made available at https://github.com/Guangyu4/Net-Ev-2.

AI.title_translation: Net-Ev$^2$：网络事件演化的生成式模拟器
AI.tldr: Net-Ev$^2$ 是一个结合自然语言事件输入并保留网络拓扑结构的新型生成式模拟器，用于高保真度地模拟网络中扰动事件的影响传播。
AI.motivation: 现有的网络事件演化模拟方法无法同时建模事件的结构化属性和非结构化语义，且在模拟中难以捕获和保留网络拓扑结构。
AI.method: 提出 Net-Ev$^2$ 框架，包含两个阶段：结构引导的掩码预训练和拓扑感知的扩散过程（通过去噪过程中的类 U-Net 图下采样和上采样实现）。在推理时，仅需自然语言事件输入即可生成模拟。此外，还引入了 Net-Ev$^2$-6.5M 基准数据集和用于评估拓扑保真度的 JL-MMD 指标。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，Net-Ev$^2$ 取得了最先进的性能（SOTA）和强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Net-Ev$^2$ 成功实现了利用自然语言事件输入进行高拓扑保真度的网络事件演化模拟，并通过新基准和指标证明了其在网络动态生成上的优异表现和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 减少现实世界的试错长期以来一直是决策的核心目标，而生成式模拟器通过对未来状态的演化进行建模来推进这一目标。一个更具挑战性但也更有意义的任务是模拟扰动事件（例如事故）如何在现实世界网络中传播其影响。现有方法在建模事件的结构化属性和非结构化语义，以及在模拟网络事件演化中捕获拓扑结构方面存在不足。因此，我们动力十足地提出了 Net-Ev$^2$（网络事件演化），这是一种新型生成式模拟器，在模拟中共同利用事件线索，同时保留网络拓扑。具体而言，该框架由两个阶段组成，即结构引导的掩码预训练和拓扑感知的扩散过程，这是通过去噪过程中的类 U-Net 图下采样和上采样实现的。在推理时，Net-Ev$^2$ 可以仅使用自然语言事件输入来生成模拟，为实际使用提供了更大的灵活性。此外，我们引入了 Net-Ev$^2$-6.5M，这是一个跨四个大型道路网络的对齐事件和网络流量数据的多模态基准，以及一个新的拓扑感知指标，即 JL-MMD，用于评估生成的网络动态中的拓扑保真度。广泛的实验证明了 Net-Ev$^2$ 的最先进性能和强大的泛化能力。代码可在 https://github.com/Guangyu4/Net-Ev-2 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 Net-Ev$^2$ 的生成式网络事件演化模拟器，旨在解决现有方法无法兼顾事件语义及网络拓扑结构的问题。Net-Ev$^2$ 采用结构引导的掩码预训练和基于类 U-Net 图采样的拓扑感知扩散过程，允许仅凭自然语言事件输入进行灵活的模拟生成。此外，研究者还发布了大规模多模态数据集 Net-Ev$^2$-6.5M 和评估拓扑保真度的新指标 JL-MMD。实验验证了该方法在网络动态生成上的优异表现。
AI.keywords: 生成式模拟器, 网络事件演化, 扩散过程, 拓扑感知, 多模态基准
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将扩散模型与图神经网络（类 U-Net 结构）相结合，用于解决复杂的网络事件演化模拟问题。其最大亮点在于能够仅使用自然语言作为输入进行推理，具有极高的实用灵活性。此外，开源的 6.5M 规模多模态数据集和全新的评估指标 JL-MMD 也为该领域做出了重要贡献。不过，扩散模型本身的计算开销可能会对实时模拟带来一定挑战。

title: Missing-Token Prompted Reliability-Aware Fusion for Robust Polyglot Speaker Identification
summary: Accurate and robust multimodal speaker identification is essential for multimedia understanding and biometric authentication. However, real-world polyglot scenarios pose two key challenges: speaker-discriminative representations should generalize across languages, and the model should remain reliable when face information is unavailable. To address these challenges, we propose MRAF, a Missing-Token Prompted Reliability-Aware Fusion framework for polyglot speaker identification across complete-modality, missing-face, and cross-lingual scenarios. MRAF represents unavailable face inputs with a learnable missing token instead of fixed zero-valued features, providing a trainable representation of the missing visual state. This design reduces the distribution gap caused by missing inputs and allows subsequent reliability estimation and cross-modal fusion to operate within a unified token space. To adaptively integrate modalities with different reliability, MRAF further introduces a reliability-aware cross-attention fusion module, which estimates face and audio reliability scores, normalizes them into modality weights, and applies these weights to token representations before bidirectional cross-attention. In this way, the model can emphasize reliable modality cues while suppressing unreliable ones. During training, MRAF jointly optimizes multi-branch classification losses, audio-only knowledge distillation, and center loss to improve speaker discrimination and missing-modality robustness. Experiments on the official POLY-SIM 2026 test set demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. In the final evaluation, MRAF achieves 100% accuracy on P3 and P5, and obtains competitive results on the more challenging missing-face settings P4 and P6. The source code will be released at https://github.com/MSA-LMC/MRAF.

AI.title_translation: 针对鲁棒多语种说话人识别的缺失Token提示可靠性感知融合
AI.tldr: 本文提出MRAF框架，通过可学习的缺失Token表示缺失的人脸，并利用可靠性感知机制动态融合音频与人脸特征，实现了多语种及人脸缺失场景下极其鲁棒的说话人识别。
AI.motivation: 在实际的多语种多模态说话人识别中，面临两大挑战：一是说话人特征需要具备跨语言的泛化能力，二是当人脸信息缺失（不可用）时，模型仍需保持高可靠性。
AI.method: 提出MRAF框架：1) 使用可学习的缺失Token（missing token）代替零值特征来表示缺失的人脸，以统一Token空间并缩小分布差距；2) 引入可靠性感知交叉注意力融合模块，自适应估计并归一化音频与人脸的可靠性得分作为模态权重；3) 联合优化多分支分类损失、仅音频知识蒸馏和中心损失（center loss）。
AI.result: 在POLY-SIM 2026测试集上，MRAF在P3和P5设置下达到了100%的识别准确率，并在更具挑战性的人脸缺失设置（P4和P6）中取得了极具竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 实验和评估结果表明，MRAF框架在处理完整模态、人脸缺失和跨语言的多语种说话人识别任务中具有极高的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 准确且鲁棒的多模态说话人识别对于多媒体理解和生物特征认证至关重要。然而，现实世界中的多语种场景带来了两个关键挑战：说话人区分性表示应当能够跨语言泛化，且在人脸信息不可用时模型应保持可靠。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于完整模态、人脸缺失和跨语言场景下多语种说话人识别的缺失Token提示可靠性感知融合框架（MRAF）。MRAF使用可学习的缺失Token来表示不可用的人脸输入，而不是固定的零值特征，从而提供了缺失视觉状态的可训练表示。这种设计减少了由缺失输入引起的分布差异，并允许后续的可靠性估计和跨模态融合在统一的Token空间中运行。为了自适应地融合不同可靠性的模态，MRAF进一步引入了一个可靠性感知交叉注意力融合模块，该模块估计人脸和音频的可靠性得分，将其归一化为模态权重，并在双向交叉注意力之前将这些权重应用于Token表示。通过这种方式，模型可以强调可靠的模态线索，同时抑制不可靠的线索。在训练期间，MRAF联合优化了多分支分类损失、仅音频知识蒸馏和中心损失，以提高说话人区分度和缺失模态的鲁棒性。在官方POLY-SIM 2026测试集上的实验证明了所提框架的有效性。在最终评估中，MRAF在P3和P5上实现了100%的准确率，并在更具挑战性的人脸缺失设置P4和P6上获得了具有竞争力的结果。源代码将开源在 https://github.com/MSA-LMC/MRAF 。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为MRAF的缺失Token提示可靠性感知融合框架，用于解决多语种及人脸缺失场景下的鲁棒说话人识别问题。该方法通过可学习的缺失Token表示缺失的视觉信息，并利用可靠性感知交叉注意力机制自适应分配模态权重，配合多种损失函数的联合优化，显著提升了多模态识别系统在不完整数据下的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 说话人识别, 多模态融合, 缺失模态, 可靠性感知, 多语种
AI.comments: 该论文创新地采用可学习的“缺失Token”来替代传统的零填充，有效缓解了多模态学习中因模态缺失导致的分布偏移问题。此外，引入的可靠性感知交叉注意力机制能够动态评估各模态的置信度，从而在噪声或缺失场景下实现更鲁棒的特征融合。实验在POLY-SIM 2026数据集上表现强劲，具有很高的实用价值。

title: $μ$VLA: On Recurrent Memory for Partially Observable Manipulation in VLA Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions from the current observation, an assumption that fails under partial observability, where decisions depend on information no longer visible. Existing memory-augmented VLAs simultaneously introduce recurrence, retrieval, compression modules, auxiliary objectives, hierarchical memory, or task-specific architectural changes, so the contribution of recurrence itself remains entangled with surrounding machinery. We present a controlled isolation study of recurrence in a strong pretrained VLA backbone. Our formulation augments the transformer with a small set of learnable memory tokens carried across timesteps and updated through self-attention, trained end to end with truncated backpropagation through time, with no auxiliary losses and no architectural changes. We instantiate this as $μ$VLA, a family of OpenVLA-OFT variants parameterized by memory width m, TBPTT length K, and the memory update rule (cross-step gradients or a detached EMA), so that recurrence is the only varying factor. On MIKASA-Robo, $μ$VLA improves average success rate on five training tasks from 0.42 to 0.84 at the strongest setting and reaches 0.23 on held-out tasks with the same memory structure versus 0.07 for the memoryless baseline. On tasks requiring different memory structure, performance remains near baseline. On LIBERO, the strongest recurrent variant achieves 96.2% average success, indicating no regression under full observability. We interpret these results as a calibration of the capability envelope of minimal in-backbone recurrence, identifying the regime in which it is sufficient and the regime where additional memory structure is required. Demos and videos can be found in https://avanturist322.github.io/mu-vla/.

AI.title_translation: $\mu$VLA：论VLA模型中用于部分可观测操纵的循环记忆
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 $\mu$VLA，通过在预训练VLA模型中引入极简的、跨时间步自注意力更新的记忆Token，系统且干净地研究了循环机制在解决部分可观测机器人操纵任务中的能力边界。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在部分可观测的环境中表现不佳，因为其决策依赖于当前不可见的历史信息。尽管现有的记忆增强型VLA引入了循环、检索、压缩等多种复杂模块，但这使得“循环机制”本身的独立贡献与其它复杂设计混淆在一起。因此，需要一项受控的隔离研究来探究最简循环机制在强预训练VLA骨干中的实际作用。
AI.method: 提出 $\mu$VLA（一种OpenVLA-OFT变体家族）。该方法在Transformer中引入少量可学习的记忆Token，这些Token跨时间步传递并通过自注意力进行更新。模型采用截断随时间反向传播（TBPTT）进行端到端训练，不使用任何辅助损失，也不对架构做其他修改。其参数化变量包括记忆宽度 $m$、TBPTT长度 $K$ 以及记忆更新规则（跨时间步梯度或分离的指数移动平均 EMA），从而将循环作为唯一的变量进行隔离研究。
AI.result: 在 MIKASA-Robo 任务上，$\mu$VLA 在最强设置下将五个训练任务的平均成功率从0.42提升至0.84，并在具有相同记忆结构的留出（held-out）任务上达到0.23（无记忆基线仅为0.07）。但在需要不同记忆结构的任务上，其性能接近基线。在完全可观测的 LIBERO 任务上，最强的循环变体实现了96.2%的平均成功率，表明该机制在完全可观测环境下不会导致性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功标定了骨干网络内极简循环机制的能力边界，明确了在何种情境下这种最简循环是足够的，以及在何种情境下需要引入更复杂的额外记忆结构。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常根据当前的观测来预测未来的动作块，这一假设在部分可观测的情况下会失效，因为此时的决策依赖于不再可见的信息。现有的记忆增强型VLA同时引入了循环、检索、压缩模块、辅助目标、分层记忆或特定于任务的架构变化，因此循环机制本身的贡献与周围的机制交织在一起。我们对强预训练VLA骨干中的循环机制进行了受控的隔离研究。我们的公式通过一小撮可学习的记忆Token来增强Transformer，这些Token跨时间步传递并通过自注意力进行更新，采用截断随时间反向传播（TBPTT）进行端到端训练，没有辅助损失，也没有架构改变。我们将此实例化为 $\mu$VLA，这是一个由记忆宽度 m、TBPTT长度 K 和记忆更新规则（跨时间步梯度或分离的EMA）参数化的 OpenVLA-OFT 变体家族，使得循环成为唯一的变量。在 MIKASA-Robo 上，$\mu$VLA 在最强设置下将五个训练任务的平均成功率从 0.42 提高到 0.84，并在具有相同记忆结构的留出任务上达到 0.23（而无记忆基线为 0.07）。在需要不同记忆结构的任务上，性能仍接近基线。在 LIBERO 上，最强的循环变体实现了 96.2% 的平均成功率，表明在完全可观测下没有退化。我们将这些结果解释为对骨干网内最小循环能力边界的校准，确定了其在何种情况下足够，以及在何种情况下需要额外的记忆结构。演示和视频可在 https://avanturist322.github.io/mu-vla/ 找到。
AI.summary: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在部分可观测任务中的局限性，提出了一种名为 $\mu$VLA 的极简循环记忆方案。通过在OpenVLA-OFT中引入跨时间步更新的记忆Token并使用TBPTT进行端到端训练，作者在不引入辅助损失和架构修改的前提下，隔离并研究了循环机制的独立作用。实验表明，$\mu$VLA显著提升了部分可观测操纵任务的成功率，同时保留了在完全可观测任务下的优异性能。
AI.keywords: VLA模型, 循环记忆, 部分可观测操纵, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于进行了一项干净的、受控的隔离研究，避免了以往研究中将“循环”机制与检索、分层记忆等复杂模块混淆的问题。通过在预训练Transformer中仅引入极简的记忆Token和TBPTT，证明了在不改变网络架构的前提下，循环机制本身即可大幅提升VLA模型在部分可观测环境下的表现。其局限性在于，面对需要不同或更复杂记忆结构的任务时，这种极简机制的性能仍会退化至基线水平，这为未来更复杂的记忆架构设计划定了清晰的能力边界。

title: From Parameters to Feature Space: Task Arithmetic for Backdoor Mitigation in Model Merging
summary: Model merging (MM) has gained significant attention as a cost-effective approach to integrate multiple task-specific models into a unified model. However, recent work reveals that MM is highly susceptible to backdoor attacks. Existing defenses based on task arithmetic often fail to eliminate backdoors without substantially degrading clean-task performance, owing to their reliance on direct parameter-space editing. To address this gap, we propose Linear Feature Path Minimization (LFPM), a backdoor mitigation framework for model merging, which introduces an anti-backdoor task vector into the backdoored merged model. Unlike prior approaches, LFPM formulates the backdoor robustness of the merged model from a unified feature-space perspective under the Cross-Task Linearity (CTL) framework, which leverages the approximate linearity of features across tasks. This perspective guides the optimization of the anti-backdoor task to suppress backdoors while preserving clean-task performance. Furthermore, we introduce an effective optimization mechanism based on gradient accumulation and loss path-integral, ensuring robust backdoor suppression along the interpolation path. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LFPM consistently exhibits strong robustness against backdoor attacks in both full fine-tuning and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) settings.

AI.title_translation: 从参数到特征空间：模型合并中后门缓解的任务算术
AI.tldr: 本文提出LFPM框架，通过在特征空间中引入反后门任务向量，有效抑制模型合并中的后门攻击，同时保持干净任务性能，优于现有依赖参数空间编辑的方法。
AI.motivation: 模型合并（MM）易受后门攻击，而现有基于任务算术的防御方法，因依赖直接参数空间编辑，难以在消除后门的同时保持干净任务性能。
AI.method: 提出线性特征路径最小化（LFPM）框架，为被后门攻击的合并模型引入反后门任务向量。该方法在统一的特征空间视角下，利用跨任务线性（CTL）框架优化反后门任务，以抑制后门并保留干净任务性能。此外，引入了基于梯度累积和损失路径积分的优化机制。
AI.result: LFPM在全微调和参数高效微调（PEFT）设置中，始终对后门攻击表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LFPM通过将后门缓解问题从参数空间转移到特征空间，并利用跨任务线性，成功解决了模型合并中的后门攻击问题，同时有效保持了模型性能。
AI.translation: 模型合并 (MM) 作为一种将多个特定任务模型集成到统一模型中的经济高效方法，受到了广泛关注。然而，最近的研究表明 MM 极易受到后门攻击。现有基于任务算术的防御措施通常无法在不大幅降低干净任务性能的情况下消除后门，因为它们依赖于直接的参数空间编辑。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了线性特征路径最小化 (LFPM)，一个用于模型合并的后门缓解框架，它将一个反后门任务向量引入到被后门攻击的合并模型中。与之前的方法不同，LFPM 在跨任务线性 (CTL) 框架下，从统一的特征空间视角阐述了合并模型的后门鲁棒性，该框架利用了特征在任务间的近似线性。这一视角指导了反后门任务的优化，以抑制后门同时保留干净任务性能。此外，我们引入了一种基于梯度累积和损失路径积分的有效优化机制，确保沿插值路径的鲁棒后门抑制。大量实验表明，LFPM 在全微调和参数高效微调 (PEFT) 设置中，始终对后门攻击表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文针对模型合并中后门攻击的脆弱性及其现有防御方法的局限性，提出了线性特征路径最小化（LFPM）框架。LFPM通过在特征空间而非参数空间中引入反后门任务向量，利用跨任务线性（CTL）框架，优化反后门任务以有效抑制后门，同时保持干净任务性能。该方法还引入了基于梯度累积和损失路径积分的优化机制。实验结果表明，LFPM在全微调和PEFT设置下，对后门攻击均展现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 模型合并, 后门攻击, 任务算术, 特征空间, LFPM
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将后门缓解的视角从传统的参数空间转向特征空间，并利用跨任务线性特性来设计防御机制。这种方法避免了直接修改参数可能导致的性能下降，为模型合并中的安全问题提供了新的解决思路。其在不同微调设置下的普适性也增强了其实用价值。

title: Action-Effect Memory Pretraining for Robot Manipulation
summary: We present AEM, an Action-Effect Memory pretraining framework for robot manipulation that learns compact temporal representations from vision-action history. Unlike prior robot representation pretraining methods that mainly focus on single-frame visual encoding, AEM targets the temporal nature of manipulation, where the current observation alone is often insufficient under partial observability. AEM models manipulation as an action-driven interaction process by interleaving visual and action features and applying masked modeling to recover missing content from incomplete histories, thereby learning action-conditioned state evolution. The Mamba-encoded output of the final vision token is used as a compact history representation, serving as the global context for decoding and downstream control. This design preserves a single-vector temporal bottleneck while keeping inference efficient. We evaluate AEM with Diffusion Policy and Flow Policy. AEM consistently improves manipulation performance in both simulation and real-world settings, outperforming baselines across clean scenes, cluttered and random scenes, and non-Markovian tasks. Ablation studies further show that history-aware pretraining surpasses single-frame pretraining and direct frame stacking, while reducing inference latency and computational cost.

AI.title_translation: 机器人操作的行动-效果记忆预训练
AI.tldr: AEM是一个用于机器人操作的预训练框架，通过学习视觉-动作历史的紧凑时序表示，解决了部分可观察性下的时序操作问题，并在模拟和真实世界中显著提升了操作性能。
AI.motivation: 先前的机器人表示预训练方法主要关注单帧视觉编码，这在部分可观察性下不足以处理操作的时序性质。AEM旨在通过从视觉-动作历史中学习时序表示来解决这一问题。
AI.method: AEM是一个行动-效果记忆预训练框架，用于机器人操作。它从视觉-动作历史中学习紧凑的时序表示。AEM通过交错视觉和动作特征，并应用掩码建模从不完整的历史中恢复缺失内容，从而学习行动条件的状态演化，将操作建模为一个行动驱动的交互过程。最终视觉标记的Mamba编码输出被用作紧凑的历史表示，作为解码和下游控制的全局上下文。这种设计保持了单向量时序瓶颈并提高了推理效率。该方法通过Diffusion Policy和Flow Policy进行评估。
AI.result: AEM在模拟和真实世界环境中都持续改进了操作性能。它在干净场景、杂乱和随机场景以及非马尔可夫任务中均优于基线。消融研究表明，历史感知预训练超越了单帧预训练和直接帧堆叠，同时减少了推理延迟和计算成本。
AI.conclusion: AEM通过利用行动-效果记忆和时序预训练，显著提高了机器人操作性能，特别是在复杂和部分可观察的环境中，同时保持了效率。
AI.translation: 我们提出了AEM，一个用于机器人操作的行动-效果记忆预训练框架，它从视觉-动作历史中学习紧凑的时序表示。与之前主要关注单帧视觉编码的机器人表示预训练方法不同，AEM针对操作的时序性质，在部分可观察性下，仅凭当前观察往往是不够的。AEM通过交错视觉和动作特征，并应用掩码建模从不完整的历史中恢复缺失内容，从而学习行动条件的状态演化，将操作建模为一个行动驱动的交互过程。最终视觉标记的Mamba编码输出被用作紧凑的历史表示，作为解码和下游控制的全局上下文。这种设计保持了单向量时序瓶颈，同时保持推理效率。我们使用Diffusion Policy和Flow Policy评估了AEM。AEM在模拟和真实世界环境中都持续改进了操作性能，在干净场景、杂乱和随机场景以及非马尔可夫任务中均优于基线。消融研究进一步表明，历史感知预训练超越了单帧预训练和直接帧堆叠，同时减少了推理延迟和计算成本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AEM，一个用于机器人操作的行动-效果记忆预训练框架。AEM通过从视觉-动作历史中学习紧凑的时序表示，解决了先前方法中单帧视觉编码的局限性。它通过交错视觉和动作特征并使用掩码建模，将操作建模为行动驱动的交互过程，以学习行动条件的状态演化。Mamba编码输出提供了一种高效、紧凑的历史表示。AEM通过Diffusion Policy和Flow Policy进行评估，在各种模拟和真实世界场景中持续改进了操作性能，优于基线，并与单帧和帧堆叠方法相比降低了计算成本。
AI.keywords: 机器人操作, 预训练, 时序表示, 行动-效果记忆, Mamba编码
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于通过“行动-效果记忆”预训练明确解决了机器人操作的时序性质，超越了单帧视觉编码。使用掩码建模在交错的视觉和动作特征上学习行动条件的状态演化是其关键方面。利用Mamba编码输出实现紧凑高效的时序瓶颈也值得关注。该框架通过在具有挑战性的非马尔可夫任务中提高性能并降低计算开销，显示出其重要性。

title: Improving Crash Frequency Prediction from Simulated Traffic Conflicts Using Machine Learning Based Microsimulation
summary: Traffic microsimulation combined with surrogate safety measures has increasingly been used as a proactive alternative to historical crash data for predicting crash frequency for current or planned road infrastructure designs. However, existing microsimulation-based safety studies have adopted simplified rule-based behaviour models, which reproduce traffic flow reasonably well but often fail to generate realistic conflict dynamics, limiting crash prediction accuracy. Recent advances in machine learning (ML)-based behaviour models offer a promising opportunity to potentially improve microsimulation realism and crash frequency predictions by learning human driving behaviour directly from large-scale trajectory datasets. To investigate this possibility, traffic microsimulation was conducted for five real-world signalised intersections in Leeds, UK, using both a standard rule-based model and a state-of-the-art ML model. Simulated vehicle trajectories were analysed using a two-dimensional Time-to-Collision metric to identify simulated conflicts, which were then modelled using Extreme Value Theory to predict crash frequency. Results show that conflicts from the ML model yielded crash predictions in line with the real-world crash data, whereas the rule-based model did not permit meaningful predictions, presumably due to a lack of model calibration to the specific simulated intersections. Directly using ML-generated simulated crashes to predict real-world crash frequency also yielded poor results, suggesting that while current ML models can realistically reproduce conflicts, they are not yet able to generate realistic crashes. Overall, the findings demonstrate that ML-based behaviour models are promising for improving crash prediction from simulated conflicts, without a need for location-specific model calibration, and suggest clear future directions for ML-based traffic microsimulation.

AI.title_translation: 使用基于机器学习的微观模拟改进模拟交通冲突的碰撞频率预测
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了使用机器学习行为模型改进交通微观模拟中碰撞频率预测的可行性。结果表明，与传统的基于规则的模型相比，机器学习模型能够生成更真实的冲突动态，从而在无需特定地点校准的情况下，提供与真实世界数据更一致的碰撞预测。
AI.motivation: 现有微观模拟安全研究采用的简化基于规则的行为模型在生成真实的冲突动态方面存在不足，限制了碰撞预测的准确性。机器学习行为模型有望通过直接从大规模轨迹数据中学习人类驾驶行为来提高微观模拟的真实性和碰撞频率预测。
AI.method: 研究在英国利兹的五个真实世界信号交叉口进行了交通微观模拟，同时使用了标准基于规则的模型和最先进的机器学习模型。通过二维碰撞时间（Time-to-Collision）指标分析模拟车辆轨迹以识别冲突，然后使用极值理论（Extreme Value Theory）对冲突进行建模以预测碰撞频率。
AI.result: 机器学习模型产生的冲突与真实世界碰撞数据一致，而基于规则的模型未能进行有意义的预测。直接使用机器学习生成的模拟碰撞来预测真实世界碰撞频率也产生了较差的结果，表明当前的机器学习模型可以真实地再现冲突，但尚不能生成真实的碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 基于机器学习的行为模型有望在无需特定地点校准的情况下，通过模拟冲突改进碰撞预测。
AI.translation: 交通微观模拟结合替代安全措施，作为历史碰撞数据的主动替代方案，在预测当前或规划道路基础设施设计的碰撞频率方面得到了越来越多的应用。然而，现有的基于微观模拟的安全研究采用了简化的基于规则的行为模型，这些模型能够很好地再现交通流，但往往无法生成真实的冲突动态，从而限制了碰撞预测的准确性。机器学习（ML）行为模型的最新进展提供了一个有前景的机会，通过直接从大规模轨迹数据中学习人类驾驶行为，有可能提高微观模拟的真实性和碰撞频率预测。为了调查这种可能性，本研究在英国利兹的五个真实世界信号交叉口进行了交通微观模拟，同时使用了标准基于规则的模型和最先进的ML模型。使用二维碰撞时间（Time-to-Collision）指标分析模拟车辆轨迹以识别模拟冲突，然后使用极值理论（Extreme Value Theory）对冲突进行建模以预测碰撞频率。结果表明，ML模型产生的冲突产生的碰撞预测与真实世界碰撞数据一致，而基于规则的模型未能进行有意义的预测，这可能归因于模型缺乏对特定模拟交叉口的校准。直接使用ML生成的模拟碰撞来预测真实世界碰撞频率也产生了较差的结果，这表明虽然当前的ML模型可以真实地再现冲突，但它们尚未能够生成真实的碰撞。总的来说，研究结果表明，基于ML的行为模型有望在无需特定地点校准的情况下，通过模拟冲突改进碰撞预测，并为基于ML的交通微观模拟提供了明确的未来方向。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在通过结合机器学习（ML）行为模型改进交通微观模拟中的碰撞频率预测，以克服传统基于规则模型在生成真实冲突动态方面的局限性。研究在英国利兹的五个信号交叉口进行了模拟，比较了标准规则模型和ML模型。结果显示，ML模型生成的冲突能更准确地预测真实世界碰撞频率，且无需特定地点校准，而直接使用ML生成的模拟碰撞进行预测效果不佳。这表明ML模型在模拟冲突方面潜力巨大，但尚不能生成真实的碰撞。
AI.keywords: 交通微观模拟, 碰撞频率预测, 机器学习, 交通冲突, 替代安全措施
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将机器学习行为模型应用于交通微观模拟，以提高碰撞频率预测的准确性。它解决了传统基于规则模型在生成真实冲突动态方面的不足，并展示了ML模型在无需特定地点校准的情况下，能够提供更接近真实世界碰撞数据的预测，这对于主动安全评估具有重要意义。然而，研究也指出当前ML模型尚无法生成真实的碰撞，这为其未来发展指明了方向。

title: Policy-driven Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy QoT Estimation
summary: We propose Conformal QoT, a policy-driven framework that combines statistically guaranteed QoT estimation with operational decision policies, enabling reliable lightpath-feasibility predictions under domain shift and improving accuracy from 92\% to 99.6\% on open datasets.

AI.title_translation: 用于可信QoT估计的策略驱动保形预测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种策略驱动的保形预测框架，将QoT估计准确率从92%提升至99.6%，实现了更可靠的光路可行性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的QoT（传输质量）估计方法在面对域偏移时可靠性不足，亟需一种既能提供统计保证又能支持实际运行决策的可靠预测框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种策略驱动的保形预测（Conformal Prediction）框架，通过结合统计保证与运行策略，在存在域偏移的情况下进行光路可行性预测。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，将预测准确率从92%提升至99.6%。
AI.conclusion: Conformal QoT框架通过结合保形预测与决策策略，成功实现了在光网络中更可靠、更准确的QoT估计，优于传统方法。
AI.translation: 我们提出了Conformal QoT，这是一个策略驱动的框架，将具有统计保证的QoT估计与操作决策策略相结合，能够在域偏移下实现可靠的光路可行性预测，并将开放数据集上的准确率从92%提高到99.6%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Conformal QoT的策略驱动框架，旨在解决光传输质量（QoT）估计在域偏移环境下的可靠性问题，通过集成保形预测技术，显著提升了预测准确性。
AI.keywords: 保形预测, QoT估计, 光网络, 域偏移, 策略驱动
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入策略驱动的框架，有效地将统计保证（Conformal Prediction）与实际运行决策相结合，显著提高了光路可行性预测的准确性，在应对域偏移（domain shift）问题上表现出较强的鲁棒性。

title: Dolph2Vec: Self-Supervised Representations of Dolphin Vocalizations
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has opened new opportunities in bioacoustics by enabling scalable modeling of animal vocalizations without the need for expensive manual annotation. However, current SSL models in this domain prioritize broad generalization across species and are not optimized for uncovering the fine-grained structure of individual communication systems. In this work, we collect and release a novel dataset of over five years of longitudinal recordings, from five known dolphins in a semi-naturalistic marine environment, an unprecedented resource for studying dolphin communication. We adapt the Wav2Vec2.0 Baevski et al. (2020) architecture to this domain and introduce Dolph2Vec, the first large-scale, species-specific SSL model trained exclusively on this data. We benchmark our model on two biologically relevant tasks: signature whistle classification and whistle detection. Dolph2Vec significantly outperforms general-purpose baselines in both tasks. Beyond performance, we show that learned embeddings and codebook structure capture interpretable acoustic units aligned with dolphin whistle categories and possibly sub-whistle structure, enabling fine-grained analysis of communication patterns. Our findings demonstrate how SSL can serve as both a model and a scientific tool to explore hypotheses in animal communication research.

title: A Type Theory of Sense: Witnessed Choice in Stratified Semantic Spaces
summary: We introduce TTS, a dependent type theory in which semantic composition is represented by horn filling and distinctions between possible completions are witnessed relative to explicit measurement regimes. TTS replaces globally canonical composition with regime-indexed indiscernibility and constructive apartness, allowing filler spaces to be classified as canonical when all completions are observationally connected and forked when two warranted completions are positively separated. Separation witnesses enter the calculus only through measurement contexts recording actual instrument outputs, yielding conservativity, provenance, and a no-fork-from-the-empty-record result. We prove that forks persist under refinement while canonicity may fail, and characterize exactly when an identification made by one regime can consistently coexist with a separation made by another. This framework supports a geometric account of Fregean sense as a choice of filler, reference as the boundary constraining that choice, and hyperintensional difference as measured apartness, while providing a falsifiable bridge to stratified representation spaces and branching behaviour in language-model generation.

AI.title_translation: 意义类型论：分层语义空间中的见证选择
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的依赖类型论（TTS），通过引入测量机制来处理语义歧义和语言模型中的生成分支，为语义学提供了一个几何化的解释框架。
AI.motivation: 为了解决传统语义学中全局规范组合（globally canonical composition）的局限性，并为语义歧义、超内涵差异以及语言模型中的生成分支行为提供一个严谨的数学框架。
AI.method: 通过引入基于Horn填充（horn filling）的依赖类型论（TTS），使用受测量机制索引的不可辨别性和构造性离散性来处理语义组合，并利用测量上下文引入分离见证（separation witnesses）。
AI.result: 证明了在不同测量机制下标识与分离的一致性，得出了保守性、来源溯源以及“空记录中无分支”的结果，并刻画了分支在细化过程中的持久性。
AI.conclusion: TTS提供了一个处理语义歧义和超内涵差异的严谨框架，证明了语义选择与测量机制之间的一致性，并为语言模型生成中的分支行为提供了可证伪的理论支持。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了TTS，这是一种依赖类型论，其中语义组合由Horn填充表示，且可能补全之间的区别是相对于明确的测量机制来见证的。TTS用机制索引的不可辨别性和构造性离散性取代了全局规范组合，允许在所有补全在观察上连通时将填充空间分类为规范的，而在两个有保证的补全被正向分离时分类为分支的。分离见证仅通过记录实际仪器输出的测量上下文进入演算，从而产生保守性、来源溯源和一个“从空记录中无分支”的结果。我们证明了分支在细化下持续存在，而规范性可能会失效，并准确刻画了由一种机制做出的识别何时能与另一种机制做出的分离一致地共存。该框架支持将弗雷格意义解释为填充的选择，将指称解释为约束该选择的边界，将超内涵差异解释为测量的离散性，同时为分层表示空间和语言模型生成中的分支行为提供了一个可证伪的桥梁。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“意义类型论”（TTS），一种通过Horn填充实现语义组合的依赖类型论。该框架通过引入测量机制来处理语义差异，将弗雷格意义定义为填充选择，指称定义为边界约束，并为语言模型生成中的分支行为提供了一个可证伪的几何解释。
AI.keywords: 依赖类型论, 语义组合, 测量机制, 超内涵差异, 语言模型生成
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入依赖类型论（TTS）为语义提供了一个深刻的几何解释，特别是对弗雷格意义理论的现代化重构。其创新点在于引入“测量机制”来处理语义歧义，将语言模型中的生成分支与形式语义学紧密结合，为理解大型语言模型的行为提供了严谨的数学基础。

title: Boosting Direct Preference Optimization with Penalization
comments: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline preference optimization has become a practical substitute for reinforcement learning from human feedback, but pairwise objectives such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and its variants use only the chosen and rejected responses stored in a static dataset. This leaves a useful signal unused: the response that the reference model itself would generate for the same prompt. We propose Direct Preference Optimization with Penalization (DPOP), a simple extension of DPO that augments the base preference loss with a gated penalty on reference-greedy responses. DPOP activates this penalty only when the current policy still assigns a lower likelihood to the preferred response than to the rejected response. On AlpacaEval 2.0, DPOP improves length-controlled win rate over DPO, SimPO, and AlphaDPO on both Llama-3-8b-it and Gemma-2-9b-it, achieving relative gains of 5.3\% and 4.4\% over baselines on the two models, respectively. Ablations further show that a SimNPO-style length-normalized penalty is stronger than NPO and token-level unlikelihood in this setting.
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning

title: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation: Post-Training Without Rubric Verifiers
summary: Rubrics have emerged as an alternative to RLVR in open-ended domains where a single ground-truth final answer is not available. Existing rubric-based training methods rely on an LLM verifier that scores each rollout against rubrics. This introduces substantial training-time overhead, exposes optimization to verifier-specific biases, and reduces rubric feedback to a sparse end-of-trajectory signal. We propose Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation (RGSD), a verifier-free training method in which the base policy, conditioned on the rubric, serves as the teacher for the unconditioned student. RGSD distills the rubric-conditioned teacher distribution into the student token-by-token, replacing sparse trajectory-level rewards with dense per-token learning signals and removing the LLM judge from the training loop entirely. Across Qwen-2.5 (3B, 7B) and Qwen3-Thinking (4B, 8B) models on medical and science domains, RGSD achieves rubric satisfaction comparable to judge-based GRPO while using one on-policy rollout per prompt and no training-time verifier calls. Ablations show that raw rubrics provide a stronger teacher enrichment signal than self-generated reference responses, while a stronger GRPO judge can outperform RGSD in some settings, positioning RGSD as a complementary verifier-free alternative when verifier cost or reliability is the bottleneck.

title: Foresight: Iterative Reasoning About Clues that Matter for Navigation
summary: Open-world mapless navigation from sparse language instructions requires resolving underspecified goals and inferring which environmental cues are relevant for reaching the goal. For instance, reaching an out-of-view destination may require interpreting ramps, signs, or detours that reveal where to go or which route to take. Prior works are limited by their reliance on known navigation factors and closed-set factor categories, or identify cues before motion planning and miss plan-dependent cues. We argue that pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can discover novel instruction-relevant cues, but require adaptation to focus on which cues matter and how they should influence motion planning. We realize these ideas in Foresight, a test-time framework in which a finetuned VLM alternates between proposing image-space motion plans and critiquing them using the language goal and visual context. Subsequent plans are conditioned on prior critiques, enabling iterative motion refinement before execution. To align plan critiques and refinements with open-set behavior preferences, we learn a reward model from human feedback and use it to post-train the VLM with reinforcement learning in the plan-critique loop. In offline evaluations and 6 real-world environments, Foresight improves average task success by 37% and reduces interventions per mission by 52% relative to state-of-the-art test-time reasoning and foundation-model baselines, while running in real-time on a Jetson AGX Orin. We will release code, data, and training details to support future work on test-time reasoning for robot motion refinement. Additional videos at: https://amrl.cs.utexas.edu/foresight

title: Crossing the Validation Crisis: Cross-Validation Reduces Benchmarking Variance Surprisingly Well
summary: Modern machine learning progresses through empirical work, benchmarking new methods to evaluate relative performance. However, the statistical variability inherent to evaluation - exacerbated by the stochastic nature of many algorithms - often makes performance estimation unreliable due to the limited test samples available, leading to a validation crisis in which genuine advances are difficult to discern. In this work, we show that cross-validation improves markedly confidence when evaluating and comparing learning algorithm performances. We introduce the concept of sample gain, which quantifies the virtual data augmentation achieved by using multiple cross-validation splits to reduce benchmarking variance. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets (histopathologic scans and NLP fine-tuning) demonstrate that multiple splits can substantially improve the reliability and stability of performance estimates, with diminishing returns often setting in later than expected. We also introduce a procedure to dynamically early-stop cross-validation by estimating from the first few folds if subsequent folds will bring large sample gains. Our findings highlight the value of pushing cross-validation on available samples to achieve robust and reliable benchmarking.

title: AudioX-Turbo: A Unified Framework for Efficient Anything-to-Audio Generation
summary: Audio and music generation based on flexible multimodal control signals is a widely applicable topic, with the following key challenges: 1) a unified multimodal modeling framework, 2) large-scale, high-quality training data, and 3) the prohibitive inference cost of multi-step diffusion sampling. As such, we propose AudioX-Turbo, a unified and efficient framework for anything-to-audio generation that integrates varied multimodal conditions (i.e., text, video, and audio signals) in this work. AudioX-Turbo follows a teacher-student paradigm. The teacher AudioX-Base is built on a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer with a Multimodal Adaptive Fusion module that aligns diverse multimodal inputs for high-fidelity synthesis, and is then distilled into the few-step student AudioX-Turbo via Distribution Matching Distillation adapted to flow matching, complemented by a diffusion-based discriminator for high-quality few-step generation. To support the training of AudioX-Turbo, we construct a large-scale, high-quality dataset, IF-caps-Pro, comprising approximately 9.2M samples curated through a two-stage data collection and annotation pipeline. We benchmark AudioX-Turbo across a wide range of tasks, finding that our model achieves superior performance, especially on text-to-audio and text-to-music generation, while operating at only 4 sampling steps and requiring approximately 25x fewer function evaluations (NFE) than multi-step baselines. These results demonstrate that our method is capable of audio generation under flexible multimodal control, showing efficient and powerful instruction-following capabilities. The code and datasets will be available at https://zeyuet.github.io/AudioX-Turbo/.

title: ITME: Inference Tiered Memory Expansion with Disaggregated CXL-Hybrid Memories
summary: The rapid shift toward agentic and long-context workloads in Large Language Models (LLMs) is pushing the industry beyond the capacity of individual servers toward disaggregated shared storage to handle TB-scale context states. This movement has led to the emergence of specialized shared context layers designed to externalize and share cumulative inference states across distributed clusters. While offloading to a data processing unit (DPU) within just-a-bunch-of-flash (JBOF) architectures accelerates NVMe-over-fabrics (NVMe-oF) target processing, the need for sophisticated software-level optimization and cost-efficiency burdens remain significant. Consequently, the ideal architecture for scaling this shared context infrastructure is still an active area of exploration. In this paper, we propose ITME (Inference Tiered Memory Expansion), which leverages a CXL-hybrid memory to present a massive, TB-scale byte-addressable remote memory expansion. This approach enables cost-efficient scaling and simplifies the software stack through direct byte-addressability, effectively addressing the challenges of shared context infrastructure. Our key insight is that the deterministic access patterns of voluminous model weights and prefix caches enable the system to proactively manage data movement across the memory-storage hierarchy. We validate ITME by evaluating its performance potential with production-grade SK Hynix CMM and PCIe Gen5 NVMe SSDs, while further demonstrating its functional feasibility through an FPGA-based hardware prototype. Overall, ITME enhances conventional CPU-offloading by providing additional remote memory expansion to accommodate large KV cache footprints beyond host memory limits, achieving up to a 35.7\% throughput improvement.

title: HairPort: In-context 3D-aware Hair Import and Transfer for Images
comments: Accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026 (Conference Papers Track). 23 pages, 15 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material as appendices. Project page: https://deepmancer.github.io/HairPort/
summary: Transferring hairstyles between images is an important but challenging task in computer graphics, computer vision, and visual effects. It enables users to explore new looks without physically altering their hair, with applications in virtual try-on systems, augmented reality, and entertainment. Most prior works operate best under small pose gaps, and they fall short under large viewpoint and scale differences, where missing hair content must be synthesized rather than transferred. We propose HairPort, a 3D-aware hairstyle transfer framework that attempts to solve these issues by explicitly separating hair removal from transfer and enforcing geometric consistency before synthesis. We introduce a Bald Converter, which produces realistic bald versions of faces through LoRA-based in-context adaptation of FLUX.1 Kontext. To train our Bald Converter, we introduce a new dataset, Baldy, containing 6,000 paired bald and original images across diverse identities and conditions. We also use a 3D-Aware Transfer Pipeline that reconstructs and re-renders the reference hairstyle from the target viewpoint before compositing it onto the source image. Being 3D aware, our method supports large pose and scale discrepancies between the source and target. Finally, a conditional flow-matching generator synthesizes the transferred result from the bald source and geometry-aligned reference guidance. Together, our method enables accurate, pose-consistent, and identity-preserving hairstyle transfer, outperforming existing methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026 (Conference Papers Track). 23 pages, 15 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material as appendices. Project page: https://deepmancer.github.io/HairPort/

title: Arbor: Tree Search as a Cognition Layer for Autonomous Agents
summary:
Arbor is a multi-agent framework that introduces structured tree search as a cognition layer for autonomous agents operating in large, stateful action spaces. Prior autonomous optimization systems operate on isolated targets with stateless evaluation. Arbor instead maintains an explicit search tree of scored hypotheses that serves as the shared working memory across agents, evolving with every measurement, treating failures as diagnostic signal that reshapes subsequent exploration, and expanding as prior successes shift the bottleneck distribution.
  We validate Arbor on full-stack LLM inference optimization, a domain where achieving peak performance has historically required coordinated effort from engineering teams across the application, framework, compiler, kernel, and hardware stack. Arbor pairs an Orchestrator agent, which drives optimization by delegating to Domain Specialists across the inference stack, with a Critic agent that safeguards stability through root-cause analysis, introspection, and measurement validation -- a checks-and-balances architecture where neither agent can unilaterally drive the system. Agent capabilities are decomposed into hard skills (domain expertise) and soft skills (coordination protocols that determine how contributions compose), enabling fully autonomous multi-day campaigns. Arbor achieves up to 193% inference throughput-latency Pareto improvement over vendor-optimized baselines, while a single agent without the harness plateaus at +33% throughput improvement and crashes irrecoverably within hours. Arbor generalizes to multiple generations of hardware platform, and run-to-run variance is within 2 percentage points demonstrating that the method is hardware-agnostic and reproducible.

title: EDEN: A Large-Scale Corpus of Clinical Notes for Italian
summary: We present EDEN (Emergency Department Electronic Notes), a new and unique large-scale corpus of clinical notes produced in Emergency Departments of Italian hospitals. The corpus, in its current version, is composed of approximately 4 million clinical notes fully anonymized, covering diverse phases of patient care during the stay in the emergency department. In addition, a subset of about six thousand notes has been manually annotated by clinical experts through a structured Case Report Form (CRF) containing 132 items relevant for two patient situations in emergency departments, dyspnea and loss of consciousness. Items may assume numerical values (e.g., for blood saturation), categorical (e.g., for level of consciousness ), binary (e.g., for presence of traumas), and mixed value types. The annotation process involved multiple clinicians and underwent iterative revision to resolve ambiguities in item formulation, resulting in a richly structured (although high imbalanced) resource. The dataset aims to fill a relevant gap of data able to support both the development and the use of Large Language Models in concrete medical applications. We describe the data collection protocol, the on-site anonymisation pipeline, corpus statistics, and the annotation scheme. Finally, we propose CRF-filling as a novel structured information extraction benchmark, and provide zero-shot baseline resulting from Gemma-27B and MedGemma-27B. To the best of our knowledge, the EDEN dataset is the largest freely available corpus of clinical notes existing for the Italian language.

title: Structure-preserving discretization and fingering dynamics of a Cahn-Hilliard model for traction-driven digit morphogenesis
summary: We study a Cahn-Hilliard equation with anisotropic traction flux arising as a reduced continuum model of mechanically biased cell interactions in digit-forming organoids. For a regularized problem with strictly positive bounded mobility, we introduce a mixed finite element discretization based on an implicit-explicit treatment of the chemical potential. We prove existence of discrete solutions, establish exact mass conservation and a discrete energy inequality, and show convergence of the fully discrete approximations to a weak solution of the regularized problem. Numerical experiments illustrate the resulting dynamics and show the transition from classical coarsening to traction-induced fingering and protrusive growth. The computational study is complemented by mass and energy diagnostics, an energy-balance residual, fingering-onset and protrusion-count diagnostics, and a manufactured-solution convergence study.

title: High-Fidelity Two-Step Image Generation via Teacher-Aligned End-to-End Distillation
summary: Few-step diffusion distillation has become increasingly mature for 4-8-step generation, yet pushing further to 2 steps remains challenging. In this work, we introduce Z-Image Turbo++, a high-quality 2-step image generation model distilled from the 8-step Z-Image Turbo teacher. Our method addresses the central bottlenecks of increased task difficulty and limited model capacity in 2-step generation through three simple but effective design choices tailored to this regime. First, we propose Distribution-Aligned Adversarial Learning, which uses teacher-generated images rather than external real images as real samples for GAN training, providing a more attainable and informative adversarial target. Second, we adopt Step-Decoupled Parameterization, assigning independent model parameters to the two denoising steps to better match their distinct capacity demands. Third, we perform End-to-End Training with Iterative Regularization, allowing the first step to receive gradients from final image quality while preserving a meaningful intermediate generation through an explicit step-1 loss. Together, these designs substantially narrow the quality gap between 2-step and 8-step generation in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, highlighting the potential of carefully tailored distillation strategies for improving the quality-efficiency trade-off in few-step generation.

title: Helping Figures Tell their Story! Paper-Grounded Video Generation Explaining Complex Scientific Figures
summary: Scientific figures compress complex pipelines into a single canvas, yet understanding them requires paper-grounded, step-by-step narration aligned with visual highlights a capability missing from current video generation systems and benchmarks. To address this, we introduce paper-grounded figure-to-video generation: generating narrated, region-grounded walkthrough videos from a figure and its paper. We propose MINARD (Multimodal Interpretation of Narrated Architecture via Region Decomposition), a pipeline that generates paper-grounded narrations and sequentially grounds them to figure regions. We also release FigTalk, a benchmark with new sequential and component-level grounding metrics derived. On FigTalk, MINARD generates humanlike, paper-faithful narrations and outperforms narration-conditioned figure spatial grounding compared to existing approaches in both automatic and human evaluation

title: Cascading Smoothers for Multigrid
summary: Multigrid methods are among the most effective frameworks for solving large-scale sparse systems. However, achieving their hallmark linear scaling and rapid convergence crucially depends on an effective smoother algorithm, whose design is often highly problem-dependent. This paper develops a new approach, referred to as \textit{cascading smoothers} due to their operation as an ordered sequence of single-step block-diagonal smoothers. Each level in the cascade is optimised to maximally damp the output of prior steps via a Frobenius norm minimisation of the corresponding error propagators. In particular, we develop an additive (resp., multiplicative) formulation analogous to Jacobi (resp., Gauss-Seidel). Applied within a standard multigrid V-cycle, we show they are remarkably effective across a wide array of problems, including finite difference, finite element, and discontinuous Galerkin discretisations applied to Poisson, elliptic interface, and Stokes systems as well as multiphase variants. In every case, cascading smoothers closely match or significantly outperform their optimally-damped classical counterparts, yet require no parameter tuning apart from a few discrete solver choices. Additionally, the approach is highly parallelisable and robust to geometric and operator complexities such as unstructured meshes and high-contrast coefficients.

title: MARD: Mirror-Augmented Reasoning Distillation for Mechanism-Level Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
summary: Mechanism-level drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction requires identifying which enzyme or pharmacodynamic axis is implicated, in which direction, and with which evidence -- not merely whether two drugs interact. We introduce a reproducible mechanism-level DDI labelling and evaluation protocol with a structured 7-family/147-subtype taxonomy, leakage-safe cold-split protocols, and auditable reasoning metrics for evaluating pharmacological prediction beyond flat interaction classification. We propose a pipeline that produces a 7B reasoning MARD (Mirror-Augmented Reasoning Distillation), combining three training innovations: a single-token KL divergence on direction tag that ties the model's prediction, per-loss PRM-weighted DPO with programmatic hard negatives, and a leakage-safe mechanism-aware retrieval channel. Process-reward step labels are automatically verifiable against DrugBank-structured fields, requiring no human or LLM judges. On the April-2026 DrugBank release, our MARD-7B is the only system in a 32-system comparison whose accuracy survives drug-pair novelty, beating the best baseline by +13.9 pp and GPT-4o by +6.7 pp at ~1% of frontier API cost. Further analysis reveals an anti-memorisation signature where accuracy improves on rarely seen drugs, suggesting that gain comes from structured pharmacological reasoning rather than drug-frequency memorisation. We release corpus, DDI-PRM, retrieval index, and training code.

title: G-MAPP: GPU-accelerated Multi-Agent Planning and Perception for Reactive Motion Generation
comments: The implementation is available at: https://github.com/chart-research/g-mapp
summary: Reactive motion generation in unstructured environments remains an open challenge in robotics. Due to the computational complexity of collision-free motion generation, existing methods either generate global trajectories for static scenarios, or employ models that make conservative assumptions about the environment. This paper identifies the primary bottleneck as the runtime performance demand of planning on high-fidelity environments, and the temporal integration between the perception and planning modules. Therefore, we propose a framework that does not compromise on runtime performance and world representations for perception and planning by accelerating world modeling and vector-field based planning using the GPU. This allows us to achieve faster parallel state exploration for quasi-global trajectory planning, and tighter coupling of the perception-action loop in real-time for dynamic cluttered environments with off-the-shelf depth sensors. We quantitatively evaluate the computation-time and success rate differences for the CPU and GPU versions of our planner, and perform qualitative evaluations of our coupled framework using real-world experiments on a 7-DoF Franka Emika robot. Experimental results demonstrate that our GPU-based framework achieves up to a 5x speedup over the CPU version and successfully avoids collisions across both trivial and challenging physical world scenarios.
comment: The implementation is available at: https://github.com/chart-research/g-mapp

title: Graph Reduction in Multirelational Networks: A Spreading-Oriented Reduction Benchmark
summary: Real-world networks are inherently incomplete, noisy, and dynamically evolving, making it difficult to capture all actors and their relationships. Their scale often renders direct analysis computationally demanding. While influence maximisation (IM) has been widely studied, the role of graph reduction as a preprocessing step, and its impact on IM accuracy, remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce the Spreading-Oriented Reduction Benchmark (SORB), an open-source, standardised framework for systematically evaluating IM models across diverse task settings. SORB provides an extensible pipeline operating on a representative collection of real-world networks, including single- and multilayer structures, and accounts for graph reduction directly into the evaluation process. This design shifts the focus from analysing IM algorithms in isolation to quantifying how graph reduction alters predictive performance. Using SORB, we study the effects of sparsification and coarsening across multiple IM scenarios. Our results show that the impact of reduction is strongly dependent on both the network type (single-layer vs. multirelational) and the downstream task ($Gain@k$ vs. $\mathrm{AUC}_{\mathrm{cutoff}}$): sparsification preserves seed set quality on single-layer networks, whereas flattened multilayer networks exhibit systematic ranking degradation regardless of reduction strategy. These findings highlight the importance of reduction-aware, multi-task evaluation when studying spreading processes in complex networks.

title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: Examining Trigger Leakage in Vision-Language Agentic Systems
summary: Vision-Language Agentic Systems (VLAS) connect visual perception to planning, tool use, and physical actions. This means backdoor-type triggers can propagate through both decision pipelines and their connected interfaces, thus making visual backdoors a system-level threat. Current evaluations on such backdoors focus on clean accuracy and attack success rate (ASR), metrics that capture whether a trigger works, but not whether an attack is actually "precise" -- i.e. whether it triggers hidden behaviors only when intended. In this work, we formalize the failure of trigger precision as "trigger leakage": inputs that are visually or semantically close to the intended trigger and therefore inadvertently activate the attacker-specified behavior. To quantify this leakage, we introduce Neighbor Leakage Rate (NLR). Our experiments show that at a 3% poisoning ratio, icon and text triggers remain robust to common visual transformations, but their neighboring variants leak heavily, with NLR reaching 0.996 (icon) and 0.944 (text). Using textual triggers as a controlled probe, we show that standard fine-tuning learns a broad activation region rather than an exact trigger condition, causing neighboring strings to invoke the malicious behavior even when the exact trigger is absent. Adding edit-distance-one hard-negative samples during training substantially narrows this activation region and reduces leakage, including in image-editing and embodied-manipulation workflows, where leaked triggers can propagate into executable programs and action sequences.

title: Strategic Decision Support for AI Agents
summary: Traditionally, decision support studies how humans use machine learning models to make better decisions. In modern agentic systems, this division of roles is increasingly reversed: AI agents act on behalf of users, while humans and tools becomes support mechanisms around them. This role reversal brings reliability concerns to the forefront, since agentic errors can be consequential and agent behavior must remain aligned with human goals and constraints. Departing from the classical view of decision support, we revisit its two basic principles, the cost--value tradeoff of seeking support and the role of uncertainty quantification, in a setting where AI agents are the central actors. We propose a framework for strategic decision support for AI agents through an optimization problem that minimizes support usage subject to controlling a counterfactual missed-support error: the probability that the agent acts alone on instances where support would have materially improved its output. At the population level, we show that the optimal policy is a threshold rule on the value of support. Building on this structure, we develop an online algorithm that adaptively thresholds such a score and uses randomized exploration to control missed-support error without distributional assumptions. We further introduce a calibration-on-the-fly method that reduces unnecessary support calls online. We instantiate this framework across diverse scenarios, including information gathering, human--AI collaboration, and tool use, showing how each can be modeled through the same strategic decision-support lens. Experiments across these settings show that our method reliably controls the target error while substantially reducing support usage in practice.

title: Analyzing and Improving Fine-grained Preference Optimization in Medical LVLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved strong performance across medical imaging tasks, yet they remain prone to factual inconsistencies, poor visual grounding, and misalignment with clinically meaningful feedback. Existing post-training alignment approaches, including Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and its variants, face three critical limitations in the medical domain: (1) sequence-level reward signals treat clinically critical tokens identically to generic filler text; (2) reliance on static supervised fine-tuning references as preferred responses introduces an off-policy distribution shift, steering optimization toward stylistic artifacts over clinical correctness; and (3) alignment objectives lack explicit visual grounding constraints, leaving models insensitive to subtle yet diagnostically decisive pathological features. Our method leverages a bidirectional token-wise KL regularizer alongside a visual-contrastive grounding objective that pairs clean and lesion-corrupted images to penalize responses generated without adequate visual evidence. Together, these components form a fine-grained, on-policy alignment framework that constructs preference pairs by minimally editing model-generated outputs, correcting only clinically erroneous spans while preserving the original linguistic style. Extensive experiments across medical imaging tasks and clinical text generation benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our approach.

title: Characterizing Tests in IoT Software: Practices, Challenges and Opportunities
