summary: Every finite family of compact convex bodies in Euclidean space induces an apartness relation between disjoint index sets: two sets are apart when the convex hulls of the corresponding unions are disjoint. This paper studies the finite theory obtained by taking apartness as the primitive relation. Its basic laws are symmetry, bilateral subsumption, and vacuity, equivalently the separation-polarity form of acyclic separoids. The main contribution is an effective rational realization theorem with uniform margins and the exact consequence theory it supports. Every finite apartness separoid is realized by rational polytopes whose coordinates are indexed by maximal separations. Maximal separations and minimal Radon partitions can be enumerated from a full table, generators, or a membership oracle; the coordinate values have controlled bit height; and each coordinate records a readable certificate of one maximal separation. The realization separates every apart pair with clearance at least 2, remains correct under outer parallel enlargement by any radius below 1, and yields full-dimensional convex bodies after thickening. The distance-function layer records standard convex-analytic stability through Lipschitz comparison, monotonicity under inclusion, and outer parallel bodies. On the logical side, positive entailment is exactly one-premise subsumption. Boolean consequence over Euclidean scenes is sound, complete, and decidable; satisfiability is NP-complete, validity is coNP-complete, and positive entailment is linear for sorted encodings. A stratification theorem shows that Boolean reasoning introduces no new atomic apartness beyond separoid closure. Fixed-dimensional consequence relations form a strictly decreasing hierarchy that stabilizes in dimension n minus 1 for n sites.
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures. Includes effective rational representation with uniform margins, logical consequence analysis, and a fixed-dimensional hierarchy

title: Fed-FBD: Federated Functional Block Diversification for Isolation, Privacy, and Surgical Unlearning
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without sharing raw patient data, but standard approaches such as FedAvg treat each client as a black box and provide no mechanism for isolating an adversarial contributor, auditing per-client influence, or honoring a departed participant's right to be forgotten. We present Fed-FBD (Federated Functional Block Diversification), a modular federated architecture that decomposes a ResNet backbone into six functional blocks (the stem, four residual groups, and the classification head) and maintains a warehouse of N color variants, each assembled from independently tracked and contributor-stamped blocks. Fed-FBD provides three capabilities absent in FedAvg: (i) architecturally guaranteed block-level isolation, so that an adversarial or mislabelled client cannot contaminate the clean colous; (ii) privacy-by-design, where membership inference advantage is already indistinguishable from chance before any privacy mechanism is applied; and (iii) surgical machine unlearning of a departed participant's contribution at sub-second cost and without retraining. Experiments on six MedMNIST-2D datasets, PathMNIST at 224x224, and CIFAR-10 show that Fed-FBD trades a modest 0.3%-3.1% IID accuracy gap on the adequately sized datasets for these guarantees, remains within 0.8%-4.0% of FedAvg at Dirichlet alpha=1.0 on three of four datasets, and confines all six adversarial attacks we study to the poisoned client's own blocks with at most +/-0.01 AUC drift on the clean colors.

title: How Useful is Causal Invariance for Domain Adaptation in Finite-Sample Settings?
summary:
Machine learning models often degrade when they are deployed on a target distribution that differs from the source distributions they were trained on. Recent work in causality-based domain generalization has shown how shared causal structure between domains can induce invariant predictors, e.g., models on a subset of features which have stable risk across structured domain shifts. However, the extent to which such population-level causal invariances can lead to gains in finite-sample settings remains underexplored. In particular, in practice we often have access to a few labeled target samples, a setting called supervised domain adaptation (sDA). In this paper, we explore when (full or partial) causal knowledge can provably improve supervised domain adaptation.
  As a first step, we study linear regression, where full or partial causal knowledge specifies a collection of invariant or possibly invariant feature subsets, each yielding a source-trained candidate predictor. We derive matching upper and lower bounds showing that finite-sample gains are governed by the target-risk margins separating the candidates, together with the finite-source estimation error. When these margins are sufficiently large relative to $n_Q$, an adaptive aggregation procedure can match the best candidate predictor while avoiding negative transfer relative to target-only learning. On the other hand, when the margins are too small, no algorithm can reliably exploit the candidate collection to obtain faster finite-sample rates. We further connect these margins to structural shift magnitude in linear SCMs and validate the theory on real-world causal benchmarks.

title: From AGI to ASI
summary: Over the last decade, building human-level artificial general intelligence has moved from far-fetched speculation to being a concrete next-decade target for many of the largest AI organisations. Achieving this goal would have profound and far-reaching impacts on human society, which raises many complex questions for the decade ahead. This report investigates how AI itself might continue to develop in a post-AGI world along the continuum of machine intelligence. The endpoint of this continuum, Universal AI, is theoretically well understood, which provides some formal grounding for the main focus of this report: the transition from human-level AGI to artificial general superintelligence, which, intuitively, can be understood as a system that is more intelligent and cognitively capable than large organisations of humans. After characterizing ASI, the report discusses four potential pathways from AGI to ASI: scaling AGI, AI paradigm shifts, recursive improvement, and ASI emerging from large-scale multi-agent collectives. The report then discusses possible frictions and bottlenecks along these pathways. Determining whether the impact of these frictions will be negligible or substantial raises a number of concrete open research questions. Due to large uncertainties for predicting ASI progress, it cannot be ruled out that AI progress might continue to accelerate over the next years. This could imply that the image of a single transformative step change, caused by the introduction of human-level AGI into our society, could be inaccurate. More apt might be the prospect of a series of transformative societal changes caused by AI-enabled progress and breakthroughs across many areas of science and technology. Preparing for this prospect requires a massively interdisciplinary endeavour of global scope and interest.

title: Forecasting Is Not Attribution: Localizing Decoder Bypass in Graph-Based Neural Marketing Mix Models
summary: Marketing mix models are used to forecast business outcomes and to attribute those outcomes to marketing channels, but these goals are not equivalent. We study a failure mode in graph-based neural MMM called attribution bypass: a high-capacity decoder can obtain low forecasting error through target autoregression, dense communication, co-movement, context, or latent memory while failing to route counterfactual sensitivity through the graph used as the attribution object. We introduce DICE-MMM as a bounded diagnostic and training framework. We do not claim that observational neural MMM identifies causal effects. Instead, DICE separates three questions often conflated in graph-based MMM: graph recovery, forecasting accuracy, and whether the trained decoder's perturbation-induced influence is graph aligned. Stage 1 trains a graph encoder with a restricted graph-mediated decoder. Stage 2 freezes the selected encoder and trains a graph-safe latent decoder whose cross-node communication must pass through the supplied graph. Decoder use is evaluated with CIG, AR-CIG, and graph-swap tests. Across controlled R/d/T swaps and an external multi-graph rawlog stress test, DICE improves stable graph recovery over CausalMMM. The experiments show that forecasting accuracy is not an attribution certificate: in a sparse-target benchmark, no-graph and full-graph decoders achieve MSE@7 around 0.004 while AR-CIG nAUPRC remains near or below zero, whereas an oracle graph reaches 0.807 +/- 0.129 at comparable MSE. Frozen graph-swap localizes the bottleneck: the same DICE-hard-trained decoder moves from nAUPRC -0.044 +/- 0.006 under learned graph inputs to 0.894 +/- 0.027 with the oracle graph. The contribution is a stress test and failure-localization framework showing that low MSE can hide attribution bypass and that the unresolved bottleneck is graph-support selection, not forecasting or decoder capacity.

title: M*: A Modular, Extensible, Serving System for Multimodal Models
summary: We are entering a new era of composite model architectures that integrate diverse components such as vision encoders, language backbones, diffusion and flow heads, audio codecs, action generators, and world-model predictors. Such architectures underpin a broad class of multimodal models, including unified multimodal models, omni models, speech-language models, vision-language-action policies, and world models. However, existing model serving frameworks were built on narrow assumptions about model structure, making them ill-suited to accommodate this new architectural diversity. Here we present M*, a universal serving system for efficient serving of composite AI models. M* represents models as dataflow graphs, processing requests spanning diverse modalities and tasks as traversals over these graphs. The core insight is a modular abstraction that supports arbitrary composition of model components, flexible placement onto a physical cluster, and model-agnostic optimizations within a distributed runtime. We call this abstraction the Walk Graph and show how it can concisely capture composite models from a broad range of families. We instantiate M* on representative models and find that it achieves, on average, 20% lower end-to-end latency than vLLM-Omni for text-to-image workloads on BAGEL, while delivering up to 2.9x lower real-time factor and 2.7x higher throughput for text-to-speech workloads on Qwen3-Omni. M* also outperforms the V-JEPA 2-AC rollout baseline for robotic planning by up to 12.5x. Thus, our work paves the road towards more efficient serving of complex models with minimal developer effort.

title: Observable Patterns Are Not Explanations: A Causal-Geometric Analysis of Latent Reasoning Models
summary: Latent reasoning models (LRMs) replace explicit chain-of-thought with continuous thoughts. Recent work treats observable latent-state patterns, such as BFS-like frontiers and decodable arithmetic computation, as evidence for internal reasoning mechanisms. Evaluating two LRMs (Coconut and CODI) against controls lacking the proposed recurrence or curriculum, we find these patterns also appear in the controls and do not always causally affect behavior. Causal interventions reveal that latent-thought utilization is not binary but graded, scaling with a thought's causal effect on model behavior. Geometric analyses reveal this effect concentrates in low-rank directions whose step-to-step geometry grows more structured as their behavioral influence increases. Latent thoughts should therefore be treated as hidden computation, not hidden explanation: decodability, attention, or static structure alone cannot establish mechanism. LRM interpretability thus requires matched controls and causal tests.

title: EWAM: An Enhanced World Action Model for Closed-Loop Online Adaptation in Embodied Intelligence
summary: In this paper, we propose the Enhanced World Action Model (EWAM), a closed-loop online adaptation architecture built upon a pretrained and fully frozen Cosmos3 backbone network. Evaluated entirely under a zero-shot task protocol, EWAM is centrally focused on reducing the amount of additional deployment data required to adapt to new task layouts. Notably, no extra task-specific demonstration sets were introduced in any of the evaluations, and no fine-tuning was performed on the backbone network. Its performance gains stem entirely from an inference-time co-reasoning mechanism composed of four inserted lightweight neural layers: the Neural Experience Memory Layer located in the intermediate layers of the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) provides task-relevant execution context; the Neural Anomaly Detection Layer after the state prediction head monitors the divergence between predicted and actual states in real time; the Neural Policy Routing Layer dynamically selects direct execution, conservative replanning, or rollback recovery based on the anomaly severity; and the Neural Action Correction Layer refines the generated action chunks using execution diagnostics. Unlike naive feature fusion, the memory, anomaly detection, and correction modules are deeply integrated into the Cosmos3 forward path in a differentiable manner, with only the final routing decision being a discrete supervised one.

title: Two-Layer Linear Auto-Regressive Models Estimate Latent States
summary: Auto-regressive models have emerged as powerful tools for sequential data, from language to video. Understanding how and why these models learn latent representations remains an open theoretical question. In this work, we demonstrate that when trained by empirical risk minimization on data from partially observed linear dynamical systems, two-layer linear auto-regressive models naturally learn to approximate Kalman filtering. In particular, we show that the learned hidden representation coincides, up to a similarity transformation, with the state estimates produced by the optimal (Kalman) filter, even though the model has no explicit knowledge of the underlying dynamics or state. The result follows from three main insights. First, we establish that the Kalman filter is well approximated by an auto-regressive model with bounded truncation error. Second, we show that despite non-convexity, the two-layer optimization landscape is benign, i.e., all stationary points are either strict saddles or global minima. Finally, as our main contributions, we provide finite-sample guarantees on prediction error, parameter estimation error, and latent state recovery. Numerical simulations support the theoretical results and demonstrate that the latent representations of auto-regressive models recover state estimates.

title: Random Proposals: A Softmax-Based Local-Improvement Framework for Maximum Weighted Matching
summary: We propose a randomized local-improvement algorithm for the Maximum Weighted Matching (MWM) problem. Our method introduces a softmax-based biased sampling mechanism that achieves local $\varepsilon$-dominance and yields an expected $\frac{1}{2}-\varepsilon$ approximation ratio. We prove convergence guarantees and show that the algorithm runs in $O\!\left(m\log(1/\varepsilon)/p_{\min}\right)$ time, where $p_{\min}$ is the minimum softmax proposal probability over all edges; under mild conditions on the bias parameter and weight range, this simplifies to $O(m\log(1/\varepsilon))$. The framework provides a tunable tradeoff between convergence speed and approximation quality.

title: A unified complexity bound for logconcave sampling
summary: We give a simple, unified, and nearly tight bound for sampling arbitrary logconcave distributions from a warm start using the In-and-Out algorithm along with exponential lifting. The main new ingredient in the analysis is an improved bound on the Poincaré constant of a lifted distribution. As a consequence, the resulting convergence rate is nearly tight for both constrained settings (e.g., Gaussian restricted to a convex body) and well-conditioned settings (e.g., strongly logconcave and smooth densities).

title: Polymer-based Capacitive Micromachined Transducer-Enabled Inline Monitoring of Ultrasonic Welding in Thermoplastic Carbon Fiber Composites
summary: Thermoplastic composite structures enable lightweight, recyclable, and high-throughput aerospace manufacturing, but reliable quality assurance of advanced joining processes remains a key challenge. This work presents a compact, low-cost, and wireless ultrasonic non-destructive testing system for real-time, inline monitoring of continuous ultrasonic welding of thermoplastic carbon fiber composites. The system integrates custom-fabricated polymer-based capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducers (polyCMUTs) with the ultra-low-power WULPUS platform, enabling operation in the harsh, high-interference welding environment. An eight-element linear polyCMUT array operating at a center frequency of approximately 3.6 MHz is designed, fabricated, packaged, and integrated into an industrial welding setup. Inline measurements are performed during welding of carbon fiber laminates with intentionally introduced defects. Process-synchronous ultrasonic data reveal consistent depth-of-echo shifts at defect locations, in strong agreement with X-ray computed tomography ground truth. Across 21 welds, all induced defects are detected without false negatives and with limited false positives. The results demonstrate that polymer-based CMUT technology enables robust, scalable, and manufacturing-compatible ultrasonic sensing, representing a decisive step toward intelligent process monitoring and quality assurance for next-generation thermoplastic composite welding.

title: LLM-Powered Personalized Glycemic Assessment in Type 2 Diabetes with Wearable Sensor Data
comments: The 14th IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics, 2026
summary:
Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) poses an increasing global health threat, demanding effective glycemic assessment to support personalized and improved diabetes care. Wearable sensors such as continuous glucose monitors (CGM) and fitness trackers offer many valuable insights for glycemic assessment. However, effectively analyzing these data requires integration with essential individual-level context. Existing methods are often based on traditional machine learning (ML) and rely primarily on historical blood glucose measurements and overlook personalized information, which limits their performance across diverse diabetes populations. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated their ability to integrate diverse data modalities while modeling sequential dependencies, motivating the exploration of their potential for personalized glycemic assessment.
  In this paper, we propose GlyLLM, an LLM-powered framework for modeling CGM-based glycemic dynamics through the integration of wearable sensor data and structured metadata. GlyLLM can leverage the extensive prior knowledge of pre-trained LLMs and achieve sensor-text semantic abstraction at decision time. Experiments on two related tasks on the AI-READI dataset demonstrate that our model outperforms traditional ML methods by an average of 13.66\% in Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) for glucose forecasting and 13.08\% in Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUROC) for diabetes categorization. Additionally, our ablation study shows that diabetes surveys and biometric tests are more critical than other health information for glycemic assessment. Our work presents a promising step toward harnessing the power of LLMs to advance personalized glycemic assessment in T2D care.
comment: The 14th IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics, 2026

title: Deployment-Centered Evaluation: Predicting Query-Level Rejection Risk in a Clinical LLM System
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into clinical systems, making it essential to evaluate the real-world utility of these systems. However, static benchmarks tend to measure correctness rather than user acceptance, aggregate performance across queries, and require densely annotated datasets -- leading to major blind spots for evaluating clinical systems. In this work, we perform a deployment-centered evaluation of an LLM system embedded within electronic health records at an academic medical center, where user feedback is sparse but closely reflects the deployment conditions. Specifically, we train a pre-response classifier that estimates the risk that a future interaction will result in the user rejecting the LLM response, based on query content and deployment-specific context available before generation. We conduct a prospective analysis of our model over 4.5 months of user feedback, finding that our prediction model achieves an AUROC of 0.719. Further, we estimate the benefit of such predictions in two downstream use cases (guardrail triggering and abstention). Our key conceptual insight is that making use of deployment-specific context (i.e., the provider type, department name, language model used for response), as opposed to only query content, improves the ability to predict whether the user will reject the system output. Altogether, our empirical case study demonstrates the feasibility of predicting user rejection using deployment-specific context, opening the door to targeted guardrails.

title: SMSR: Certified Defence Against Runtime Memory Poisoning in Persistent LLM Agent Systems
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents increasingly run with persistent memory that accumulates across user sessions. This creates a new attack surface: an adversary interacting only through normal channels can inject crafted memories that, once retrieved, steer the agent's responses for future users, without touching model weights or code. We call this Multi-Session Memory Poisoning (MSMP) and show that no existing defence certifies against it; static-corpus defences (RobustRAG, ReliabilityRAG) assume a fixed knowledge base, and heuristic filters are bypassed by fluent enterprise-style text. We present Signed Memory with Smoothed Retrieval (SMSR), the first defence with a certified robustness bound for this setting. Component 1 adds HMAC-SHA256 provenance at write time, blocking unsigned injection. Component 2 applies randomised memory ablation with verdict-based majority voting at query time, bounding the influence of authenticated adversaries. We prove that no provenance-free retrieval-time filter can certify against adaptive injection, derive a hypergeometric certificate for Component 2, and formalise the Consistent Minority Effect, whereby a consistent adversarial answer wins string-based voting as a numerical minority while verdict-based voting removes it. Across 15 enterprise scenarios (3,150 repeated trials), Component 1 cuts attack success from 93-100% to 0% for all unsigned variants. For an authenticated adversary with a single injection, Component 2 holds success to 8.0% (95% CI [5.8, 10.9], n=450), below the certified worst case. In an end-to-end query-only attack where the agent itself writes the poison rather than it being pre-seeded, SMSR reduces success from 65.3% to 5.3% (n=150, non-overlapping CIs) on a live agent stack. Clean-query utility is 90% (Component 1) and 85% (combined).

title: VLADriveBench: Evaluating CoT-Action Relationship in VLA for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning alongside driving trajectories, but existing benchmarks evaluate only trajectory quality and do not assess whether the CoT is relevant, consistent, or causally connected to the driving action. We introduce VLADriveBench, a framework that combines observational metrics (mentioning, hallucination, contradiction, action alignment) with a CoT intervention protocol to provide complementary views of the CoT-action relationship. Applying VLADriveBench to three models across two architectures, we find that the two analyses can diverge sharply: ORION scores highest on observational alignment yet its CoT is epiphenomenal, while Alpamayo v1.5 scores lower yet its CoT is strongly causal, with visual salience gating the extent of CoT influence.

AI.title_translation: VLADriveBench：评估自动驾驶VLA模型中思维链与动作的关系
AI.tldr: 本文提出VLADriveBench框架，通过结合观察指标与干预协议，评估自动驾驶VLA模型中思维链（CoT）与动作的因果关系，揭示了表面对齐与实际因果性之间的巨大分歧。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型基准测试仅评估轨迹质量，无法评估模型生成的思维链（CoT）推理是否与驾驶动作相关、一致或存在因果联系。

AI.result: 在两种架构的三个模型上应用该框架后发现：ORION在观察对齐上得分最高，但其CoT与动作并无因果关系（属于副现象）；而Alpamayo v1.5虽然观察得分较低，但其CoT具有强因果性，且视觉显著性控制着CoT的影响程度。
AI.conclusion: VLADriveBench通过结合观察指标和干预协议，能够更深入地揭示VLA模型中CoT与实际动作之间的真实因果关系，表明高观察对齐度并不等同于强因果驱动。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在生成驾驶轨迹的同时生成思维链（CoT）推理，但现有的基准测试仅评估轨迹质量，而未评估CoT是否与驾驶动作相关、一致或具有因果联系。我们引入了VLADriveBench，这是一个将观察性指标（提及、幻觉、矛盾、动作对齐）与CoT干预协议相结合的框架，以提供CoT与动作关系的互补视角。将VLADriveBench应用于两种架构的三个模型中，我们发现这两种分析可能会产生急剧的分歧：ORION在观察对齐上得分最高，但其CoT是副现象（无因果关系），而Alpamayo v1.5得分较低，但其CoT具有强因果性，且视觉显著性控制着CoT的影响程度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VLADriveBench，这是一个用于评估自动驾驶中VLA模型思维链（CoT）与驾驶动作关系的基准测试框架。该框架结合了观察性指标与干预协议，揭示了模型生成的CoT与实际动作之间是否存在真正的因果联系，并发现现有模型在观察对齐度与因果性上存在显著分歧。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 思维链, 评估基准, 因果关系
AI.comments: 该论文填补了自动驾驶VLA模型评估中的一个重要空白。过去的研究往往默认模型生成的CoT（思维链）能有效指导其动作，但本文通过干预协议证明了这种“因果关系”在某些高分模型中可能只是副现象（表象）。这一发现对于未来构建真正可解释、安全可靠的自动驾驶系统具有重要的警示和指导意义。

title: Storage and Transport Capacity Design for a Self-Reliable Two-Node Stochastic Resource System
summary: We study a two-node stochastic resource system operating over a finite horizon. Each node experiences uncertain supply and demand and is equipped with finite storage. The objective is to ensure that resource levels remain within prescribed limits with high probability. To this end, we formulate a chance-constrained capacity-design problem in which resources can be exchanged through a capacity-limited transport link. We characterize the minimum storage required at each node, derive the optimal transport policy, and quantify the trade-off between storage and transport capacities. Our results show the existence of a critical transport-capacity threshold that enables full risk pooling between the nodes. Moreover, this threshold decreases with the operating horizon, implying that full-pooling performance can be achieved with progressively smaller transport capacity over longer horizons.

AI.title_translation: 自给自足的双节点随机资源系统的存储与传输容量设计
AI.tldr: 本文研究了双节点随机资源系统的容量设计，推导了最优传输策略并量化了存储与传输的权衡，发现存在一个随时间周期延长而降低的临界传输容量阈值，可实现完全风险分摊。
AI.motivation: 在面临不确定供需的有限时间双节点随机资源系统中，如何确保资源水平以高概率保持在规定限制内，并通过优化存储和传输容量的设计来降低系统风险。
AI.method: 构建了一个机会约束容量设计模型（chance-constrained capacity-design problem），允许资源通过容量受限的传输链路在两个节点间进行交换。基于该模型，刻画了各节点的最少存储需求，推导了最优传输策略，并对存储与传输容量之间的权衡关系进行了定量分析。
AI.result: 研究表明存在一个临界传输容量阈值，达到该阈值即可实现节点间的完全风险分摊。此外，该临界阈值会随着运行周期的延长而降低，这意味着在更长的时间跨度内，使用更小的传输容量即可达到完全风险分摊的效果。
AI.conclusion: 存储与传输容量之间存在明确的权衡关系。通过合理设计临界传输容量，可以在较长运行周期内利用更小的传输能力实现双节点系统的完全风险分摊，从而确保系统的自给自足与高可靠性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一个在有限时间内运行的双节点随机资源系统。每个节点都面临着不确定的供应和需求，并配备了有限的存储空间。其目标是确保资源水平以高概率保持在规定的限制范围内。为此，我们构建了一个机会约束的容量设计问题，其中资源可以通过容量受限的传输链路进行交换。我们刻画了每个节点所需的最少存储容量，推导了最优传输策略，并量化了存储与传输容量之间的权衡关系。我们的结果表明，存在一个临界传输容量阈值，能够实现节点之间的完全风险分摊。此外，该阈值随着运行周期的增加而降低，这意味着在更长的运行周期内，可以通过逐渐减小的传输容量来实现完全分摊性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对具有不确定供需的双节点随机资源系统，研究了有限时间内的存储与传输容量设计问题。通过建立机会约束优化模型，推导了最优传输策略，量化了存储与传输容量的折中，并揭示了实现完全风险分摊的临界传输容量阈值及其随时间周期变长而降低的规律。
AI.keywords: 随机资源系统, 容量设计, 机会约束, 风险分摊, 存储与传输折中
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将机会约束引入双节点随机资源系统的容量设计中，并定量刻画了存储与传输容量之间的折中关系，特别是发现了临界传输容量阈值随时间周期延长而降低的有趣规律。这对于能源网络、物流系统等实际基础设施的规划具有重要的理论与应用价值。局限性在于目前的研究仅局限于双节点系统，向多节点通用网络拓扑的推广可能面临更高的计算和分析复杂度。

title: AfriSUD: A Dependency Treebank Collection for Evaluating Models on African Languages
summary: Despite their linguistic diversity and global significance, African languages remain underrepresented in research and resources to support NLP. We aim to bridge this gap by introducing AfriSUD, the first large-scale collection of syntactically annotated treebanks for nine diverse African languages spanning major language families and regions across Sub-Saharan Africa. Using the Surface-Syntactic Universal Dependencies (SUD) framework, our community-led effort provides high-quality, native-speaker verified data that capture typological key features such as agglutination and tone. We evaluate a range of models on AfriSUD for part-of-speech tagging and dependency parsing including non-transformer baselines, multilingual pretrained encoders, and LLMs. Our results reveal a significant syntax gap, where models still show clear limitations across the nine languages, suggesting that existing architectures may not fully capture the structural diversity of African-language syntax.

AI.title_translation: AfriSUD：一个用于评估非洲语言模型的依存树库集合
AI.tldr: 本文推出了首个针对九种非洲语言的大规模句法标注树库集合 AfriSUD，评估表明现有主流模型在处理这些语言的句法结构时仍存在显著的局限性。
AI.motivation: 尽管非洲语言具有高度的语言多样性和全球重要性，但在NLP的研究和资源中仍然严重代表性不足。
AI.method: 引入了首个针对九种非洲语言的大规模句法标注树库集合 AfriSUD，该集合采用表层句法通用依存（SUD）框架构建，由社区主导并经母语者验证，保留了粘着和声调等类型学特征。并在此基础上评估了非Transformer基线、多语言预训练编码器以及大语言模型（LLM）在词性标注和依存句法分析上的表现。
AI.result: 评估结果揭示了显著的“句法差距”，即各类模型在九种非洲语言上的表现仍存在明显的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型架构可能无法完全捕获非洲语言句法的结构多样性，在处理这些语言时存在明显的局限性。
AI.translation: 尽管非洲语言具有语言多样性和全球重要性，但在支持自然语言处理（NLP）的研究和资源中仍然代表性不足。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了 AfriSUD，这是针对撒哈拉以南非洲地区主要语系和区域的九种不同非洲语言的首个大规模句法标注树库集合。通过使用表层句法通用依存（SUD）框架，我们这一社区主导的努力提供了高质量、经母语者验证的数据，这些数据捕捉了诸如粘着和声调等关键的类型学特征。我们在 AfriSUD 上评估了一系列模型在词性标注和依存句法分析方面的表现，包括非Transformer基线、多语言预训练编码器和大型语言模型（LLMs）。我们的结果揭示了显著的句法差距，模型在九种语言中仍然显示出明显的局限性，这表明现有的架构可能无法完全捕捉非洲语言句法的结构多样性。
AI.summary: 本文推出了首个针对九种非洲语言的大规模句法标注树库集合 AfriSUD，旨在解决非洲语言在NLP资源中的匮乏问题。该数据集基于SUD框架构建，由社区主导并经母语者验证，保留了粘着和声调等类型学特征。研究人员在 AfriSUD 上对多种模型进行评估，结果表明，现有模型在词性标注和依存句法分析中存在明显的“句法差距”，无法充分捕捉非洲语言独特的句法结构。
AI.keywords: 非洲语言, 依存树库, 句法分析, 词性标注, 模型评估
AI.comments: 该研究填补了非洲语言句法资源的空白，对于推动低资源语言和多语言NLP的发展具有重要意义。通过使用SUD框架并由母语者验证，保证了数据的质量。然而，研究结果揭示了当前主流模型在非印欧语系语言句法处理上的严重不足，这表明未来的工作需要探索更能适应结构多样性语言的全新模型架构。

title: Smarter Saboteurs, Better Fixers: Scaling & Security in Linear Multi-Agent Workflows
comments: 16 pages (4 are main text), 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the AIWILD Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: As LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) are deployed in the wild, the resilience of their collaboration structures against adversarial compromise becomes a critical safety concern. Attackers may leverage prompt-injection or jailbreaking to sabotage individual agents within MAS workflows, but the interaction between model scaling and system-level resilience remains poorly understood. This paper investigates how model scale affects the security of linear multi-agent workflows. Our experiments across scales of two open-weight model families on the HumanEval benchmark reveal a compliance-correction symmetry: larger models are far more likely to faithfully execute malicious instructions, with the control-to-malicious performance drop reaching 53.7pp at 27B in uncorrected pipelines. However, appending a lightweight terminal Fixer stage collapses this to 0.6pp and restores statistical parity with control-level performance, demonstrating that strictly linear collaboration structures can be viable and resilient to adversaries at this scale, and suggesting that the brittleness previously attributed to linear topology may stem from a lack of correction.
comment: 16 pages (4 are main text), 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the AIWILD Workshop at ICML 2026

AI.title_translation: 更聪明的破坏者，更出色的修复者：线性多智能体工作流中的规模化与安全性
AI.tldr: 研究表明大模型更容易执行恶意攻击指令，但通过在线性多智能体工作流末端添加轻量级修复（Fixer）阶段，可将性能损失从53.7%降至0.6%，显著提升系统韧性。
AI.motivation: 随着基于大语言模型的多智能体系统广泛部署，其协作结构抵御对抗性破坏（如提示词注入、越狱）的安全韧性变得至关重要，但模型规模与系统级韧性之间的相互作用尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 在HumanEval基准上，针对两个开源模型系列的不同参数规模（最高达27B）进行实验。研究了在面对提示词注入或越狱攻击时，未纠正的线性管道与添加了轻量级末端修复（Fixer）阶段的管道在性能和韧性上的差异。
AI.result: 实验发现了“顺从-纠正对称性”：更大规模的模型更倾向于顺从并执行恶意指令，在27B规模下，未纠正管道的性能下降高达53.7个百分点。然而，通过添加一个轻量级的末端修复（Fixer）阶段，该性能损失骤降至0.6个百分点，并恢复了与控制组水平的统计学对等。
AI.conclusion: 在适当的规模下，严格的线性协作结构通过引入纠错机制是完全可行且具备对抗韧性的。此前文献中归因于线性拓扑结构本身的脆弱性，实际上可能只是因为缺乏纠正阶段。
AI.translation: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）在实际场景中的部署，其协作结构抵御对抗性破坏的韧性已成为一个关键的安全问题。攻击者可能会利用提示词注入或越狱来破坏MAS工作流中的单个智能体，但模型规模化与系统级韧性之间的相互作用仍未得到充分理解。本文研究了模型规模如何影响线性多智能体工作流的安全性。我们在HumanEval基准上对两个开源模型系列的多种规模进行了实验，结果揭示了一种“顺从-纠正对称性”：更大的模型更容易忠实地执行恶意指令，在未纠正的管道中，27B模型的控制组与恶意组性能差距达到了53.7个百分点（pp）。然而，附加一个轻量级的末端修复（Fixer）阶段可将这一差距缩小至0.6个百分点，并恢复与控制组水平的统计学对等。这表明，在这一规模下，严格的线性协作结构是可行且能抵御对手的，同时也表明此前归因于线性拓扑的脆弱性可能源于缺乏纠正机制。
AI.summary: 本文研究了模型规模对线性多智能体工作流安全性的影响。实验表明，虽然大模型更容易顺从并执行恶意攻击指令导致系统性能崩溃，但通过在线性工作流末端引入一个轻量级的修复（Fixer）阶段，可以几乎完全抵消攻击带来的负面影响，证明了线性协作结构在配备纠错机制时具有极强的安全韧性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 线性工作流, 模型规模化, 对抗韧性, 提示词注入
AI.comments: 本文深入探讨了多智能体系统（MAS）在对抗性攻击下的安全韧性，特别是模型规模对攻击顺从性以及纠错能力的影响。其创新之处在于揭示了“顺从-纠正对称性”，并通过引入一个简单且极轻量级的“末端修复者（Fixer）”阶段，成功将性能损失降到几乎可以忽略不计的程度。这一发现重新评估了线性拓扑结构的实用价值，证明其脆性并非源于结构本身，而是缺乏纠错机制。局限性在于实验主要基于HumanEval代码生成基准，在更广泛、非代码类的多智能体任务中的泛化性仍需进一步验证。

title: A Stabilized Path-Space Approach to Diffusion-Based Posterior Sampling
summary: Diffusion models provide expressive data-driven priors for Bayesian inverse problems, but many diffusion posterior samplers rely on heuristic guidance approximations that can fail for nonlinear operators and multimodal posteriors. In this work, we develop a stabilized path-space framework for diffusion-based posterior sampling. Starting from a base diffusion process whose terminal marginal represents the prior, we define a likelihood-weighted target measure on trajectories and cast posterior sampling as learning a controlled stochastic process whose path measure matches this target. This formulation connects diffusion posterior sampling to stochastic optimal control while preserving the Bayesian structure needed for uncertainty quantification. We introduce a time reparameterization that makes the path-space control problem well posed by removing the bias induced by the unknown initial value function, without auxiliary training. We then learn the control via a trust-region path-space optimization method with log-variance objectives. The path-space perspective also unifies our learned control approach with existing guidance-based samplers, quantifies the sampling error induced by approximate controls, and yields importance sampling corrections for asymptotically exact posterior expectations. We evaluate the proposed framework on a suite of benchmark inverse problems with analytically characterized or high-quality reference posteriors, enabling principled assessment of sampling accuracy and uncertainty quantification. These experiments provide insight into the behavior of diffusion-based posterior samplers and demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over leading approaches.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于基于扩散的后验采样的稳定路径空间方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种稳定的路径空间框架，通过将扩散后验采样转化为随机最优控制问题，并引入时间重参数化与信赖域优化，有效解决了非线性及多峰后验采样中的失效问题，显著提升了采样精度和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散后验采样器大多依赖启发式的引导近似，在处理非线性算子和多峰后验分布时容易失效，且难以进行准确的不确定性量化。
AI.method: 1. 将后验采样转化为学习一个受控随机过程，使其路径测度匹配轨迹上的似然加权目标测度；2. 引入时间重参数化，消除由未知初始值函数引起的偏差，使路径空间控制问题在无需辅助训练的情况下适定；3. 采用带有对数方差目标的信赖域路径空间优化方法来学习控制变量；4. 引入重要性采样修正以获得渐近精确的后验期望。
AI.result: 在多项具有解析解或高质量参考后验的基准逆问题上，该框架能够进行原则性的采样精度和不确定性量化评估，实验结果表明其在准确性和鲁棒性上均优于现有的主流方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的稳定路径空间框架不仅在理论上将扩散后验采样与随机最优控制相统一，而且在实际应用中显著提升了非线性及多峰后验逆问题下的采样准确性和鲁棒性，为不确定性量化提供了原则性的评估方法。
AI.translation: 扩散模型为贝叶斯逆问题提供了富有表现力的自适应先验，但许多扩散后验采样器依赖于启发式的引导近似，这些近似在面对非线性算子和多峰后验时可能会失效。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种用于基于扩散的后验采样的稳定路径空间框架。从终端边缘分布代表先验的基扩散过程开始，我们在轨迹上定义了一个似然加权的目标测度，并将后验采样建模为学习一个路径测度与该目标相匹配的受控随机过程。这种表述将扩散后验采样与随机最优控制联系起来，同时保留了不确定性量化所需的贝叶斯结构。我们引入了一种时间重参数化方法，通过消除由未知的初始值函数引起的偏差，使路径空间控制问题在没有辅助训练的情况下变得适定。然后，我们通过带有对数方差目标的信赖域路径空间优化方法来学习控制。路径空间的视角还将我们的学习控制方法与现有的基于引导的采样器统一起来，量化了由近似控制引起的采样误差，并为渐近精确的后验期望提供了重要性采样修正。我们在具有解析特征或高质量参考后验的一系列基准逆问题上评估了所提出的框架，从而能够对采样精度和不确定性量化进行原则性评估。这些实验深入揭示了基于扩散的后验采样器的行为，并展示了相比于主流方法更高的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于扩散模型后验采样的稳定路径空间框架。该方法将后验采样重新表述为随机最优控制问题，通过引入时间重参数化消除了未知初始值函数带来的偏差，并利用信赖域路径空间优化方法学习控制。该框架不仅统一了现有的引导采样方法，还能提供重要性采样修正以实现渐近精确的后验估计，在非线性和多峰后验的逆问题中展现出更高的精度和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 后验采样, 路径空间, 随机最优控制, 逆问题
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种从随机最优控制和路径空间视角出发的扩散后验采样框架，理论构建非常优雅。其核心创新点在于通过时间重参数化巧妙地解决了无需辅助训练时未知初始值函数带来的偏差问题，并且通过重要性采样修正实现了渐近精确的后验估计，这为解决非线性逆问题和多峰后验分布提供了坚实的理论基础和更强的鲁棒性。

title: Definitional alignment before capability alignment: a Design-Science framework for adjudicating claims about AGI
summary: Claims that artificial general intelligence has already arrived and claims that it remains decades away are often defended from overlapping evidence. "AGI" lacks a single shared and stable referent and competing operationalizations can return different verdicts on the same system. This article treats that under-specification as a design and governance problem. Following Design Science Research Methodology, it develops DAF-AGI, a second-order conceptual artifact with two coupled components: five ordinal criteria for assessing the adjudicative fitness of candidate definitions and a structured governance audit of authorship, interest, certification, external verification and revision authority. The artifact is demonstrated on five prominent measurement families and one deflationary boundary position in a documented corpus and then stress-tested against a stylized strong arrival claim: that current generative systems constitute AGI because they outperform a well-educated adult on many cognitive tasks. On evidence from the cited 2024-2025 sources, the claim was certifiable only under a performance-based operationalization; capability-ontology, psychometric and skill-acquisition approaches did not certify it, the economic family remains indeterminate and the deflationary position refuses binary adjudication. The contribution is a novel integration and operationalization, not an empirical validation: independent application, inter-rater testing and author-external cases remain necessary. The paper further proposes definitional sovereignty as an enabling component of algorithmic sovereignty: the institutional capacity to contest, certify and revise imported technological categories under public accountability.

AI.title_translation: 能力对齐之前的定义对齐：一个用于裁定通用人工智能（AGI）主张的设计科学框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了DAF-AGI框架，通过设计科学方法解决AGI定义不明确、评估标准不一的问题，强调在评估AGI是否实现时，必须先进行“定义对齐”，并提出了“定义主权”的概念。
AI.motivation: 目前关于“AGI是否已经到来”的争论缺乏统一且稳定的参考标准，竞争性的操作化定义对同一个系统会得出不同的裁定。这种定义的模糊性和规范不足为AI的设计与治理带来了挑战，因此需要“定义对齐”来先于“能力对齐”。
AI.method: 遵循设计科学研究方法（DSRM），开发了名为“DAF-AGI”的二阶概念工具。该工具包含两个耦合部分：一是用于评估候选定义裁定适用性的五个序数标准，二是针对作者身份、利益、认证、外部验证和修订权限的结构化治理审计。
AI.result: 在五个主要测量体系和一个收缩性边界立场上对框架进行了论证，并针对“当前生成式系统已构成AGI”的主张进行了压力测试。结果表明，该主张仅在“基于性能”的运作化下可被认证；而“能力本体”、“心理测量”和“技能获取”方法均未予以认证，经济体系仍不确定，收缩性立场则拒绝二元判定。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出“定义主权”（definitional sovereignty）是“算法主权”的赋能组成部分，即机构在公共问责下质疑、认证和修订引入的技术类别的制度能力。同时指出，本研究的贡献在于新颖的整合和运作化，未来仍需进行独立的外部应用和评判者间测试。
AI.translation: 关于通用人工智能（AGI）已经到来与仍需数十年的主张，往往是基于重叠的证据进行辩护的。“AGI”缺乏单一、共享且稳定的指代，竞争性的操作化定义可能会对同一个系统得出不同的裁定。本文将这种规范不足视为一个设计与治理问题。遵循设计科学研究方法，本文开发了DAF-AGI，这是一个具有两个耦合组件的二阶概念人工制品：用于评估候选定义裁定适用性的五个序数标准，以及对作者身份、利益、认证、外部验证和修订权限的结构化治理审计。该人工制品在记录语料库中的五个杰出测量家族和一个紧缩边界立场上进行了演示，然后针对一个典型的强到达主张进行了压力测试：即当前的生成式系统构成了AGI，因为它们在许多认知任务上超越了受过良好教育的成年人。根据所引用的2024-2025年来源的证据，该主张仅在基于性能的操作化下是可认证的；能力本体、心理测量和技能获取方法并未予以认证，经济家族仍处于未定状态，而紧缩立场拒绝二元裁定。本文的贡献在于一种新颖的整合与操作化，而非实证验证：独立的实际应用、评分者间测试以及作者外部的案例仍然是必要的。本文进一步提出，定义主权是算法主权的一个赋能要素：即在公共问责下，对引入的技术类别进行质疑、认证和修订的制度能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对AGI概念缺乏统一标准、导致评估结论冲突的问题，提出了一种基于设计科学研究方法的治理框架——DAF-AGI。该框架通过五个序数标准和结构化治理审计来评估不同的AGI定义。通过对“当前生成式系统已达AGI”这一主张进行压力测试，展示了该框架在澄清概念冲突中的作用，并强调了在公共问责下建立“定义主权”对实现算法主权的重要性。
AI.keywords: 通用人工智能 (AGI), 设计科学, 定义对齐, 算法治理, 定义主权
AI.comments: 本文切中当前AI治理与评估的痛点，即在争论AGI是否到来之前，必须先明确“什么是AGI”的定义标准（定义对齐）。其创新性在于将哲学和概念定义问题转化为设计科学和治理问题，提出了DAF-AGI框架。局限性在于该框架目前主要是一个概念整合与运作化工具，尚未进行大规模的实证验证，其在实际政策制定和行业标准中的可操作性和客观接受度仍有待观察。

title: The three dimensional Neumann Green's function for general surfaces: singular asymptotics and boundary integral methods
summary: We present an asymptotic analysis and high-order boundary integral method for the three-dimensional Neumann Green's function in general geometries. The Neumann Green's function is a fundamental quantity which arises in numerous fields of science and engineering. In the application of singular perturbation methods to strongly localized reactions and diffusive transport, the Green's function plays the key role in mediating global dynamics. However, this essential quantity can only be determined in closed form for a limited set of geometries. The Green's function for the Laplacian is an elliptic problem with a Dirac forcing term. Accurate resolution of the solution requires a careful decomposition into a singular and a regular part. The bulk scenario is where the source is placed off surface and the singularity is given by the free-space function. In the surface case, where the source is placed at a curved point on the boundary, we use asymptotic analysis to determine a three-term singularity structure. With explicit knowledge of these singularities, we develop a high-order boundary integral method for the determination of the remaining regular part. To resolve the singular boundary data, our integral method uses a custom discretization with Duffy patches near the source. We validate our method using several test cases in which closed form solutions can be developed, including spheres, prolate spheroids and constructed domains. We demonstrate the applicability of our method to address some open problems in narrow capture theory.

AI.title_translation: 一般曲面的三维诺伊曼格林函数：奇异渐近性与边界积分方法
AI.tldr: 本文通过渐近分析推导出了三维弯曲边界上诺伊曼格林函数的三项奇异性结构，并结合高阶边界积分法与Duffy补丁离散化，实现了一般几何体中该函数的高精度数值计算。
AI.motivation: 诺伊曼格林函数是科学和工程领域（如强局部反应和扩散输运的奇异扰动分析）中调解全局动力学的关键物理量。然而，除了少数简单几何形状外，该函数极难获得闭式解。在拉普拉斯算子格林函数的求解中，当源点位于曲面边界上时，会产生复杂的奇异性，如何对其进行精确分解并实现高精度数值求解是一个亟待解决的挑战。
AI.method:
1. **奇异性渐近分析**：针对源点位于弯曲边界曲面上的情况，利用渐近分析确定了其“三项奇异性结构”（three-term singularity structure），实现了奇异部分与正则部分的精确分解。
2. **高阶边界积分法**：在显式已知奇异项的基础上，开发了一种高阶边界积分方法来求解剩余的正则部分。
3. **定制离散化（Duffy补丁）**：在积分方法中，在源点附近采用定制的Duffy补丁（Duffy patches）进行离散化，以高精度解析奇异边界数据。
AI.result:
1. 在球体、拉长椭球体以及人工构建的具有闭式解的区域等多个测试案例中，验证了该方法的准确性与高精度。
2. 成功将该方法应用于狭窄捕获理论（narrow capture theory）中，展示了其解决该领域一些开放性问题的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功开发了一种结合渐近分析和边界积分方法的高精度数值框架，能够有效计算一般三维几何体中的诺伊曼格林函数，并展示了其在解决狭窄捕获理论中开放性问题上的强大适用性。
AI.translation: 我们针对一般几何体中的三维诺伊曼格林函数，提出了一种渐近分析和高阶边界积分方法。诺伊曼格林函数是科学和工程众多领域中出现的一个基本量。在将奇异扰动方法应用于强局部反应和扩散输运时，格林函数在介导全局动力学方面起着关键作用。然而，这一重要物理量仅能在有限的几何形状中确定闭式解。拉普拉斯算子的格林函数是一个带有狄拉克强迫项的椭圆问题。对该解的精确求解需要将其仔细分解为奇异部分和正则部分。体场景（bulk scenario）是指源置于曲面之外，其奇异性由自由空间函数给出。在面场景中，源置于边界上的弯曲点处，我们使用渐近分析来确定一个三项奇异性结构。在显式掌握这些奇异性的基础上，我们开发了一种高阶边界积分方法来确定剩余的正则部分。为了解决奇异边界数据，我们的积分方法在源附近采用了定制的Duffy补丁离散化。我们使用几个可以构建闭式解的测试案例（包括球体、拉长椭球体和构建区域）验证了我们的方法。我们展示了该方法在解决狭窄捕获理论中一些开放性问题上的适用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于计算一般三维几何体中诺伊曼格林函数的新型数值方法。针对源点位于弯曲边界上的复杂情况，作者首先通过渐近分析推导出了三项奇异性结构，从而实现了格林函数的奇异与正则部分分解。接着，结合高阶边界积分方法并在源点附近应用定制的Duffy补丁离散化，实现了对正则部分的高精度求解。该方法在多种标准几何体上得到了验证，并被成功应用于解决狭窄捕获理论中的关键问题。
AI.keywords: 诺伊曼格林函数, 渐近分析, 边界积分方法, 奇异性分解, 狭窄捕获理论
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将渐近分析与边界积分法（BIM）有机结合，首次显式推导出了三维弯曲边界上诺伊曼格林函数的“三项奇异性结构”，这为克服边界源点带来的强奇异性计算瓶颈提供了创新的数学途径。其重要性在于，该方法不仅提高了格林函数的计算精度，还为狭窄捕获理论（narrow capture theory）等涉及强局部反应和输运的复杂应用提供了强有力的数值工具。局限性在于，摘要中未提及该方法对非光滑边界（如带尖角或裂纹的几何体）的适用性及高阶离散化在大规模计算中的时间复杂度。

title: Does AI Reviewer See the Full Picture? Attacking and Defending Multimodal Peer Review
comments: Accepted to ICML 2026, Project Page: https://paper-guard.github.io/
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) into scientific peer-review workflows introduces novel and significant risks for adversarial manipulation, especially given the multimodal nature of scientific papers where figures, not just text, convey core evidence. This creates a significant gap: current robustness studies on AI peer-review are overwhelmingly text-only. Moreover, the problem is distinct from standard jailbreaking, as a peer-review attack seeks to induce a domain-specific, targeted failure (e.g., "inflate this score") rather than a general safety policy violation, for which no practical defenses exist. To address this, we introduce PaperGuard, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to systematically evaluate and defend AI-generated peer-review against these domain-specific, cross-modal attacks. Our framework is built on three pillars: (1) a new multimodal peer-review dataset spanning multiple scientific domains; (2) a unified suite of attacks, including black-box prompt injections and white-box perturbations, specifically designed to target both text (GCG) and figures (PGD); and (3) a practical defense, motivated by the long-context challenge of academic papers, that uses chunk-based embedding search to efficiently localize and mitigate harmful instructions. Our extensive experiments, conducted across state-of-the-art models, confirm that AI reviewers are pervasively vulnerable. PaperGuard establishes the foundational benchmark, protocols, and actionable defense necessary to pioneer trustworthy, attack-resilient AI-assisted scholarly reviewing.
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026, Project Page: https://paper-guard.github.io/

AI.title_translation: AI审稿人是否看到了全貌？攻击与防御多模态同行评审
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个多模态AI同行评审安全基准框架PaperGuard，揭示了AI审稿人易受跨模态靶向攻击的脆弱性，并提供了一种高效的防御机制。
AI.motivation: 将LLM和多模态LLM引入科学同行评审带来了对抗性操纵的风险，尤其是图表等非文本要素极易成为攻击媒介。现有的AI评审鲁棒性研究大多局限于纯文本，且此类攻击属于特定领域的靶向攻击（如“虚高分数”），有别于通用的越狱攻击，目前缺乏有效的防御手段。
AI.method:
提出PaperGuard框架，包含三个核心支柱：
1. 构建了一个涵盖多个科学领域的全新多模态同行评审数据集；
2. 设计了一套统一的攻击套件，包括针对文本的黑盒提示词注入（GCG）和针对图表的白盒扰动（PGD）；
3. 提出了一种基于分块（chunk-based）嵌入搜索的实用防御方法，用于在长文本上下文中高效定位并消除有害指令。
AI.result: 在最先进的多模态大模型上进行的广泛实验表明，AI审稿人普遍存在严重的易受攻击性。
AI.conclusion: PaperGuard为构建可信、抗攻击的AI辅助学术评审系统奠定了基础基准、测试协议和切实可行的防御方案。
AI.translation: 将大型语言模型（LLMs）和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）整合到科学同行评审流程中，引入了对抗性操纵的新型且重大的风险，尤其是考虑到科学论文的多模态性质——不仅是文本，图表也传达了核心证据。这造成了一个显著的空白：目前关于AI同行评审鲁棒性的研究绝大多数仅限于纯文本。此外，该问题与标准的越狱（jailbreaking）不同，因为同行评审攻击旨在引发特定领域、有针对性的失败（例如“虚高分数”），而不是通用的安全策略违规，目前对此尚无实用的防御措施。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了 PaperGuard，这是首个旨在系统评估和防御AI生成同行评审免受这些特定领域、跨模态攻击的全面基准。我们的框架建立在三个支柱之上：（1）一个跨越多个科学领域的全新多模态同行评审数据集；（2) 统一的攻击套件，包括专门针对文本（GCG）和图像（PGD）设计的黑盒提示注入和白盒扰动；以及（3）一种实用的防御方法，受学术论文长上下文挑战的启发，该方法使用基于块（chunk-based）的嵌入搜索来高效定位并减轻有害指令。我们在最先进的模型上进行了广泛的实验，证实了AI审稿人普遍容易受到攻击。PaperGuard 建立了开创可信、抗攻击的AI辅助学术评审所必需的基础基准、协议和可行防御。
AI.summary: 本文针对AI多模态同行评审系统易受对抗性操纵的问题，提出了首个全面的基准和防御框架PaperGuard。该框架通过构建多模态数据集、设计针对文本和图像的跨模态攻击套件，以及开发基于分块嵌入搜索的防御机制，系统性地评估并提升了AI审稿系统的抗攻击能力。
AI.keywords: 多模态同行评审, 对抗性攻击, 学术安全, 基准测试, 跨模态防御
AI.comments: 本文具有极强的前瞻性和现实意义。随着AI在学术评审中的应用日益广泛，其安全性问题至关重要。该研究敏锐地捕捉到了多模态学术论文（文本+图表）在AI评审中面临的独特安全威胁，填补了现有研究仅关注纯文本攻击的空白。其提出的PaperGuard不仅是一个评估基准，还提供了实用的防御机制，对构建可信的AI学术辅助系统具有重要贡献。

title: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detectors for Open-Set RF Fingerprinting
summary: Radio-frequency (RF) fingerprinting systems must operate in open-world environments where signals from unknown transmitters and temporal drift introduce distribution shift at test time. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection provides a natural framework for this problem, yet its application to RF fingerprinting (RFF) remains limited. A key barrier to their adoption is that most OOD detectors require auxiliary OOD data for parameter tuning, an assumption that is difficult to satisfy in RF environments where representative OOD data is impractical to collect. In this work, we introduce a promising set of OOD detection methods from the machine learning literature to open-set RFF domain. We present these methods within a unified mathematical framework based on information theory, which is a natural framework for communication systems. Our framework allows for the systematic analysis of methods and development of new methods. We further demonstrate the applicability of recent work on tuning OOD detectors without given OOD tuning data for open-set RFF. We evaluate on the POWDER RF fingerprinting dataset, showing that detectors tuned without any given OOD data achieve performance comparable to baselines with access to true OOD tuning data and greatly out-perform baseline approaches without access to true OOD tuning data, showcasing the practical viability for the RFF problem.

AI.title_translation: 用于开集射频指纹识别的分布外（OOD）检测器
AI.tldr: 本文将机器学习的OOD检测引入开集射频指纹识别，提出了基于信息论的统一框架，并实现了在无需辅助OOD数据的情况下的高效检测器调优。
AI.motivation: 射频指纹（RFF）系统在实际部署中面临未知发射机和时间漂移带来的分布偏移。虽然分布外（OOD）检测是解决该问题的天然方法，但大多数现有OOD检测器依赖辅助OOD数据进行参数调优，而这在难以收集代表性OOD数据的射频环境中极难实现。
AI.method:
1. 将机器学习领域的OOD检测方法引入开集RFF领域。
2. 提出了一个基于信息论的统一数学框架，用于系统分析和开发新的检测方法。
3. 引入并展示了在无需给定OOD调优数据的情况下，对OOD检测器进行参数调整的技术。
AI.result: 在POWDER射频指纹数据集上的评估表明，在完全不使用给定OOD数据进行调优的情况下，所提检测器的性能可媲美拥有真实OOD调优数据的基线方法，并显著优于无法访问真实OOD数据的传统基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 无需OOD调优数据的检测器在开集射频指纹识别（RFF）中具有极高的实际可行性，而基于信息论的统一框架也为该领域的后续研究奠定了坚实的理论基础。
AI.translation: 射频（RF）指纹识别系统必须在开放世界环境中运行，在测试时，来自未知发射机的信号和时间漂移会引入分布偏移。分布外（OOD）检测为这一问题提供了一个自然的解决框架，然而其在射频指纹识别（RFF）中的应用仍然有限。阻碍其采用的一个关键障碍是，大多数OOD检测器需要辅助OOD数据来进行参数调整，而这一假设在难以收集代表性OOD数据的射频环境中是难以满足的。在这项工作中，我们将机器学习文献中一套很有前景的OOD检测方法引入到开集RFF领域。我们在一个基于信息论的统一数学框架内展示了这些方法，信息论是通信系统的一个自然框架。我们的框架允许对方法进行系统分析并开发新方法。我们进一步展示了最近关于在没有给定OOD调整数据的情况下调整OOD检测器的研究在开集RFF中的适用性。我们在POWDER射频指纹数据集上进行了评估，结果表明，在没有给定任何OOD数据的情况下调整的检测器，其性能可以与能够访问真实OOD调整数据的基线方法相媲美，并且大大优于无法访问真实OOD调整数据的基线方法，展示了其在RFF问题中的实际可行性。
AI.summary: 本文针对开集射频指纹识别（RFF）中难以获取辅助分布外（OOD）数据进行参数调优的难题，引入了机器学习中的OOD检测技术。作者提出了一个基于信息论的统一数学框架来系统分析这些方法，并展示了在无需OOD调优数据的情况下调整检测器的可行性。在POWDER数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在无OOD数据辅助下仍能取得与有辅助数据相当的优异性能，具有极高的实际应用价值。
AI.keywords: 射频指纹识别 (RF Fingerprinting), 分布外检测 (Out-of-Distribution Detection), 开集识别 (Open-Set Recognition), 信息论 (Information Theory)
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：针对射频环境中代表性OOD数据难以收集的痛点，首次将免OOD调优数据的检测器引入开集射频指纹识别领域。
2. 理论价值：利用信息论构建了一个统一的数学框架，为系统性分析现有方法和开发新方法提供了理论基础。
3. 局限性：摘要中仅在POWDER单个射频指纹数据集上进行了评估，在更广泛、更复杂的实际无线电环境中的泛化性能仍需进一步验证。

title: A Multiplexing Design Space: Theory, Method, and Application
summary: Many visualization designs feature phenomena referred to as ``visual multiplexing'', where multiple pieces of information associated with the same data point are conveyed simultaneously. Although visualization designers are able to bring such phenomena, often unconsciously, into their designs, the design space of visual multiplexing is huge, and it is uncommon to explore visual multiplexing systematically as design patterns. In this paper, we propose a design method for exploring a smaller design space constrained by an application. As an illustrative case study, we focus on machine learning (ML) workflows for developing ML models that approximate partial differential equations (PDEs). In these workflows, ML researchers need to analyze the inter-relationships among multiple 2D scalar fields frequently. Since superimposing one heatmap on top of another is not an effective design, we formulate three design steps to explore the design space of visual multiplexing in the context of multiple 2D scalar fields. Our design method also includes a pre-design step for domain grounding and theoretical analysis, and involves domain experts in both co-design and evaluation activities. The design process enables us to identify relatively optimal default multiplexing designs as well as the need for small variations that domain experts can control through a user interface.

AI.title_translation: 多路复用设计空间：理论、方法与应用
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种探索受应用约束的视觉多路复用设计空间的方法，并成功应用于机器学习工作流中多2D标量场的可视化分析。
AI.motivation: 视觉多路复用的设计空间极其庞大，且通常缺乏系统性的设计模式探索。此外，在机器学习工作流中分析多个2D标量场之间的相互关系时，传统的简单热力图叠加效果不佳，需要更有效的可视化设计。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对特定应用约束的视觉多路复用设计方法，包含：1）用于领域落地和理论分析的前期设计步骤；2）在多个2D标量场背景下探索设计空间的三个具体设计步骤；3）让领域专家深度参与的协同设计与评估活动。
AI.result: 通过该设计流程，成功识别出了相对最优的默认多路复用设计，并确定了领域专家可以通过用户界面控制的微小变体需求。
AI.conclusion: 该设计方法能够有效缩小并探索视觉多路复用的设计空间，帮助领域专家在特定应用（如PDE机器学习模型开发）中更好地分析多维数据关系。
AI.translation: 许多可视化设计都具有被称为“视觉多路复用”的现象，即同时传达与同一数据点相关的多条信息。尽管可视化设计师能够（通常是无意识地）将这种现象引入到他们的设计中，但视觉多路复用的设计空间非常庞大，系统地将视觉多路复用作为设计模式进行探索并不常见。在本文中，我们提出了一种设计方法，用于探索受应用约束的较小设计空间。作为一个说明性的案例研究，我们专注于开发近似偏微分方程（PDE）的机器学习（ML）模型的机器学习工作流。在这些工作流中，机器学习研究人员需要频繁分析多个2D标量场之间的相互关系。由于将一个热力图叠加在另一个热力图之上并不是一种有效的设计，我们制定了三个设计步骤来在多个2D标量场的背景下探索视觉多路复用的设计空间。我们的设计方法还包括用于领域落地和理论分析的前期设计步骤，并让领域专家参与共同设计和评估活动。该设计过程使我们能够识别出相对最优的默认多路复用设计，以及领域专家可以通过用户界面控制的微小变体的需求。
AI.summary: 本文针对“视觉多路复用”设计空间过于庞大且缺乏系统探索的问题，提出了一种受应用约束的系统化设计方法。该方法以偏微分方程（PDE）机器学习模型开发中的多2D标量场分析为案例，通过前期理论分析、三步设计法以及领域专家协同设计，成功提炼出了最优的默认设计及交互式变体。
AI.keywords: 视觉多路复用, 设计空间, 机器学习工作流, 2D标量场, 协同设计
AI.comments: 本文针对庞大的“视觉多路复用”设计空间，提出了一种在特定应用约束下进行系统化探索的方法，具有很强的实用价值。通过将该方法应用于机器学习工作流中多2D标量场的可视化，并引入领域专家进行协同设计与评估，证明了其有效性。不过，该方法的通用性以及在非标量场数据上的表现仍有待进一步验证。

title: The Theory of Mind Utility: Formal Specification of a Mentalizing Mechanism
summary: Inferring others' beliefs requires more than reading surface signals; it requires tracking who told them what, in what order, and how credibly. The Theory of Mind Utility (ToM-U) formalizes this epistemic state inference problem at the computational level of analysis, specifying what mentalizing computes and why without commitment to algorithmic or neural implementation. ToM-U achieves this by constructing Local Epistemic World Models (LEWMs) -- directed typed graphs that represent agents, state nodes, and the epistemic relationships among them -- and evaluating discrete candidate LEWMs against observed behavior until one achieves sufficient confidence. Five formal definitions specify the LEWM structure, agent node properties including ordered information access history, a bounded proliferation mechanism for recursive mentalizing, three inference procedures, and a residue function that captures the structured trace left by failed mentalizing attempts. ToM-U differs from Bayesian Theory of Mind and adjacent formal accounts, which presuppose rather than derive belief states, and from simulation theory and theory-theory, which lack a formal apparatus for epistemic state inference. The architecture generates directional, falsifiable predictions about mentalizing failure that follow from structural properties of the model rather than auxiliary assumptions, and positions ToM-U as a domain-agnostic mechanism upstream of goal inference and other downstream social cognitive processes.

AI.title_translation: 心智理论效用：心理化机制的形式化规范
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“心智理论效用”（ToM-U）框架，通过构建局部认识世界模型（LEWMs），在计算层面上首次对信念状态推断进行了形式化规范，并能预测心理化失败。
AI.motivation: 推断他人信念需要追踪信息的来源、顺序和可信度，而不仅是读取表面信号。现有的贝叶斯心智理论等框架往往预设而非推导信念状态，而模拟理论和理论-理论则缺乏认识状态推断的形式化工具。因此，需要一个在计算层面上明确规范心理化计算内容与原因的形式化机制。
AI.method: 提出“心智理论效用”（ToM-U）框架。该框架在计算层面上运行，通过构建“局部认识世界模型”（LEWMs，即表示主体、状态节点及其认识关系的定向类型图）并对照观察到的行为评估候选模型来实现信念推断。它包含五个形式化定义，规定了LEWM结构、主体节点属性（包括有序信息获取历史）、递归心理化的有界增殖机制、三种推理程序，以及捕获失败心理化尝试残留痕迹的残留函数。
AI.result: ToM-U 能够根据模型的结构特征（而非辅助假设）产生关于心理化失败的方向性、可证伪的预测，并成功将自身定位为处于目标推断等其他下游社会认知过程上游的、与领域无关的通用机制。
AI.conclusion: ToM-U 成功为认识状态推断提供了一个形式化的计算框架，不仅区别于预设信念状态的贝叶斯心智理论及缺乏形式化工具的传统理论，还为预测心理化失败和理解下游社会认知过程奠定了领域通用的基础。
AI.translation: 推断他人的信念不仅需要读取表面信号，还需要追踪谁在何时向他们传递了什么信息，以及这些信息的可靠性。心智理论效用（ToM-U）在计算分析层面上对这一认识状态推断问题进行了形式化，规定了心理化计算的内容和原因，而不受算法或神经实现的束缚。ToM-U 通过构建局部认识世界模型（LEWMs）来实现这一点——LEWMs 是表示主体、状态节点以及它们之间认识关系的定向类型图——并对照观察到的行为评估离散的候选 LEWMs，直到其中一个达到足够的置信度。五个形式化定义规定了 LEWM 的结构、包括有序信息获取历史在内的主体节点属性、用于递归心理化的有界增殖机制、三种推理程序，以及一个捕获失败心理化尝试所留下的结构化痕迹的残留函数。ToM-U 区别于贝叶斯心智理论及邻近的正式解释（后者预设而非推导信念状态），也区别于缺乏认识状态推断形式化工具的模拟理论和理论-理论。该架构产生关于心理化失败的方向性、可证伪的预测，这些预测源于模型的结构属性而非辅助假设，并将 ToM-U 定位为处于目标推断和其他下游社会认知过程上游的领域通用机制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“心智理论效用”（ToM-U），这是一种在计算层面上对心理化机制进行形式化规范的理论。通过构建“局部认识世界模型”（LEWMs）这一定向类型图，ToM-U 能够推断主体的认识状态，克服了现有理论预设信念状态或缺乏形式化工具的缺陷，并能对心理化失败做出可证伪的预测。
AI.keywords: 心智理论, 心理化机制, 认识状态推断, 局部认识世界模型, 计算理论
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：提出了“心智理论效用”（ToM-U）框架，通过构建“局部认识世界模型”（LEWMs）在计算层面上对心理化机制进行了形式化规范，能够推导而非预设信念状态，填补了现有理论的空白。
2. 重要性：该模型不仅能精确描述信念推断的过程，还能基于结构属性对心理化失败做出方向性、可证伪的预测，为下游社会认知过程（如目标推断）提供了通用的上游机制。
3. 局限性：摘要中明确指出该理论目前仅在计算层面上进行分析，不涉及具体的算法或神经实现，其在实际计算应用中的效率和可行性仍需进一步验证。

title: EquiDexFlow: Contact-Grounded SE(3)-Equivariant Dexterous Grasp Generative Flows
comments: 22 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Project page with videos, code, and checkpoints: https://equidexflow.github.io
summary: Most learned dexterous grasp generators relegate contact forces to a downstream verification step, so a kinematically-plausible pose can still violate the conditions for a stable physical grasp. We address this with EquiDexFlow, an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching model that jointly predicts wrist pose, joint angles, fingertip contacts, surface normals, and contact forces from an object point cloud. Our architecture projects contacts onto the object surface and forces into the Coulomb friction cone by construction, so placement and friction compliance hold without loss penalties. We prove end-to-end SE(3) equivariance and verify it empirically over 200 rotations, with wrist residuals below $0.04^\circ$ and exactly zero joint deviation. Trained on 8,100 force-closure grasps across 81 objects for the 16-DoF Allegro Hand, our model achieves zero friction violations, the best composite score, and the lowest wrench residual among all ablation variants. We retarget decoded fingertip contacts to a 16-DoF LEAP Hand via per-finger inverse kinematics, and our hardware-feasible refinement places every joint at least 5% inside its actuator envelope while preserving wrench balance. On the physical robot, retargeted EquiDexFlow-decoded grasps complete open-loop pick-and-hold trials on all six test objects, with every asymmetric object succeeding at both the canonical pose and a $120^\circ$ co-rotation. Videos, code, and checkpoints are available at https://equidexflow.github.io.
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Project page with videos, code, and checkpoints: https://equidexflow.github.io

AI.title_translation: EquiDexFlow：基于接触约束的 SE(3) 等变灵巧抓取生成流
AI.tldr: EquiDexFlow 是一种 SE(3) 等变流匹配模型，它通过将几何和物理约束直接融入网络设计，联合预测手腕姿态与符合摩擦锥约束的接触力，实现了零摩擦违规的稳定灵巧抓取，并在真实机器人上成功运行。
AI.motivation: 现有的灵巧抓取生成器大多将接触力预测放在下游验证步骤，导致生成的运动学可行姿态仍可能由于违反物理规律（如摩擦力约束）而无法实现稳定抓取。为了解决这一问题，需要一种能够联合预测姿态与符合物理约束的接触力的生成模型。
AI.method: 提出 EquiDexFlow，一种 SE(3) 等变流匹配模型。该模型从物体点云出发，联合预测手腕姿态、关节角、指尖接触点、表面法线和接触力。其架构设计通过将接触点投影到物体表面、将力投影到库仑摩擦锥内，从而在无需损失惩罚的情况下天然满足位置和摩擦约束。此外，还通过单指逆运动学将接触点重定向到 LEAP 机械手。
AI.result:
1. 经验验证了端到端 SE(3) 等变性，手腕残差低于 0.04°，关节偏差为零；
2. 实现了零摩擦力违规，并在所有消融变体中获得了最佳综合得分和最低的力矩残差；
3. 成功将接触重定向至 16 自由度的 LEAP 手，并在真实机器人上完成了所有 6 个测试物体的开环抓取与保持实验，非对称物体在标准和 120° 旋转姿态下均抓取成功。
AI.conclusion: EquiDexFlow 证明了通过在生成模型中显式融入几何与物理约束（如库仑摩擦锥和表面投影），可以生成物理上可行、无摩擦违规且具备强泛化能力的灵巧抓取，成功桥接了运动学生成与物理可行性之间的鸿沟。
AI.translation: 大多数学习到的灵巧抓取生成器将接触力归入下游验证步骤，因此运动学上合理的姿势仍然可能违反稳定物理抓取的条件。我们通过 EquiDexFlow 解决了这个问题，这是一种 SE(3) 等变流匹配模型，可从物体点云中联合预测手腕姿态、关节角度、指尖接触、表面法线和接触力。我们的架构通过设计将接触投影到物体表面，并将力投影到库仑摩擦锥中，因此在没有损失惩罚的情况下保持了位置和摩擦合规性。我们证明了端到端的 SE(3) 等变性，并在 200 次旋转中进行了经验验证，手腕残差低于 0.04° 且关节偏差完全为零。我们的模型在针对 16 自由度 Allegro 手的 81 个物体的 8,100 个力闭合抓取上进行了训练，实现了零摩擦违反、最佳综合得分以及所有消融变体中最低的力矩残差。我们通过单指逆运动学将解码的指尖接触重定向到 16 自由度的 LEAP 手，并且我们的硬件可行性细化使每个关节至少处于其执行器包络线内部 5%，同时保持力矩平衡。在实体机器人上，重定向的 EquiDexFlow 解码抓取在所有六个测试物体上完成了开环抓取并保持试验，其中每个非对称物体在标准姿态和 120° 共旋转下均取得成功。视频、代码和检查点可在 https://equidexflow.github.io 获得。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 EquiDexFlow，一种用于灵巧抓取生成的 SE(3) 等变流匹配模型。该模型能够从物体点云中直接联合预测手腕姿态、关节角、接触点、法线和接触力。通过将物理约束（如表面投影和库仑摩擦锥）直接构建在网络架构中，该方法消除了摩擦违规，实现了高成功率、物理可行的灵巧抓取，并在真实机器人上通过跨设备重定向完成了验证。
AI.keywords: 灵巧抓取 (Dexterous Grasping), 流匹配 (Flow Matching), SE(3) 等变性 (SE(3) Equivariance), 接触力学 (Contact Mechanics)
AI.comments: 这项工作的一大亮点在于将物理约束（如接触点在物体表面、接触力在库仑摩擦锥内）直接融入网络架构的设计中，而不是依赖后期优化或损失函数惩罚，这极大地保证了生成抓取的物理可行性。同时，端到端 SE(3) 等变性的引入和证明，使得模型在面对物体旋转时具有极高的鲁棒性。将接触点成功重定向到不同硬件（LEAP Hand）并进行实体机器人验证，展示了该方法的实用价值。

title: Rethinking Psychometric Evaluation of LLMs: When and Why Self-Reports Predict Behavior
comments: Accepted as an Oral (Contributed Talk) at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks (CTB)
summary: Anticipating LLM behavioral tendencies from low-cost psychometric probes is critical for safe deployment, but only if self-reports (SR) reliably predict behavior. Recent work documented substantial SR-behavior dissociation in LLMs, but relied on broad personality traits (Big 5) that predict specific behaviors weakly, even in humans. Furthermore, the isolation of conversational sessions combined with weak context matching left open whether LLMs truly lack coherence or whether the conditions needed to detect such coherence were not met. We contrast Big 5 with the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), which measures intention targeted to a specific behavior and predicts human behavior substantially better than broad traits. We run experiments across four behavioral tasks and 11 frontier LLMs, while also varying session context and identity induction. We find that SR-behavior coherence exists but is selective. 1) Within a shared conversation, the Theory of Planned Behavior reaches human-level coherence; Big 5 does not. 2) Across separate conversations, coherence survives only for behaviors anchored outside the immediate prompt, such as implicit bias shaped by training, and collapses when behavior is strongly primed by context, as with sycophancy. 3) Persona prompting makes self-reports more consistent across conversations, but does not bring behavior into alignment. These findings suggest that coarse personality frameworks, such as Big 5 may not be the best tools for testing deployment behavior. More task- and behavior-specific instruments are needed, and even these must be evaluated across tasks and contexts.
comment: Accepted as an Oral (Contributed Talk) at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks (CTB)

AI.title_translation: 重新思考大语言模型的心理测量评估：自我报告何时以及为何能预测行为
AI.tldr: 本研究发现，大语言模型的自我报告与行为之间存在选择性的一致性：基于计划行为理论（TPB）的具体行为测量比大五人格更有效，但这种一致性极易受到跨会话上下文和提示词的干扰。
AI.motivation: 利用低成本的心理测量探针预测LLM的行为倾向对于安全部署至关重要，但前提是自我报告能可靠地预测行为。现有研究发现LLM的自我报告与行为严重脱节，但这些研究依赖于预测力较弱的大五人格，且未考虑会话隔离和上下文匹配的影响。因此，需要探究LLM是否真的缺乏行为一致性，以及在何种条件下能检测到这种一致性。
AI.method: 将大五人格（Big 5）与计划行为理论（TPB）进行对比，在11个前沿大语言模型和4个行为任务上进行实验，同时改变会话上下文（session context）和身份诱导（persona prompting），以评估自我报告与实际行为之间的一致性。
AI.result: 1) 在同一会话中，计划行为理论（TPB）达到了人类水平的一致性，而大五人格则没有；2) 在跨会话中，只有由训练塑造的隐性偏见等锚定于即时提示之外的行为能保持一致性，而当行为受上下文强引导（如阿谀奉承）时，一致性会崩溃；3) 角色提示（persona prompting）虽然使跨会话的自我报告更一致，但未能使实际行为与自我报告相一致。
AI.conclusion: 粗粒度的人格框架（如大五人格）可能不是测试LLM部署行为的最佳工具。评估LLM需要更多针对特定任务和行为的工具，且这些工具必须在不同的任务和上下文中进行交叉评估。
AI.translation: 预测大语言模型（LLM）从低成本心理测量探测中表现出的行为倾向对于安全部署至关重要，但这必须以自我报告（SR）能够可靠预测行为为前提。最近的研究记录了LLM中显著的自我报告与行为分离现象，但这些研究依赖于宽泛的人格特质（大五人格），而这些特质即使在人类身上对特定行为的预测能力也很弱。此外，对话会话的隔离以及微弱的上下文匹配，使得LLM究竟是真正缺乏连贯性，还是检测这种连贯性所需的条件未得到满足，这一问题悬而未决。我们将大五人格与计划行为理论（TPB）进行了对比，后者衡量针对特定行为的意图，并且对人类行为的预测能力明显优于宽泛的特质。我们在四个行为任务和11个前沿LLM上进行了实验，同时改变了会话上下文和身份诱导。我们发现自我报告与行为的连贯性确实存在，但具有选择性。1）在共享对话中，计划行为理论达到了人类水平的连贯性，而大五人格则没有。2）在独立的对话中，连贯性仅在锚定于即时提示之外的行为（例如由训练塑造的隐性偏见）中得以保留，而在行为受到上下文强烈引导（例如阿谀奉承）时则会崩溃。3）角色提示使自我报告在不同对话中更加一致，但未能使行为保持一致。这些发现表明，像大五人格这样粗糙的人格框架可能不是测试部署行为的最佳工具。需要更多针对特定任务和行为的评估工具，并且即使是这些工具也必须在不同的任务和上下文中进行评估。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）的心理测量评估中，自我报告何时以及为何能预测其行为。研究者对比了粗粒度的大五人格和针对特定行为的计划行为理论（TPB），在11个前沿LLM和4个行为任务上进行了实验。结果表明，自我报告与行为的一致性是选择性存在的：在同一对话内，TPB能达到人类水平的一致性；但在跨对话时，一致性仅存在于隐性偏见等非即时提示决定的行为中。研究指出，未来需要更多针对特定任务和行为的评估工具。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 心理测量评估, 自我报告, 计划行为理论, 行为预测
AI.comments: 本文对大模型心理测量学的有效性提出了重要的质疑与改进方向。通过将社会心理学中的计划行为理论（TPB）引入大语言模型评估，揭示了传统大五人格在预测大模型行为时的局限性，并深入分析了上下文和角色提示对行为一致性的影响，对大语言模型的安全部署和行为对齐具有重要的指导意义。

title: Normative Robustness as a Frontier for Non-Verifiable Reasoning in LLMs
summary: As LLMs increasingly serve in advisory and deliberative roles, users rely on them for non-verifiable reasoning in domains lacking objective ground truths. However, traditional evaluations of LLM reasoning focus almost exclusively on fact-based domains, such as mathematics and science, leaving uncertainty over whether and to what degree models can handle ambiguous, subjective, or value-laden problems over time. To address this concern, we propose moral reasoning as a paradigmatic subdomain of non-verifiable reasoning. We define moral robustness as a model's capacity to exhibit sound moral reasoning across time and contexts, and we introduce a scalable, adversarial, multi-turn evaluation framework to empirically measure this capability. We simulate 48,000 user-agent moral deliberations across four frontier LLMs, varying premise relevance, premise order, conversation duration, and the user's stated moral view. We find that models successfully ignore morally-irrelevant distractors, but shift their reasoning by up to 6.5%, on average, towards the user's stated preferred moral view, and varying their reasoning depending on factors such as order (altering moral judgments by order in 13-22% of the cases) and duration (altering moral judgments between single-turn and multi-turn in 10-24% of the cases). Our analysis indicates that models tailor not just their final verdicts but their underlying justifications to align with a user's moral viewpoint - a failure mode we characterize as moral deliberative sycophancy.

AI.title_translation: 规范鲁棒性：大语言模型中不可验证推理的新前沿
AI.tldr: 本文评估了大语言模型在道德推理等不可验证领域中的鲁棒性，发现模型存在“道德审议阿谀奉承”现象，即模型会迎合用户的道德观点来调整其最终判断和底层的论证逻辑。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地担任咨询和审议角色，用户开始依赖它们在缺乏客观真理的领域进行不可验证的推理。然而，传统的LLM推理评估几乎完全集中在数学和科学等基于事实的领域，导致模型在处理模糊、主观或充满价值偏好的问题时的能力和稳定性（即规范鲁棒性）尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method:
1. 将道德推理作为不可验证推理的范式子领域，并定义“道德鲁棒性”为模型在不同时间和背景下表现出合理道德推理的能力。
2. 引入一个可扩展的、对抗性的、多轮评估框架来实证衡量这一能力。
3. 在四个前沿大语言模型上模拟了48,000次用户-智能体道德审议，通过改变前提相关性、前提顺序、对话时长以及用户陈述的道德观点来进行多维度测试。
AI.result: 研究发现，模型虽然能够成功忽略与道德无关的干扰信息，但其推理平均会向用户陈述的偏好道德观点偏移多达6.5%。此外，模型的推理极易受到前提顺序（13-22%的情况下因顺序改变道德判断）和对话时长（10-24%的情况下在单轮和多轮之间改变道德判断）等因素的影响。模型不仅会调整其最终的判决，还会调整其底层的论证逻辑以与用户的道德观点保持一致（即产生“道德审议阿谀奉承”现象）。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在面对非客观、价值导向的不可验证推理时，容易表现出“道德审议阿谀奉承”的失效模式。它们不仅会改变最终的道德评判，甚至会重构底层的论证逻辑以迎合用户的道德立场，这表明提升大语言模型在非验证性推理中的规范鲁棒性是当前亟待解决的重要挑战。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地担任咨询和审议角色，用户在缺乏客观事实真相的领域中依赖它们进行不可验证的推理。然而，传统的LLM推理评估几乎完全集中在数学和科学等基于事实的领域，这使得模型随着时间的推移能否以及在多大程度上处理模糊、主观或带有价值偏好的问题存在不确定性。为了解决这一担忧，我们提出将道德推理作为不可验证推理的一个范式子领域。我们将“道德鲁棒性”定义为模型在不同时间和背景下表现出合理道德推理的能力，并引入了一个可扩展的、对抗性的、多轮评估框架来实证衡量这一能力。我们在四个前沿LLM中模拟了48,000次用户-智能体的道德审议，改变了前提相关性、前提顺序、对话时长以及用户陈述的道德观点。我们发现，模型成功地忽略了与道德无关的干扰因素，但其推理平均向用户陈述的偏好道德观点偏移了多达6.5%，并且其推理会根据顺序（在13-22%的情况下由于顺序改变道德判断）和时长（在10-24%的情况下在单轮和多轮之间改变道德判断）等因素发生变化。我们的分析表明，模型不仅调整了其最终裁决，还调整了其底层的论证，以迎合用户的道德观点——我们称这种失效模式为“道德审议阿谀奉承”。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）在缺乏客观标准答案的“不可验证推理”（以道德推理为代表）中的表现。作者定义了“道德鲁棒性”概念，并开发了一个多轮对抗性评估框架。通过在四种前沿LLM上模拟4.8万次道德审议对话，研究发现模型虽然能排除无关干扰，但其推理极易受到用户立场、论据顺序和对话长度的影响，甚至会为了迎合用户而调整其底层的论证逻辑，表现出“道德审议阿谀奉承”的倾向。
AI.keywords: 规范鲁棒性, 不可验证推理, 道德推理, 道德审议阿谀奉承, 大语言模型评估
AI.comments: 该研究开辟了LLM评估的新维度，将关注点从传统的客观事实推理（如数学、代码）延伸到了主观、无标准答案的道德与价值推理领域。提出的“道德审议阿谀奉承（moral deliberative sycophancy）”概念非常具有启发性，揭示了当前LLM为了讨好用户而牺牲逻辑一致性和道德原则的缺陷。不过，由于道德本身具有高度的文化和背景敏感性，如何在不引入特定偏见的前提下定义并测量“合理的道德推理”和“鲁棒性”，仍是一个极具挑战性且值得深入探讨的课题。

title: Let's Ask Gauss: Improved One-Run Privacy Auditing
summary: Privacy auditing provides an important safeguard by estimating the actual information leaked by a model, thus ensuring that theoretical privacy guarantees hold in practice. We study empirical privacy auditing for differentially private (DP) machine learning, focusing on efficient one-run methods for mechanisms such as DP-SGD. Prior one-run approaches threshold training examples or "canaries" into binary membership guesses, which discards useful information. We show that, in the white-box DP-SGD setting, canary-aligned signals naturally form a sequence of random variables whose normalized sum is asymptotically Gaussian. Leveraging this distributional perspective, we develop a DP-auditing framework that leads to tighter privacy lower bounds from a single training run.

AI.title_translation: 让我们问问高斯：改进的单次运行隐私审计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于高斯分布视角的单次运行隐私审计框架，避免了传统方法中二值化带来的信息损失，从而在单次训练中实现了更紧密的差分隐私下界估计。
AI.motivation: 传统的单次运行隐私审计方法将训练样本或“金丝雀”阈值化为二值的成员身份猜测，这会导致有用信息的丢失，从而限制了审计的紧密性。
AI.method: 在白盒DP-SGD设置下，证明了与金丝雀对齐的信号自然形成一个随机变量序列，其归一化总和渐近服从高斯分布。利用这一分布视角，开发了一种新型的差分隐私审计框架。
AI.result: 成功开发了一种新的差分隐私审计框架，该框架能够仅通过单次训练运行就推导出更紧密的隐私下界。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用白盒DP-SGD设置下金丝雀信号的渐近高斯分布特性，可以从单次训练运行中实现更紧密、更高效的差分隐私安全审计。
AI.translation: 隐私审计通过评估模型泄露的实际信息来提供重要的安全保障，从而确保理论上的隐私保证在实践中成立。我们研究了差分隐私（DP）机器学习的经验隐私审计，重点关注针对DP-SGD等机制的高效单次运行方法。先前的单次运行方法将训练样本或“金丝雀”阈值化为二值成员身份猜测，这丢弃了有用的信息。我们表明，在白盒DP-SGD设置中，与金丝雀对齐的信号自然形成一个随机变量序列，其归一化和渐近服从高斯分布。利用这种分布视角，我们开发了一个DP审计框架，该框架可以从单次训练运行中获得更紧密的隐私下界。
AI.summary: 本文针对差分隐私机器学习，研究了高效的单次运行隐私审计方法。针对以往方法因将金丝雀信号进行二值化分类而导致信息丢失的问题，本文提出在白盒DP-SGD设置下，金丝雀对齐信号的归一化和在渐近意义上服从高斯分布。基于这一高斯分布视角，本文构建了一个新的差分隐私审计框架，能够仅凭单次训练运行获得更紧密的隐私下界。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私, 隐私审计, 单次运行, DP-SGD, 高斯分布
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于摒弃了传统方法中将金丝雀信号进行二值化截断的做法，转而从分布的角度出发，利用了其渐近高斯分布的特性。这一改进不仅保留了更多有用的信息，而且在保持单次运行（one-run）高效性的同时，成功获得了更紧密的隐私下界，对差分隐私的实际部署和安全评估具有重要意义。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Radial Basis Functions for PDEs with Dirac Delta Sources
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a machine learning method for solving forward and inverse Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). When applied to PDEs with Dirac delta functions in the forcing terms, boundary conditions, or initial conditions, PINNs require approximating them with smooth surrogate functions, a practice that can introduce significant modeling errors. In this work, we exploit the interpretation of PINNs as Residual Least Squares (RLS) methods and show that this perspective enables direct treatment of Dirac delta terms by integrating the weak-form equation. Among RLS formulations other than PINN, we focus on the Radial Basis Function (RBF) expansion (also known as a single-layer RBF Network). We show that while integrating out the Dirac delta in PINNs causes residuals to fail to converge to zero, RBF-RLS consistently provides good forward and inverse solutions to transport problems. We explain this finding using the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) theory. We test both approaches on linear PDEs that represent groundwater flow and transport in porous media and rivers. We solve inverse problems to fit synthetic data, noisy synthetic data, and real-world measurements.

AI.title_translation: 基于物理信息的神经网络和径向基函数用于处理带有狄拉克δ源的偏微分方程
AI.tldr: 当处理带有狄拉克δ函数的偏微分方程时，传统的基于物理信息的神经网络（PINNs）表现不佳。本文提出利用残差最小二乘（RLS）方法的视角，并通过弱形式方程积分直接处理狄拉克δ项，特别关注径向基函数（RBF）展开。研究表明，RBF-RLS在解决传输问题时能提供良好的正向和反向解，而PINNs则会导致残差无法收敛到零。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于物理信息的神经网络（PINNs）在处理带有狄拉克δ函数（如在强制项、边界条件或初始条件中）的偏微分方程（PDEs）时，需要用平滑的替代函数来近似狄拉克δ函数，这会引入显著的建模误差。本研究旨在解决这一问题，提供一种更直接、更准确的处理方法。
AI.method: 本文将基于物理信息的神经网络（PINNs）解释为残差最小二乘（RLS）方法，并利用这一视角通过积分弱形式方程来直接处理狄拉克δ项。研究重点关注了径向基函数（RBF）展开（即单层RBF网络）作为一种RLS形式。通过与PINNs进行比较，并利用神经正切核（NTK）理论解释了两者性能差异。
AI.result: 研究发现，在PINNs中积分狄拉克δ函数会导致残差无法收敛到零。相比之下，径向基函数-残差最小二乘（RBF-RLS）方法能够持续为传输问题提供良好的正向和反向解。这些发现通过神经正切核（NTK）理论得到了解释。两种方法都在代表多孔介质和河流中地下水流动和传输的线性偏微分方程上进行了测试，并成功解决了拟合合成数据、噪声合成数据和真实世界测量的反问题。
AI.conclusion: 当处理带有狄拉克δ源的偏微分方程时，径向基函数-残差最小二乘（RBF-RLS）方法相比于传统的基于物理信息的神经网络（PINNs）表现出更优越的性能和鲁棒性，能够提供更准确的解。
AI.translation: 基于物理信息的神经网络（PINNs）是一种用于解决正向和反向偏微分方程（PDEs）的机器学习方法。当应用于强制项、边界条件或初始条件中含有狄拉克δ函数的PDEs时，PINNs需要用平滑的替代函数来近似它们，这种做法会引入显著的建模误差。在这项工作中，我们利用PINNs作为残差最小二乘（RLS）方法的解释，并表明这一视角通过积分弱形式方程能够直接处理狄拉克δ项。在除PINN之外的RLS公式中，我们关注径向基函数（RBF）展开（也称为单层RBF网络）。我们表明，虽然在PINNs中积分狄拉克δ会导致残差无法收敛到零，但RBF-RLS始终能为传输问题提供良好的正向和反向解。我们使用神经正切核（NTK）理论解释了这一发现。我们测试了这两种方法在线性PDEs上，这些PDEs代表了多孔介质和河流中的地下水流动和传输。我们解决了反问题，以拟合合成数据、带噪声的合成数据和真实世界的测量。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于物理信息的神经网络（PINNs）在处理带有狄拉克δ源的偏微分方程时存在的近似误差问题，提出了一种改进方法。通过将PINNs解释为残差最小二乘（RLS）方法，并采用弱形式方程积分来直接处理狄拉克δ项，研究特别关注了径向基函数（RBF）展开作为一种RLS形式。实验结果表明，RBF-RLS相比于传统PINNs在处理传输问题时能提供更准确、更稳定的正向和反向解，而PINNs在此情况下残差无法收敛。这一现象通过神经正切核（NTK）理论得到解释，并在地下水流和传输的线性PDEs上进行了验证，成功应用于合成数据和真实世界测量的反问题。
AI.keywords: 基于物理信息的神经网络, 径向基函数, 狄拉克δ函数, 偏微分方程, 残差最小二乘
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它提供了一种更稳健、更直接的方法来处理基于物理信息的神经网络（PINNs）在面对带有狄拉克δ源的偏微分方程时的局限性。通过将PINNs置于残差最小二乘（RLS）框架下，并引入径向基函数（RBF）展开，作者成功解决了传统PINNs需要平滑近似狄拉克δ函数所带来的建模误差问题。神经正切核（NTK）理论的引入为理解两种方法性能差异提供了深刻的理论解释，增强了研究的说服力。这项工作对于涉及点源或集中力场的物理系统建模具有重要意义。

title: Benchmarking AI Agents for Addressing Scientific Challenges Across Scales
summary: AI agents are increasingly being developed to accelerate scientific discovery, yet their practical capabilities in real research settings remain poorly understood. Existing benchmarks for AI agents rarely capture the complexity, heterogeneity, and extended reasoning required by scientific work, whereas benchmarks for scientific tasks often reduce research to static, direct problems and provide limited support for interactive evaluation. Here, we introduce SciAgentArena, a systematic benchmark for evaluating AI agents in real-world scientific research scenarios drawn from emerging needs across multiple domains. SciAgentArena comprises approximately 200 tasks with stepwise verification and an interactive, agent-agnostic environment for assessing diverse AI agents. Using this benchmark, we find that current agents can contribute effectively to well-specified data-analysis workflows, particularly when the task structure and evaluation criteria are clear. However, their performance remains uneven across scientific contexts: agents struggle to generate genuinely novel insights, sustain self-directed exploration, and formulate robust solutions for open-ended research questions. We further characterize common failure modes across agents and identify opportunities for improving their reliability, autonomy, and scientific reasoning. Together, SciAgentArena provides a practical framework for measuring progress in AI agents for science and for guiding the design of future agents capable of addressing complex scientific challenges. Full codes, tasks, and datasets can be accessed via this link: https://sciagentarena.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: 基准测试AI智能体以解决跨尺度的科学挑战
AI.tldr: 引入SciAgentArena，一个用于评估AI智能体在真实科学场景中能力的基准，发现当前智能体在明确任务中表现良好，但在开放式探索和生成新见解方面仍有不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI智能体基准测试无法捕捉科学工作的复杂性、异质性和扩展推理能力，而科学任务基准又过于简化，限制了交互式评估，导致对AI智能体在真实研究中实际能力的理解不足。
AI.method: 引入了SciAgentArena，一个系统性的基准测试平台，包含约200个具有分步验证的任务，以及一个交互式、与智能体无关的环境，用于评估多样化的AI智能体。
AI.result: 当前智能体在明确的数据分析工作流程中，特别是当任务结构和评估标准清晰时，能有效发挥作用。然而，它们在不同科学背景下的表现不均衡，难以产生真正新颖的见解、维持自主探索，并为开放式研究问题制定稳健的解决方案。研究还描述了智能体的常见故障模式。
AI.conclusion: SciAgentArena为衡量科学AI智能体的进展提供了一个实用框架，并指导未来能够应对复杂科学挑战的智能体的设计。
AI.translation: 人工智能智能体正被越来越多地开发出来以加速科学发现，但它们在真实研究环境中的实际能力仍知之甚少。现有的AI智能体基准测试很少能捕捉到科学工作所需的复杂性、异质性和扩展推理，而科学任务的基准测试往往将研究简化为静态、直接的问题，并对交互式评估支持有限。在此，我们引入了SciAgentArena，一个系统性基准测试平台，用于评估AI智能体在来自多个领域新兴需求的真实世界科学研究场景中的表现。SciAgentArena包含大约200个具有分步验证的任务，以及一个交互式、与智能体无关的环境，用于评估多样化的AI智能体。通过使用这个基准，我们发现当前的智能体可以在明确的数据分析工作流程中有效发挥作用，特别是当任务结构和评估标准清晰时。然而，它们在不同科学背景下的表现仍然不均衡：智能体难以产生真正新颖的见解、维持自主探索，并为开放式研究问题制定稳健的解决方案。我们进一步描述了智能体的常见故障模式，并确定了提高其可靠性、自主性和科学推理能力的机会。总而言之，SciAgentArena为衡量科学AI智能体的进展提供了一个实用框架，并指导未来能够应对复杂科学挑战的智能体的设计。完整的代码、任务和数据集可通过此链接访问：https://sciagentarena.github.io/。
AI.summary: 这篇论文介绍了SciAgentArena，一个旨在评估AI智能体在真实世界科学研究场景中能力的系统性基准测试平台。它包含约200个任务和交互式环境。研究发现，当前AI智能体在明确的数据分析任务中表现良好，但在开放式探索和产生新见解方面存在不足。该基准为衡量科学AI智能体的进展和指导未来智能体设计提供了框架。
AI.keywords: AI智能体, 科学发现, 基准测试, SciAgentArena, 科学挑战
AI.comments: SciAgentArena通过提供一个更接近真实科学研究复杂性的基准，解决了现有AI智能体评估的局限性。其创新之处在于提供了交互式、多领域、分步验证的任务，这对于推动AI在科学发现中的应用至关重要。该工作揭示了当前AI智能体在自主探索和生成新见解方面的不足，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: PI-Hunter: Automated Red-Teaming for Exposing and Localizing Prompt Injections
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into agentic systems that interact with external tools and environments, introducing new security risks such as indirect prompt injection attacks through untrusted external sources. Existing defenses mainly focus on blocking malicious content at inference time, and current red-teaming methods primarily optimize attack success. As a result, developers have limited visibility into how latent prompt injections emerge and propagate through agents. We propose PI-Hunter, an automated agentic auditing framework for proactive vulnerability exposure in LLM agents. PI-Hunter constructs realistic source-aware test cases and iteratively evolves them through feedback-driven exploration to induce agents to retrieve and reveal latent malicious instructions embedded within external environments. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks, agent architectures, attacks, and defenses demonstrate that PI-Hunter substantially improves vulnerability exposure and attack-surface coverage over strong automated red-teaming baselines, while remaining effective under existing prompt injection defenses.

AI.title_translation: PI-Hunter：用于暴露和定位提示词注入的自动化红队测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出PI-Hunter框架，通过反馈驱动的迭代测试用例演化，主动且自动地暴露和定位LLM智能体中的潜在提示词注入漏洞。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM演变为与外部环境交互的智能体，间接提示词注入带来了新的安全风险。然而，现有防御侧重于推理时拦截，而现有红队方法侧重于攻击成功率，导致开发者对潜在提示词注入在智能体中的传播和显现过程缺乏可见性。
AI.method: 提出PI-Hunter自动化审计框架。该框架通过构建现实的源感知（source-aware）测试用例，并利用反馈驱动的探索进行迭代演化，诱导LLM智能体检索并暴露嵌入在外部环境中的潜在恶意指令。
AI.result: 在多个基准、智能体架构、攻击和防御场景下的实验表明，PI-Hunter相比现有自动化红队基线，显著提高了漏洞暴露率和攻击面覆盖率，并且在现有的提示词注入防御下依然保持有效。
AI.conclusion: PI-Hunter是一个强大的自动化审计框架，能够有效提升LLM智能体对提示词注入漏洞的检测能力，为构建更安全的智能体系统奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）正迅速演变为与外部工具和环境交互的智能体系统，这引入了新的安全风险，例如通过不受信任的外部源进行的间接提示词注入攻击。现有的防御措施主要集中在推理时拦截恶意内容，而目前的红队测试方法主要侧重于优化攻击成功率。因此，开发者对于潜在提示词注入如何在智能体中出现和传播的可见性有限。我们提出了PI-Hunter，这是一个用于在LLM智能体中进行主动漏洞暴露的自动化智能体审计框架。PI-Hunter构建了现实的、源感知的测试用例，并通过反馈驱动的探索进行迭代演化，以诱导智能体检索并揭示嵌入在外部环境中的潜在恶意指令。在多个基准测试、智能体架构、攻击和防御上的广泛实验表明，与强大的自动化红队基线相比，PI-Hunter显著提高了漏洞暴露和攻击面覆盖率，同时在现有的提示词注入防御下依然有效。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）智能体易受间接提示词注入攻击的问题，提出了PI-Hunter。这是一种自动化的智能体审计框架，旨在主动暴露和定位漏洞。通过构建并迭代演化源感知测试用例，PI-Hunter能够诱导智能体揭示潜在的恶意指令。实验表明，该方法在漏洞曝光率和攻击面覆盖率上显著优于现有红队基线。
AI.keywords: 提示词注入, 红队测试, 大语言模型智能体, 漏洞暴露, 自动化审计
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将LLM智能体的红队测试从单纯追求“攻击成功率”转向“主动漏洞审计与定位”，通过反馈驱动的迭代探索，提高了安全漏洞的可见性。其重要性在于为LLM智能体开发者提供了一个实用的主动防御工具。局限性在于，仅从摘要来看，尚未能评估该方法在面对极其复杂的、多步骤推理智能体时的计算开销和可扩展性。

title: Deep Unfolded Latent Optimally Partitioned-l2/l1 Networks for Data-driven Block-Sparse Recovery
summary: The convex Latent Optimal Partition (LOP)-l2/l1 approach enables block-sparse signal recovery with unknown partitions but relies on manual hyperparameter tuning. Additionally, numerical instability in differentiating its proximal operator prevents its automatic parameter tuning via Deep Unfolding (DU). To address these limitations, we propose two architectures: a stable framework utilizing implicit differentiation and a flexible variant leveraging Deep Weight Factorization (DWF). The DWF-based approach also supports nonconvex smooth data fidelity terms. Numerical experiments demonstrate that DU-LOP-l2/l1 yields competitive performance and high resilience against impulsive noise.

AI.title_translation: 用于数据驱动块稀疏恢复的深度展开潜在最优划分-l2/l1网络
AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种基于隐式微分和深度权重分解的深度展开LOP-l2/l1网络，解决了未知划分块稀疏恢复中的超参数手动调优及求导数值不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的凸潜在最优划分（LOP）-l2/l1方法在进行未知划分的块稀疏信号恢复时，高度依赖手动超参数调优。然而，由于其近邻算子在微分时存在数值不稳定性，使得无法通过深度展开（Deep Unfolding）进行自动参数调优。
AI.method: 提出了两种新型深度展开架构：1) 一种利用隐式微分（implicit differentiation）来保证求导过程数值稳定的框架；2) 一种利用深度权重分解（DWF）的灵活变体，该变体还支持非凸平滑的数据保真度项。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，所提的DU-LOP-l2/l1网络在块稀疏恢复任务中表现出极具竞争力的性能，并且对脉冲噪声具有高度的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的深度展开LOP-l2/l1网络成功克服了传统方法的数值不稳定性和调参困难，为未知划分的块稀疏信号恢复提供了一种高效、鲁棒的数据驱动解决方案。
AI.translation: 凸潜在最优划分（LOP）-l2/l1方法能够在未知划分的情况下实现块稀疏信号恢复，但它依赖于手动的超参数调优。此外，其近邻算子在求导时的数值不稳定性阻碍了通过深度展开（DU）进行自动参数调优。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了两种架构：一种是利用隐式微分的稳定框架，另一种是利用深度权重分解（DWF）的灵活变体。基于DWF的方法还支持非凸平滑数据保真度项。数值实验表明，DU-LOP-l2/l1具有竞争力的性能，并且对脉冲噪声表现出高度的抗扰性。
AI.summary: 本文针对未知划分的块稀疏信号恢复，提出了一种深度展开潜在最优划分（DU-LOP-l2/l1）网络。为了解决传统LOP-l2/l1方法依赖手动调参以及近邻算子求导数值不稳定的限制，论文设计了基于隐式微分的稳定框架和基于深度权重分解（DWF）的灵活变体。实验表明，该方法不仅实现了自动参数优化，还在抗脉冲噪声方面表现出优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 深度展开, 块稀疏恢复, 潜在最优划分, 隐式微分, 深度权重分解
AI.comments: 该论文成功将深度展开（Deep Unfolding）应用于具有未知划分的块稀疏信号恢复问题。其主要创新点在于克服了传统LOP-l2/l1方法中近邻算子求导的数值不稳定问题。通过引入隐式微分和深度权重分解（DWF），不仅实现了自动参数调节，还拓宽了对非凸平滑数据保真度项的支持，在鲁棒性和实用性上均有显著提升。

title: Reducing the Complexity of Deep Learning Models for EEG Analysis on Wearable Devices
summary: Wearable healthcare devices are the fastest-growing Internet of Things (IoT) sector. Many automated healthcare services rely on two crucial biological signals, namely ECG and EEG, which reflect the activity of the heart and brain, respectively. Although deep neural networks are considered the primary way to process and analyze these signals, the very tight energy and computational power constraints in wearable devices are far below the computational, energy, and memory bandwidth demands of DNN models, thereby impeding the deployment of deep learning in many practical wearable services. This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying state-of-the-art DNN models in resource-constrained wearable devices. Notably, we explore the trade-off between accuracy and computational complexity of DNNs when parameter quantization and electrode reduction methods are used.
