AI.result: 在 TinyShakespeare 实验中，秩为 2 的 LoRA-Muon 恢复了全参数训练的最佳测试学习率，而秩为 32 的 LoRA-Muon 的平均验证损失低于全参数基线。LoRA-Muon 的最佳学习率能够很好地跨秩、宽度、深度和因子重新缩放进行传递。此外，它比依赖任意因子缩放的 Spectron 更具鲁棒性，且比 LoRA-RITE 更节省内存和计算资源。
AI.conclusion: LoRA-Muon 是全秩 Muon 和 Shampoo 系列优化器的高效低秩代理。它成功解决了 LoRA 优化中的超参数传输和性能瓶颈问题，同时由于避免了 QR 分解和二阶矩存储，使其更加契合硬件加速器且显存效率极高。
AI.translation: 低秩自适应（LoRA）显著降低了微调深度学习模型的计算和内存成本，但通常比全参数（dense）训练更难调参：当使用如 AdamW 等逐因子优化器时，它对初始化选择非常敏感，其最佳学习率在不同秩之间的传递性较差，且往往无法超越全参数基线。我们通过将 Muon 优化器的谱最速下降规则应用于低秩设置，推导出了 LoRA-Muon。结合我们的分裂权重衰减规则，我们的主要观点是 LoRA-Muon 是全秩 Muon 和 Shampoo 系列优化器的一个良好低秩代理。它的最佳学习率可以跨秩、宽度、深度和因子重新缩放进行传递。在我们的计算匹配 TinyShakespeare 研究中，一个秩为 2 的代理恢复了全参数最佳测试学习率，而一个秩为 32 的 LoRA-Muon 运行在种子平均扫描中获得了比全参数基线更低的平均验证损失。我们进一步表明，Spectron 优化器依赖于任意因子缩放，因此当微调从严重失衡的因子开始时，它可能表现不佳，而 LoRA-RITE 简化的 QR 坐标核心实现了相同的谱更新。LoRA-Muon 在不进行 QR 分解的情况下计算该更新，并避免了存储二阶矩，使其对加速器更友好、更省显存。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LoRA-Muon，这是一种将 Muon 优化器的谱最速下降规则应用于低秩自适应（LoRA）的新型优化方法。通过结合分裂权重衰减规则，LoRA-Muon 克服了传统 LoRA 微调中学习率难以跨秩传递、对初始化敏感以及难以超越全参数基线的问题。实验表明，LoRA-Muon 不仅在性能上超越了全参数基线，而且由于无需 QR 分解和二阶矩存储，具有极高的计算和内存效率。
AI.keywords: LoRA, Muon 优化器, 谱最速下降, 低秩流形, 参数高效微调
AI.comments:
创新点：将先进的谱最速下降优化器（Muon）与低秩自适应（LoRA）相结合，并创新性地避免了复杂的 QR 分解和二阶矩存储，极大提升了硬件友好度。
重要性：解决了 LoRA 长期以来在学习率等超参数跨秩（rank）传递性差以及难以超越全参数基线的痛点，为高效微调提供了更稳健的优化方案。
局限性：摘要中仅提及在 TinyShakespeare 这一较小规模的数据集上进行了验证，其在更大规模模型和更复杂任务上的扩展性和泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Polar: A Benchmark for Evaluating Political Bias in LLMs
summary: Political bias in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly significant, but difficult to measure reproducibly across political and linguistic contexts. We introduce Polar, a 4,026-instance multiple-choice benchmark that measures political bias through option-level likelihoods rather than prompt-based generation. Polar covers two ideological axes and eight issue categories derived from the Manifesto Project, and evaluates models in parallel across U.S. and South Korean political contexts. Across 38 LLMs, measured bias varies systematically with political context, issue category, model group, and presentation language. All models lean left-progressive on U.S. political content, but show more centered and mixed patterns on South Korean content. Translation experiments further show that presentation language alone can shift measured bias. These findings highlight the need for multilingual and cross-contextual evaluation of political bias in LLMs.

AI.title_translation: Polar：评估大语言模型中政治偏见的基准
AI.tldr: 本文推出Polar基准，通过选项级似然度评估大模型在美国和韩国政治背景下的偏见，发现模型在美国内容中偏左，但在韩国内容中更中立，且语言本身的变化会使偏见结果发生漂移。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）中的政治偏见日益显著，但在不同的政治和语言背景下，难以进行可重复的测量。
AI.method: 引入了Polar，一个包含4,026个多选题实例的基准。该基准通过选项级似然度（option-level likelihoods）而非基于提示词的生成来衡量政治偏见，涵盖源自Manifesto项目的两个意识形态轴和八个议题类别，并在美国和韩国的政治背景下并行评估模型。
AI.result: 对38个LLM的评估表明，测得的偏见随政治背景、议题类别、模型群体和呈现语言的不同而发生系统性变化。所有模型在美国政治内容上都偏向左翼/进步派，但在韩国政治内容上表现出更居中和混合的模式。翻译实验进一步表明，仅呈现语言本身的变化就能改变测得的偏见。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现强调了在评估大语言模型的政治偏见时，进行多语言和跨语境评估的迫切必要性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）中的政治偏见变得越来越重要，但在不同的政治和语言背景下难以进行可重复的测量。我们引入了Polar，这是一个包含4,026个多选题实例的基准，通过选项级似然度而非基于提示词的生成来测量政治偏见。Polar涵盖了源自“宣言项目”（Manifesto Project）的两个意识形态轴和八个议题类别，并在美国和韩国的政治背景下并行评估模型。在对38个LLM的评估中，测得的偏见随着政治背景、议题类别、模型群体和呈现语言的不同而呈现出系统性变化。所有模型在美国政治内容上都偏向左翼/进步派，但在韩国政治内容上表现出更居中和混合的模式。翻译实验进一步表明，仅呈现语言本身就可以改变测得的偏见。这些发现强调了对LLM政治偏见进行多语言和跨语境评估的必要性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Polar，一个用于评估大语言模型政治偏新的多选题基准。该基准包含4,026个实例，通过选项级似然度进行测量，涵盖两个意识形态轴和八个议题类别，并在美国和韩国的政治语境下并行测试。通过对38个模型的评估，研究发现LLM的政治偏见受语境、议题和语言的显著影响：在美版内容中普遍偏左，但在韩版内容中更中立，且仅改变语言即可漂移偏见结果。这表明多语言和跨语境评估对于政治偏见研究至关重要。
AI.keywords: 政治偏见,大语言模型,Polar基准,多语言评估,跨语境评估
AI.comments:
1. 该论文提出了一种创新的评估方法，通过选项级似然度（option-level likelihoods）而非传统的文本生成来测量政治偏见，这显著提高了评估的可重复性和客观性。
2. 跨国（美国和韩国）和跨语言的对比设计非常新颖，揭示了模型在不同文化/政治语境下的偏见差异。
3. 研究发现“仅呈现语言的改变即可漂移偏见结果”，这是一个非常重要的警示，指出了当前LLM安全对齐在多语言场景下的不一致性与局限性。

title: Order Is Not Control
summary: AI alignment, interpretability, steering, and neural perturbation studies identify order-inducing objects. We argue that order is not control. Control requires a receiver-gated response law: a denominator-indexed operator mapping material state, action/drive, bath, and receiver state to response displacement, sinks, effort, and basin projection. We identify it across biological, LLM, adapter, and stochastic-operator panels. The laws are local: an intervention can be admitted, saturated, sign-changing, leaky, or overdriven depending on medium, bath, receiver state, action port, and comparator. Control is assigned when finite effort moves a target or outcome-readout class under the same denominator while damage, null/evasive, invalid format, overdrive, and unnecessary effort stay bounded. Mouse ALM, C. elegans, and zebrafish panels provide physical response-operator evidence while excluding coordinate identity and controller conclusions. LLM panels show generated-output response laws: across four material conditions, response vectors are predictable at 72.8-73.7% component-sign accuracy, rising to 84.3-84.8% on nonzero components; held-out observers predict system-effect and target/oracle families at 93.6% and 91.7% accuracy. Constitution-conditioned adapters reshape susceptibility as prepared media, and stochastic-operator panels separate measured opportunity from deployable action policies. This gives a driven-dissipative response-system account at the mesoscopic control level: drives act through prepared media, baths, and receivers, producing admitted movement, impedance, sinks, or overdrive. The evidence supports local admitted control and measurable stochastic response operators, while leaving deployable pre-generation control, hidden/logit causal sufficiency, biological-to-LLM coordinate identity, and literal thermodynamic quantities outside scope.

AI.tldr: 本文指出“秩序不等于控制”，并提出了一种跨生物和LLM系统的“接收器门控响应定律”，用以在介观层面量化和预测真正的控制行为。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI对齐、可解释性、引导和神经扰动研究能够识别出诱导秩序的对象，但作者认为“秩序并不等同于控制”。真正的控制需要更严格的、由接收器门控的响应机制来定义。
AI.method: 提出了一种“接收器门控响应定律（receiver-gated response law）”，该定律通过一个分母索引的算子，将物质状态、动作/驱动、环境和接收器状态映射为响应位移、汇、努力和流域投影。作者在生物面板（小鼠、线虫、斑马鱼）、LLM面板、适配器和随机算子面板中对该定律进行了实证和识别。
AI.result: 在生物面板中，提供了物理响应算子的证据。在LLM面板中，生成的输出响应向量的分量符号预测准确率达到72.8%-73.7%（非零分量上达84.3%-84.8%）；留出的观察者对系统效应和目标/预言机家族的预测准确率分别达到93.6%和91.7%。此外，宪法调节的适配器成功将敏感性重塑为准备好的介质。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，控制应当被理解为一种在介观控制层面上的驱动-耗散响应系统。证据支持局部允许的控制和可测量的随机响应算子，而将可部署的生成前控制、隐藏因果充分性、生物与LLM的坐标同一性等排除在研究范围之外。
AI.translation: AI对齐、可解释性、引导和神经扰动研究识别了诱导秩序的对象。我们认为，秩序并非控制。控制需要一种接收器门控的响应定律：一个分母索引的算子，将物质状态、动作/驱动、环境（bath）和接收器状态映射到响应位移、汇（sinks）、努力（effort）和流域投影（basin projection）。我们在生物、大语言模型（LLM）、适配器和随机算子面板中识别了这一规律。这些定律是局部的：一个干预可以是允许的、饱和的、符号改变的、泄漏的或过载的，这取决于介质、环境、接收器状态、动作端口和比较器。当有限的努力在同一分母下移动目标或结果读取类别，同时损伤、空/规避、无效格式、过载和不必要的努力保持有界时，即被判定为控制。小鼠ALM、秀丽隐杆线虫和斑马鱼面板提供了物理响应算子的证据，同时排除了坐标同一性和控制器的结论。LLM面板展示了生成的输出响应定律：在四种物质条件下，响应向量的分量符号预测准确率为72.8-73.7%，在非零分量上上升至84.3-84.8%；留出观察者预测系统效应和目标/预言机家族的准确率分别为93.6%和91.7%。宪法调节的适配器将敏感性重塑为准备好的介质，而随机算子面板则将测量的机会与可部署的行动策略隔离开来。这在介观控制层面提供了一个驱动-耗散响应系统的解释：驱动通过准备好的介质、环境和接收器起作用，产生允许的运动、阻抗、汇或过载。证据支持局部允许的控制和可测量的随机响应算子，而将可部署的生成前控制、隐藏/对数几率因果充分性、生物到LLM的坐标同一性以及字面上的热力学量留在了研究范围之外。
AI.summary: 本文提出并论证了“秩序不等于控制”的观点。作者引入了“接收器门控响应定律”这一数学和物理框架，用于在介观层面刻画控制行为。通过在生物系统（如小鼠、线虫、斑马鱼）和大语言模型（LLM）上的多维度实验，证实了该定律在预测系统响应和输出行为方面的高准确性，为理解复杂系统的可控性提供了全新的驱动-耗散系统视角。
AI.keywords: AI对齐, 接收器门控响应定律, 驱动-耗散系统, 控制理论, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于从物理学和控制论的角度，对AI对齐和解释性研究中常用的“秩序”和“控制”概念进行了深刻的区分，提出了“接收器门控响应定律”。这一理论框架不仅适用于大语言模型（LLM），也适用于生物神经系统，展现了极强的跨学科普适性。其局限性在于，该模型目前还较为抽象，且明确排除了生成前控制、深层因果充分性等复杂问题。

title: Iterating Toward Better Search: A Two-Agent Simulation Framework for Evaluating Agentic Search Architectures in E-Commerce
summary: We present a modular two-agent simulation framework for evaluating conversational shopping assistant architectures. An independent buyer agent, configured with personas, missions, and patience levels, is paired with an interchangeable responder that integrates with a real e-commerce search API. Holding the buyer constant across experiments enables controlled comparison of responder designs on identical scenarios. Using 2011 conversations across 14 persona buckets, we establish four empirical findings. First, rolling-window memory outperforms intent-extraction memory on all quality metrics while being 35% faster per query. Second, illustrating rapid evidence-driven iteration, a systematic failure analysis of a responder version enables targeted fixes that reduce failure and near-failure rates by 62% across the full dataset. Third, swapping the responder LLM backbone from Gemini~2.5 to Llama~3.3~70B costs 0.16--0.45 points despite identical architecture. Finally, we document systematic philosophical disagreement between frontier LLM judges: Gemini rewards process correctness while Claude demands concrete outcomes, despite using the same evaluation prompt.

AI.title_translation: 迈向更好的搜索：一种用于评估电子商务中智能搜索架构的双智能体模拟框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个双智能体模拟框架，用于评估电商对话式购物助手，并基于2011次对话得出了关于内存机制、模型迭代、LLM底座差异以及LLM裁判偏见的四项实证发现。
AI.motivation: 评估对话式购物助手架构需要受控且可重复的实验环境。为了在相同场景下对不同的响应器（responder）设计进行受控比较，需要一种能够保持买家行为一致的模拟框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种模块化的双智能体模拟框架。该框架将一个配置了角色（personas）、任务（missions）和耐心程度（patience levels）的独立买家智能体（buyer agent），与一个集成了真实电商搜索API的可更换响应器（responder）进行配对。通过在实验中保持买家智能体不变，实现对不同响应器设计的受控对比。
AI.result: 基于14个角色分类下的2011次对话，研究得出以下结果：1) 滚动窗口内存（rolling-window memory）在所有质量指标上均优于意图提取内存（intent-extraction memory），且每条查询速度快35%；2) 通过系统性故障分析进行针对性修复，使整个数据集的失败和接近失败率降低了62%；3) 将响应器的LLM底座从Gemini 2.5更换为Llama 3.3 70B会导致评分下降0.16至0.45分；4) 前沿LLM裁判（Gemini和Claude）之间存在系统性的哲学分歧，即使使用相同的评估提示词，Gemini更看重过程正确性，而Claude更看重具体结果。
AI.conclusion: 该双智能体模拟框架能够有效支持电商智能搜索架构的快速、证据驱动迭代和受控评估，同时揭示了LLM底座选择及LLM裁判偏见对评估结果的重要影响。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于评估对话式购物助手架构的模块化双智能体模拟框架。一个配置了角色、任务和耐心程度的独立买家智能体，与一个集成了真实电子商务搜索API的可更换响应器进行配对。在实验中保持买家智能体不变，可以对相同场景下的响应器设计进行受控比较。通过在14个角色分类中进行2011次对话，我们确立了四个实证发现。首先，滚动窗口内存在所有质量指标上均优于意图提取内存，同时每条查询的速度快35%。其次，展示了快速的证据驱动迭代，对响应器版本进行系统性故障分析，使整个数据集的失败和接近失败率降低了62%。第三，尽管架构相同，将响应器LLM底座从Gemini 2.5更换为Llama 3.3 70B会损失0.16至0.45分。最后，我们记录了前沿LLM裁判之间系统性的哲学分歧：尽管使用相同的评估提示词，Gemini奖励过程的正确性，而Claude则要求具体的结果。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个模块化的双智能体模拟框架，用于评估电子商务中的对话式购物助手。该框架通过匹配一个设定了角色和任务的独立买家智能体与一个可更换的搜索响应器，实现了受控的对比实验。基于2011次对话的实验，研究发现滚动窗口内存性能和速度更佳，系统性修复可大幅降低失败率，更换LLM底座对性能有明显影响，且不同的前沿LLM裁判在评估标准上存在系统性偏见（过程导向 vs 结果导向）。
AI.keywords: 双智能体模拟, 电商搜索, 智能体评估, 大语言模型裁判, 对话式购物助手
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于构建了双智能体模拟环境来解决电商搜索中难以进行受控对比评估的问题。其实证发现非常具有实用价值，特别是关于不同LLM裁判（Gemini vs Claude）评估偏好存在系统性分歧的发现，为未来使用LLM作为评估器（LLM-as-a-judge）的研究提供了重要的启示和警示。

title: Multi-Label Test-Time Adaptation with Bayesian Conditional Priors
summary: Multi-label recognition with frozen Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is brittle under distribution shift: standard zero-shot inference scores labels independently, ignoring co-occurrence structure and producing incoherent label sets where dominant concepts suppress weaker but compatible labels. We introduce Bayesian Conditional Priors (BCP) Estimation, a gradient-free test-time adaptation method that injects label dependency without tuning the backbone. BCP views zero-shot logits as a proxy for marginal posteriors under a fixed image-text likelihood and attributes shift-induced errors mainly to a mismatched label prior. For each test image, it selects a high-confidence anchor label and applies an anchor-conditioned Bayesian refinement. This update is closed-form in logit space and admits a pointwise mutual information (PMI) interpretation, explicitly promoting compatible labels and suppressing incompatible ones. BCP operates without target annotations by estimating anchor-conditioned priors online from the unlabeled test stream via lightweight second-order co-occurrence statistics, adding negligible overhead beyond a single forward pass. Across standard multi-label benchmarks and multiple CLIP backbones, BCP consistently outperforms strong TTA baselines, e.g., improving RN50 average mAP from 57.31 to 69.22 and ViT-B/16 from 62.61 to 71.79.

AI.title_translation: 基于贝叶斯条件先验的多标签测试时自适应
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无梯度的测试时自适应方法BCP，通过在线估计无标注测试流中的标签共现关系并进行贝叶斯条件细化，显著提升了冻结视觉语言模型在分布偏移下的多标签识别能力。
AI.motivation: 冻结的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在面对分布偏移时的多标签识别表现脆弱。标准的零样本推理独立地对每个标签进行评分，忽略了标签之间的共现结构，导致主导概念会抑制较弱但兼容的标签，从而产生不连贯的标签预测。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯条件先验（BCP）估计。BCP将零样本对数几率（logits）视为边缘后验，并将分布偏移引起的误差归因于不匹配的标签先验。对于每个测试图像，它选择一个高置信度的锚标签，并在对数几率空间中应用闭式的锚条件贝叶斯细化（具有点互信息PMI解释）。BCP通过轻量级的二阶共现统计，从无标注的目标测试流中在线估计这些条件先验，无需任何目标域标注。
AI.result: 在标准的多标签基准测试和多种CLIP骨干网络上，BCP均显著优于强TTA基线。例如，它将RN50的平均mAP从57.31%提升至69.22%，将ViT-B/16的平均mAP从62.61%提升至71.79%，且几乎不增加额外的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: BCP提供了一种高效、无梯度且无需标注的解决方案，通过在测试时引入标签依赖性，成功缓解了分布偏移对多标签视觉语言模型识别性能的影响。
AI.translation: 使用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）进行多标签识别在分布偏移下非常脆弱：标准的零样本推理独立地对标签进行评分，忽略了共现结构，从而产生不连贯的标签集，其中主导概念会抑制较弱但兼容的标签。我们引入了贝叶斯条件先验（BCP）估计，这是一种无梯度的测试时自适应方法，在不调整骨干网络的情况下注入了标签依赖性。BCP将零样本对数几率（logits）视为固定图文似然下的边缘后验代理，并将偏移引起的错误主要归因于不匹配的标签先验。对于每个测试图像，它选择一个高置信度的锚标签，并应用锚条件贝叶斯细化。这种更新在对数几率空间中是闭式解，并具有点互信息（PMI）解释，显式地促进兼容标签并抑制不兼容标签。BCP无需目标标注，通过轻量级的二阶共现统计从无标注的测试流中在线估计锚条件先验，除了单次前向传播之外几乎不增加额外开销。在标准的多标签基准和多个CLIP骨干网络上，BCP一致优于强TTA基线，例如，将RN50的平均mAP从57.31提升到69.22，将ViT-B/16从62.61提升到71.79。
AI.summary: 本文针对冻结视觉语言模型在多标签识别中因忽略标签共现而导致在分布偏移下表现脆弱的问题，提出了一种无梯度的测试时自适应方法——贝叶斯条件先验（BCP）估计。该方法通过在无标注测试流上在线统计轻量级二阶共现关系来估计条件先验，并利用高置信度锚标签对其他标签进行闭式的贝叶斯细化，从而在不微调骨干网络的前提下显著提升了多标签分类性能。
AI.keywords: 测试时自适应, 视觉语言模型, 多标签识别, 贝叶斯条件先验, 标签共现
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将多标签分类中的标签依赖性建模与测试时自适应（TTA）相结合，提出了一种无梯度的贝叶斯闭式更新方法，计算开销极低且无需调整骨干网络。其局限性可能在于对首个高置信度“锚标签”的选择精度依赖较高，如果锚标签预测错误，可能会通过条件先验导致级联的错误传播。

title: Is Spurious Correlation Removal Always Learnable?
summary: Invariant learning can fail even when the invariant structure is statistically identifiable. We show a conditional computational barrier: under a black-box samplable supervised sparse recovery primitive motivated by average-case sparse-recovery reductions, there exist \emph{samplable} multi-environment instances with a one-dimensional predictive invariant subspace ($k=1$) that are learnable with polynomial samples by exhaustive search, while any polynomial-time constant-accuracy recovery algorithm would contradict the primitive. We further quantify environment diversity by a separation parameter $γ$, which controls identifiability and the curvature of invariance objectives. Under sufficient diversity and local Gaussian regularity, the minimax risk is $\mathbb{E}[\dist(\hat{V},V_{\mathrm{inv}})^2]=Θ(k(d-k)/(n|\mathcal{E}|))$, and under label-induced shifts a phase transition occurs at $n^*\propto k(d-k)/(|\mathcal{E}|γ^2)$ with refined estimation error scaling proportional to $1/γ^2$. Synthetic and real datasets illustrate the predicted gaps and transitions and motivate simple diversity diagnostics.

AI.title_translation: 消除虚假关联总是可学习的吗？
AI.tldr: 本文证明了消除虚假关联存在计算壁垒（即使统计上可识别也可能无法在多项式时间内学习），并量化了环境多样性对可学习性和相变的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管在统计上不变结构是可识别的，但不变学习在实际中仍可能失败。本文旨在探讨消除虚假关联在计算上是否总是可学习的，并试图厘清计算可行性、样本复杂性与环境多样性之间的关系。
AI.method: 1. 提出基于黑盒可采样监督稀疏恢复原语的条件计算壁垒分析框架；2. 引入分离参数 $\gamma$ 来量化多环境的多样性；3. 在充足多样性和局部高斯正则性假设下，推导极小极大风险（minimax risk）和相变阈值；4. 利用合成与真实数据集进行实验验证和多样性诊断。
AI.result: 1. 证明了存在某些多环境实例，虽然可通过穷举搜索在多项式样本下可学习，但任何多项式时间恒定精度算法都无法有效求解（存在计算障碍）；2. 确定了极小极大风险的紧确界；3. 发现并刻画了在标签引起的偏移下发生的相变现象，其估计误差与 $1/\gamma^2$ 成比例；4. 通过实验验证了理论预测的计算-统计差距和相变。
AI.conclusion: 消除虚假关联并不总是多项式时间可学习的。即使在统计上可识别，也存在有条件的计算壁垒。环境多样性（通过分离参数 $\gamma$ 衡量）对不变量的识别和估计误差至关重要，且在特定样本量下会发生相变。
AI.translation: 即使在不变结构具有统计可识别性的情况下，不变学习也可能会失败。我们展示了一个条件计算障碍：在由平均情况稀疏恢复归约所启发的黑盒可采样监督稀疏恢复原语下，存在具有一维预测不变子空间（$k=1$）的可采样多环境实例，这些实例可以通过穷举搜索以多项式样本进行学习，而任何多项式时间恒定精度的恢复算法都将与该原语相矛盾。我们通过一个分离参数 $\gamma$ 进一步量化了环境多样性，该参数控制着可识别性和不变目标的曲率。在足够的多样性和局部高斯正则性下，极小极大风险为 $\mathbb{E}[\text{dist}(\hat{V},V_{\mathrm{inv}})^2]=\Theta(k(d-k)/(n|\mathcal{E}|))$，并且在标签引起的偏移下，在 $n^*\propto k(d-k)/(|\mathcal{E}|\gamma^2)$ 处发生相变，精细的估计误差缩放比例与 $1/\gamma^2$ 成正比。合成和真实数据集说明了预测的差距和相变，并激发了简单的多样性诊断方法。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了不变学习中消除虚假关联的计算可学性。作者证明了即使在统计上可识别的情况下，也存在计算上的障碍，使得某些多环境实例无法在多项式时间内被高效学习。此外，论文引入了分离参数 $\gamma$ 来量化环境多样性，推导了极小极大风险，并揭示了标签偏移下的相变现象。实验结果验证了上述理论发现。
AI.keywords: 不变学习, 虚假关联, 计算障碍, 环境多样性, 相变
AI.comments: 本文深入探讨了不变表征学习的计算复杂性，揭示了统计可识别性与计算可行性之间的鸿沟。通过引入环境多样性参数 $\gamma$ 并刻画相变，为评估和诊断多环境学习系统的鲁棒性提供了坚实的理论基础，对鲁棒表征学习和域泛化领域具有重要学术价值。

title: MARS: Margin-Adversarial Risk-controlled Stopping for Parallel LLM Test-time Scaling
summary: Parallel test-time scaling samples many reasoning traces and majority-votes their answers, improving LLM accuracy but requiring traces to run to completion, incurring substantial computational overhead. We observe that probing partial traces at intermediate checkpoints can extract current answers without disrupting generation, revealing an evolving aggregate vote. Based on this observation, we introduce MARS, a margin-adversarial stopping rule that estimates which active traces are likely to change their answers and stops once the leader remains safe under a conservative bound on future vote movement. The rule separates two sources of uncertainty. It learns the trace-level switch probabilities that determine how much of the current margin is likely to be retained, while handling the harder question of where switching traces land through an adversarial bound calibrated from warmup traces. With true switch probabilities, MARS guarantees with high probability that the early-stopped answer matches the full-budget vote. In practice, a five-feature logistic model closely matches oracle switching behavior. Across three reasoning models and three competition-math benchmarks, MARS saves 25-47% of self-consistency tokens and 14-29% on top of DeepConf Online, a strong confidence-weighted baseline that already filters and truncates weak traces, while matching the accuracy of the corresponding full-budget baselines.

AI.title_translation: MARS：用于并行LLM测试时缩放的边际对抗风险控制停止机制
AI.tldr: MARS是一种针对LLM测试时并行采样的早期停止机制，通过中途探测推理轨迹并预测投票变化，在保证与全预算投票结果一致的前提下，可节省25-47%的计算Token。
AI.motivation: 并行测试时缩放（例如对多个推理轨迹进行采样并进行多数投票）虽然能显著提升LLM的推理准确率，但要求所有轨迹都必须运行完毕，这带来了巨大的计算和Token开销。作者注意到，在中间步骤探测部分轨迹可以提取出当前的临时答案而不打断生成，这为提前停止推理以节省计算资源提供了可能。
AI.method: 提出MARS（边际对抗风险控制停止规则）。该方法在中间检查点探测部分推理轨迹以获取当前的临时投票情况，并评估哪些活跃轨迹有可能在未来改变答案。当领先答案在未来投票变动的保守界限下（通过预热轨迹校准的对抗界限）依然保持安全时，便触发停止。具体实现中，使用一个五特征的逻辑回归模型来预测轨迹级别的答案切换概率。
AI.result: 在三个推理模型和三个竞赛数学基准测试上，MARS成功节省了25%至47%的自一致性（self-consistency）Token。相比于已经进行了弱轨迹过滤和截断的强基线方法（DeepConf Online），MARS还能进一步节省14%至29%的Token，同时完全保持了与运行完所有预算的基线相同的准确率。
AI.conclusion: MARS是一种高效且具有理论保障的早期停止机制。它通过在推理过程中动态探测和预测轨迹答案的切换，成功在不降低模型推理准确率的前提下，大幅削减了并行LLM测试时缩放的计算开销。
AI.translation: 并行测试时缩放（Parallel test-time scaling）通过对许多推理轨迹进行采样并对其答案进行多数投票，从而提高了大语言模型（LLM）的准确性，但这也要求所有轨迹必须运行完毕，从而带来了巨大的计算开销。我们观察到，在中间检查点探测部分轨迹可以在不干扰生成的情况下提取当前答案，从而揭示出不断演变的总体投票情况。基于这一观察，我们引入了 MARS，一种边际对抗停止规则（margin-adversarial stopping rule），该规则估计哪些活跃轨迹可能会改变其答案，并在领先者在未来投票变动的保守界限下保持安全时停止。该规则分离了两个不确定性来源：它学习决定当前边际有多大可能被保留的轨迹级切换概率，同时通过从预热轨迹中校准的对抗界限来处理切换轨迹最终落脚点这一更难的问题。在真实切换概率下，MARS能以高概率保证提前停止的答案与全预算投票一致。在实践中，一个包含五个特征的逻辑模型与预知（oracle）切换行为高度匹配。在三个推理模型和三个竞赛数学基准测试中，MARS节省了25-47%的自一致性Token，并在DeepConf Online（一个已经过滤和截断弱轨迹的强置信度权重基线）之上进一步节省了14-29%的Token，同时与相应的全预算基线的准确率相匹配。
AI.summary: 本文针对并行LLM测试时缩放带来的高额计算开销，提出了一种名为MARS的早期停止机制。MARS通过在生成过程中途探测部分推理轨迹来提取当前的临时投票状态，并结合轨迹切换概率和对抗界限来判断是否可以提前终止生成。实验表明，MARS在不损失推理准确率的前提下，能够显著减少25-47%的计算Token开销。
AI.keywords: 测试时缩放 (Test-time Scaling), 早期停止 (Early Stopping), 计算效率 (Computational Efficiency), 大语言模型 (Large Language Models)
AI.comments:
1. **创新性**：MARS的创新之处在于它没有将推理轨迹视为黑盒，而是通过在中间检查点主动探测部分轨迹来动态评估投票趋势。将不确定性解耦为“切换概率”与“对抗界限”的设计非常巧妙，兼顾了理论保证与实用性。
2. **重要性**：随着Test-time Compute（测试时计算）成为提升LLM推理能力（如OpenAI o1等）的核心范式，如何在不牺牲准确率的前提下降低并行采样的计算成本是当前学术界和工业界极度关注的痛点。MARS提供了一种即插即用的高效解决方案。
3. **局限性**：该方法依赖于在中间检查点探测轨迹的能力，对于某些完全闭源且只提供最终API输出的模型，可能难以获取中间状态。此外，对抗界限的校准依赖于预热轨迹，在面对极度不均匀或分布偏移的任务时，其保守界限的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: An Embodied Simulation Platform, Benchmark, and Data-Efficient Augmentation Framework for Wet-Lab Robotics
summary: Wet-lab robots can improve the reproducibility, throughput, and safety of biomedical experiments, but scaling their learning requires customizable simulators for safe and reproducible task generation, open editable laboratory assets, and efficient pipelines that turn limited demonstrations into usable training data. We present Pipette, an embodied simulation platform, benchmark, and data-efficient augmentation framework for wet-lab robot learning. Pipette releases over 43 open-source and re-editable wet-lab assets, together with an extensible asset-building pipeline. A key component of Pipette is its simulation-based data augmentation pipeline, replaying human demonstrations in simulation, applies lighting, camera, speed, and action perturbations, and filters generated episodes with automatic task success checks, rapidly expanding usable training data from limited manual demonstrations. We further introduce an 11-task wet-lab embodied benchmark covering sample handling, culture-ware manipulation, device operation, and precision placement. With only 30 demonstrations per task, ACT achieves 65.5% average success rate, while simulation augmentation improves SmolVLA from 44.1% to 74.7% and π0 from 40.4% to 46.5%, validating the effectiveness of Pipette for data-efficient VLA training and evaluation. Pipette also supports natural-language-driven scene construction and task registration, lowering the barrier for non-expert users to define new wet-lab robotic tasks.

AI.title_translation: Pipette：用于湿实验室机器人的具身模拟平台、基准测试和数据高效增强框架
AI.tldr: 本文推出了 Pipette，一个用于湿实验室机器人的模拟与增强框架，通过模拟数据增强将 SmolVLA 的任务成功率从 44.1% 提升至 74.7%。
AI.motivation: 湿实验室机器人能提高生物医学实验的重现性、吞吐量和安全性，但其学习规模的扩展受限于缺乏可定制的模拟器、开放的可编辑实验室资产，以及将有限演示高效转化为训练数据的管道。
AI.method: 提出 Pipette 平台，包括：1) 发布 43 个以上开源且可编辑的湿实验室资产及构建管道；2) 提出基于模拟的数据增强管道，在模拟中重放人类演示并引入光照、相机、速度和动作扰动，通过自动任务成功检查过滤数据；3) 建立包含 11 个任务的湿实验室具身基准；4) 支持自然语言驱动的场景构建和任务注册。
AI.result: 在每个任务仅有 30 个演示的限制下，ACT 达到了 65.5% 的平均成功率。通过 Pipette 的模拟增强，SmolVLA 的成功率从 44.1% 提升至 74.7%，π0 的成功率从 40.4% 提升至 46.5%。
AI.conclusion: Pipette 成功验证了其在数据高效的 VLA 模型训练和评估中的有效性，并通过支持自然语言驱动的场景构建，降低了非专家用户定义新湿实验室机器人任务的门槛。
AI.translation: 湿实验室机器人可以提高生物医学实验的重现性、吞吐量和安全性，但扩展其学习能力需要可定制的模拟器以安全且可重现地生成任务、开放的可编辑实验室资产，以及能够将有限演示转化为可用训练数据的高效管道。我们展示了 Pipette，这是一个用于湿实验室机器人学习的具身模拟平台、基准测试和数据高效增强框架。Pipette 发布了超过 43 个开源且可重新编辑的湿实验室资产，以及一个可扩展的资产构建管道。Pipette 的一个关键组成部分是其基于模拟的数据增强管道，它在模拟中重放人类演示，应用光照、相机、速度和动作扰动，并通过自动任务成功检查来过滤生成的片段，从而快速从有限的手动演示中扩展可用的训练数据。我们进一步引入了一个包含 11 个任务的湿实验室具身基准，涵盖样本处理、培养皿操作、设备操作和精准放置。在每个任务仅有 30 个演示的情况下，ACT 实现了 65.5% 的平均成功率，而模拟增强将 SmolVLA 的成功率从 44.1% 提升至 74.7%，将 π0 从 40.4% 提升至 46.5%，验证了 Pipette 在数据高效的 VLA 训练和评估中的有效性。Pipette 还支持自然语言驱动的场景构建和任务注册，降低了非专家用户定义新湿实验室机器人任务的门槛。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 Pipette，这是一个专为湿实验室机器人学习设计的具身模拟平台、基准测试和数据高效增强框架。Pipette 提供了 43 个以上的开源可编辑资产，并设计了一个基于模拟的数据增强管道，通过重放人类演示并引入多种扰动及自动成功过滤，快速扩充训练数据。此外，它引入了包含 11 个任务的基准，实验表明其能显著提升 SmolVLA 和 π0 等模型的任务成功率，并支持利用自然语言进行场景构建。
AI.keywords: 湿实验室机器人, 具身智能, 模拟数据增强, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 机器人基准测试
AI.comments: 该论文针对生物医学湿实验室机器人面临的数据稀缺和模拟环境缺乏问题，提出了端到端的解决方案。其创新的模拟数据增强方法能以极少的真实世界演示大幅提升 VLA 模型的性能，这对于高成本、高风险的生物化学实验场景尤为重要。开源资产和支持自然语言任务定义也极大地方便了非专家用户的跨学科研究。不过，模拟环境中的物理交互（如液体操作的动力学）与真实世界的差距可能仍需进一步在实物上验证。

title: MAMVI: 3D Test-Time Adaptation via Masked Multi-View Point Clouds
summary: 3D point cloud models suffer significant performance degradation under distribution shifts caused by sensor noise, occlusions, and environmental changes. Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a practical paradigm for mitigating this issue during inference. Recently, leveraging multi-view augmentation has shown promise in improving 3D TTA performance. However, existing multi-view approaches are often constrained by sequential optimization that treats each view independently. This sequential optimization leads to substantial inference latency due to repetitive optimization steps, making real-time adaptation impractical. To address this, we propose Masked Multi-View Test-Time Adaptation (MAMVI), which replaces sequential optimization with a unified single-step adaptation. Specifically, MAMVI utilizes a hybrid masking strategy that combines fixed ratios for stability with Beta-distributed sampling for diversity. By aggregating losses across multiple views, MAMVI performs adaptation through a single backward pass based on multi-view consensus. Additionally, a confidence-based adaptive learning rate is used to dynamically adjust the adaptation intensity for each sample. Extensive experiments on ModelNet-40C, ShapeNet-C, and ScanObjectNN-C demonstrate that MAMVI achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on ShapeNet-C and ScanObjectNN-C. Moreover, it remains competitive on ModelNet-40C while delivering 4.9-8.9 times faster inference, making it highly suitable for real-time applications. Our code is available at https://github.com/Inseok-kong/MAMVI

AI.title_translation: MAMVI：通过掩蔽多视图点云进行3D测试时自适应
AI.tldr: MAMVI通过统一的单步自适应和混合掩蔽策略，显著加速了3D点云模型的测试时自适应，同时保持或提高了性能，使其适用于实时应用。
AI.motivation: 3D点云模型在由传感器噪声、遮挡和环境变化引起的分布偏移下，性能会显著下降。现有的多视图测试时自适应（TTA）方法通常采用顺序优化，独立处理每个视图，导致重复的优化步骤和高推理延迟，使得实时自适应不切实际。
AI.method: 本文提出了掩蔽多视图测试时自适应（MAMVI），用统一的单步自适应取代了传统的顺序优化。MAMVI采用混合掩蔽策略，结合固定比例（用于稳定性）和Beta分布采样（用于多样性）。通过聚合多个视图的损失，MAMVI基于多视图共识通过单次反向传播执行自适应。此外，它还使用基于置信度的自适应学习率来动态调整每个样本的自适应强度。
AI.result: 在ModelNet-40C、ShapeNet-C和ScanObjectNN-C上的实验表明，MAMVI在ShapeNet-C和ScanObjectNN-C上取得了最先进的精度，并在ModelNet-40C上保持竞争力。同时，它实现了4.9-8.9倍的推理速度提升。
AI.conclusion: MAMVI通过引入统一的单步自适应和创新的掩蔽策略，显著提高了3D测试时自适应的效率，使其在保持或提高性能的同时，能够满足实时应用的需求。
AI.translation: 3D点云模型在由传感器噪声、遮挡和环境变化引起的分布偏移下，性能会显著下降。测试时自适应（TTA）已成为在推理过程中缓解此问题的实用范例。最近，利用多视图增强在改善3D TTA性能方面显示出前景。然而，现有的多视图方法通常受到顺序优化的限制，即独立处理每个视图。这种顺序优化由于重复的优化步骤导致大量的推理延迟，使得实时自适应不切实际。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了掩蔽多视图测试时自适应（MAMVI），它用统一的单步自适应取代了顺序优化。具体来说，MAMVI利用混合掩蔽策略，结合固定比例以实现稳定性，以及Beta分布采样以实现多样性。通过聚合多个视图的损失，MAMVI基于多视图共识通过单次反向传播执行自适应。此外，还使用基于置信度的自适应学习率来动态调整每个样本的自适应强度。在ModelNet-40C、ShapeNet-C和ScanObjectNN-C上的大量实验表明，MAMVI在ShapeNet-C和ScanObjectNN-C上取得了最先进的精度。此外，它在ModelNet-40C上保持竞争力，同时推理速度快4.9-8.9倍，使其非常适合实时应用。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Inseok-kong/MAMVI 获取。
AI.summary: MAMVI提出了一种用于3D点云模型的测试时自适应（TTA）新方法，旨在解决现有多视图TTA方法因顺序优化导致的推理延迟问题。MAMVI通过引入统一的单步自适应、结合固定比例和Beta分布采样的混合掩蔽策略，以及基于置信度的自适应学习率，实现了基于多视图共识的单次反向传播自适应。实验证明，MAMVI在保持或提高精度的同时，显著提升了推理速度（4.9-8.9倍），使其适用于实时3D点云自适应任务。
AI.keywords: 3D点云, 测试时自适应, 多视图, 掩蔽, 实时应用
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了MAMVI，通过将传统的顺序多视图优化替换为统一的单步自适应，显著解决了3D TTA的实时性问题。其混合掩蔽策略和基于置信度的学习率设计巧妙，在保证稳定性和多样性的同时，提高了自适应效率。对于需要实时处理3D点云分布偏移的应用，如自动驾驶或机器人，MAMVI具有重要的实用价值。

title: Self-Guidance: Enhancing Neural Codecs via Decoder Manifold Alignment
comments: 20 pages, 9 figures, accepted to ICML 2026, demo website available at https://sgvqvae.github.io/sgvqvae-demo
summary: Neural speech codecs based on Vector-Quantized VAEs (VQ-VAEs) are core audio tokenizers for speech LLMs, yet their reconstruction fidelity is bottlenecked by quantization error. Modifying the quantizer or increasing model capacity are common fixes, but they complicate downstream language modeling. Our core idea is to align the decoder's internal feature manifolds when processing both the quantized tokens and their original continuous embeddings, using a lightweight feature-mapping loss. This requires minimal training overhead and no inference-time changes. Applied to XCodec2, self-guidance improves all reconstruction metrics, achieving state-of-the-art low-bitrate performance. Notably, it enables a 4x codebook reduction without fidelity loss, which downstream TTS experiments show significantly improves LLM-based synthesis by simplifying the token modeling space. Multiple statistical observations and visualizations corroborate the enhanced internal manifold alignment in the decoder. Extensive experiments confirm its generality across various inductive biases. Self-guidance thus establishes an efficient, broadly applicable method for high-fidelity neural audio coding.
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, accepted to ICML 2026, demo website available at https://sgvqvae.github.io/sgvqvae-demo

AI.title_translation: 自我引导：通过解码器流形对齐增强神经编解码器
AI.tldr: 本文提出“自我引导”方法，通过在训练中对齐解码器处理量化前后特征的内部流形，在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升神经音频编解码器的重构质量，并支持4倍码本缩减以简化下游语音大模型的建模。
AI.motivation: 基于VQ-VAE的神经语音编解码器是语音大模型的核心分词器，但其重构保真度受到量化误差的限制。传统的改进方法（如修改量化器或增加模型容量）会增加下游语言建模的复杂度，因此需要一种既能提高保真度又不会使推理或下游任务复杂化的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出“自我引导”（Self-Guidance）方法，核心是通过一个轻量级的特征映射损失（feature-mapping loss），在训练时对齐解码器在处理“量化后的标记”与“原始连续嵌入”时的内部特征流形。该方法仅在训练期引入极小的开销，而在推理期不需要任何修改。
AI.result:
1. 在XCodec2上应用后，提升了所有重构指标，实现了最先进的低比特率性能；
2. 在不损失保真度的前提下，实现了4倍的码本（codebook）规模缩减；
3. 下游TTS实验表明，由于简化了Token建模空间，显著提升了基于LLM的语音合成质量；
4. 统计观察、可视化及广泛的实验证实了解码器内部流形对齐的有效性及其在不同归纳偏置下的通用性。
AI.conclusion: 自我引导（Self-Guidance）为高保真神经音频编码提供了一种高效、通用且无推理开销的新方法，并能有效助力下游语音大语言模型的合成任务。
AI.translation: 基于向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAEs）的神经语音编解码器是语音大语言模型（LLMs）的核心音频分词器（tokenizers），但它们的重构保真度受到量化误差的瓶颈限制。修改量化器或增加模型容量是常见的解决办法，但它们会使下游语言建模变得复杂。我们的核心思想是，利用轻量级的特征映射损失，对齐解码器在处理量化标记及其原始连续嵌入时的内部特征流形。这只需要极小的训练开销，且无需在推理时进行任何更改。应用于 XCodec2 时，自我引导提升了所有重构指标，实现了最先进的低比特率性能。值得注意的是，它在不损失保真度的前提下实现了 4 倍的码本缩减，下游文本转语音（TTS）实验表明，这通过简化标记建模空间，显著改善了基于 LLM 的合成。多项统计观察和可视化证实了解码器中增强的内部流形对齐。广泛的实验证实了其在各种归纳偏置中的通用性。因此，自我引导为高保真神经音频编码确立了一种高效、适用广泛的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“自我引导”（Self-Guidance）的神经音频编解码器增强方法。针对VQ-VAE编解码器中量化误差限制重构质量的问题，该方法在训练时通过轻量级特征映射损失，将解码器处理量化标记和原始连续嵌入时的内部特征流形进行对齐。该方法在推理时不增加任何开销，不仅在XCodec2上实现了SOTA的低比特率重构性能，还允许将码本大小缩减4倍，从而简化了下游语音LLM的建模空间，显著提升了语音合成效果。
AI.keywords: 神经语音编解码器, 向量量化, 流形对齐, 自我引导, 语音大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种非常优雅且实用的方法。通过在训练阶段引入轻量级的特征映射损失来对齐流形，既解决了量化误差带来的保真度损失，又避免了在推理阶段增加任何计算开销。此外，能够将码本大小缩减4倍而不失真，对下游语音大模型（Speech LLM）的离散Token建模来说是一个巨大的利好，能显著降低序列建模的复杂度，具有很强的应用价值。

title: Multi-Turn Reasoning When Context Arrives in Pieces: Scalable Sharding and Memory-Augmented RL
summary: When a user reveals task-critical information across several conversation turns, LLM accuracy drops by up to 65% despite full context availability. We show that this Lost in Conversation degradation can be substantially mitigated by training models to maintain a compact rolling memory instead of attending to a growing history. To make such training scalable, we introduce a low-cost sharding pipeline that converts single-turn QA datasets into multi-turn fragmented-information episodes, eliminating the need for hours of manual annotation. Training only on sharded GSM8K, our memory-augmented policy significantly improves multi-turn accuracy and generalises zero-shot to harder math and out-of-domain long-context QA. Moreover, memory-trained models outperform full-history baselines even when given the full history at test time, suggesting that learning to compress induces more robust incremental reasoning than full-context exposure alone.

AI.title_translation: 当上下文分段到达时的多轮推理：可扩展的分片和记忆增强型强化学习
AI.tldr: 当上下文分段到达时，LLM在多轮对话中的准确性会显著下降。本研究通过训练模型维护紧凑的滚动记忆，并引入低成本分片管道来创建多轮训练数据，从而有效缓解了这一问题。记忆增强模型在多轮推理任务中表现出色，甚至优于完整历史基线。
AI.motivation: 当用户在多轮对话中逐渐揭示任务关键信息时，即使提供了完整的上下文，大型语言模型（LLM）的准确性也会下降高达65%，即“对话中迷失”现象。本研究的动机是缓解这种性能下降。
AI.method: 本研究通过训练模型维护一个紧凑的滚动记忆来替代关注不断增长的历史，从而减轻“对话中迷失”的退化。为了使这种训练可扩展，研究引入了一个低成本的分片管道，将单轮QA数据集转换为多轮分段信息情景，消除了手动注释的需求。模型在分片后的GSM8K数据集上进行训练，采用了记忆增强策略。
AI.result: 1. 记忆增强策略显著提高了多轮准确性。2. 模型零样本泛化到更难的数学问题和域外长上下文QA任务。3. 即使在测试时提供了完整的历史，记忆训练的模型也优于完整历史基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 训练模型学习压缩信息能够诱导比单独暴露于完整上下文更鲁棒的增量推理能力，从而有效缓解了多轮对话中上下文分段到达导致的LLM准确性下降问题。
AI.translation: 当用户在几次对话轮次中揭示任务关键信息时，即使提供了完整的上下文，LLM的准确性也会下降高达65%。我们发现，通过训练模型维护一个紧凑的滚动记忆而不是关注不断增长的历史，可以显著缓解这种“对话中迷失”的退化。为了使这种训练具有可扩展性，我们引入了一个低成本的分片管道，将单轮QA数据集转换为多轮分段信息情景，从而消除了数小时手动注释的需要。仅在分片后的GSM8K上进行训练，我们的记忆增强策略显著提高了多轮准确性，并零样本泛化到更难的数学和域外长上下文QA任务。此外，即使在测试时提供了完整的历史，经过记忆训练的模型也优于完整历史基线，这表明学习压缩会比单独暴露于完整上下文诱导出更鲁棒的增量推理。
AI.summary: 本研究解决了大型语言模型在多轮对话中上下文分段到达时准确性显著下降的问题。作者提出了一种通过训练模型维护紧凑滚动记忆的策略，并开发了一个低成本的分片管道，将单轮QA数据集转换为多轮情景，以实现可扩展的训练。实验结果表明，该记忆增强策略显著提高了多轮推理的准确性，并能零样本泛化到其他复杂任务，甚至在提供完整历史时也优于基线模型，表明学习压缩能促进更鲁棒的增量推理。
AI.keywords: 多轮推理, 记忆增强, 分片, 强化学习, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个有效的解决方案来解决LLM在多轮对话中因上下文分段到达而导致的“对话中迷失”问题。通过引入滚动记忆和低成本分片管道，该方法不仅提高了模型的准确性和泛化能力，还解决了多轮训练数据标注成本高昂的问题。其发现“学习压缩比完整上下文暴露能诱导更鲁棒的增量推理”具有重要的理论意义和实践价值。

title: PRISMR: Overcoming Parse Collapse in Multimodal Listwise Ranking via Parameterized Representation Internalization
summary:
Generative listwise ranking with Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) aims to capture global list context in a single forward pass, but
  its effectiveness degrades in long-context multimodal scenarios. We identify a recurring failure mode, parse collapse, where the
  autoregressive decoder produces fluent yet incomplete rankings by silently omitting candidates and terminating early. This
  failure stems from limited context utilization rather than simple formatting mistakes, making prompt engineering and constrained
  decoding insufficient. We propose PRISMR (Parameterized Representation Internalization for Semantic Multimodal Ranking), a
  framework that replaces transient in-context list processing with parametric structural conditioning. PRISMR uses a lightweight
  hypernetwork to encode multimodal candidates in parallel and generate item-specific LoRA weights, which are synthesized into an
  instance-specific adapter for a LMM. This paradigm enables more robust internalization of list structure while preserving the
  base model. We further introduce a large-scale multimodal review-ranking benchmark for evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that
  PRISMR substantially reduces parse collapse, improves listwise ranking performance, and transfers effectively across domains and
  instruction-tuned backbones.

AI.title_translation: PRISMR：通过参数化表示内化克服多模态列表式排序中的解析崩溃
AI.tldr: PRISMR是一个框架，通过将瞬态上下文列表处理替换为参数化结构条件，解决了大型多模态模型在长上下文多模态场景中列表式排序的“解析崩溃”问题，显著提高了性能。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）在长上下文多模态场景中，其生成式列表式排序的有效性会下降。研究发现，存在一种反复出现的失败模式，即“解析崩溃”，其中自回归解码器会产生流畅但不完整的排序，通过默默省略候选并提前终止。这种失败源于有限的上下文利用，而不仅仅是简单的格式错误。
AI.method: PRISMR（Parameterized Representation Internalization for Semantic Multimodal Ranking）框架用参数化结构条件取代了瞬态上下文列表处理。PRISMR使用一个轻量级超网络并行编码多模态候选，并生成特定于项目的LoRA权重，这些权重被合成为LMM的实例特定适配器。这种范式能够更稳健地内化列表结构，同时保留基础模型。
AI.result: PRISMR显著减少了“解析崩溃”，提高了列表式排序性能，并且在不同领域和指令调优骨干网络之间有效迁移。研究还引入了一个大规模多模态评论排序基准进行评估。
AI.conclusion: PRISMR框架通过参数化表示内化有效解决了大型多模态模型在长上下文列表式排序中的“解析崩溃”问题，显著提高了性能和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）的生成式列表式排序旨在通过一次前向传播捕获全局列表上下文，但其在长上下文多模态场景中的有效性会下降。我们发现了一种反复出现的失败模式，即解析崩溃，其中自回归解码器通过默默省略候选并提前终止来产生流畅但不完整的排序。这种失败源于有限的上下文利用，而不仅仅是简单的格式错误，使得提示工程和约束解码不足以解决问题。我们提出了PRISMR（Parameterized Representation Internalization for Semantic Multimodal Ranking），一个通过参数化结构条件取代瞬态上下文列表处理的框架。PRISMR使用一个轻量级超网络并行编码多模态候选，并生成特定于项目的LoRA权重，这些权重被合成为LMM的实例特定适配器。这种范式能够更稳健地内化列表结构，同时保留基础模型。我们进一步引入了一个大规模多模态评论排序基准进行评估。实验表明，PRISMR显著减少了分析崩溃，提高了列表式排序性能，并在不同领域和指令调优骨干网络之间有效迁移。
AI.summary: 本文提出PRISMR框架，旨在解决大型多模态模型在长上下文列表式排序中出现的“解析崩溃”问题。该问题表现为模型生成不完整或过早终止的排序，原因在于上下文利用不足。PRISMR通过引入参数化表示内化，利用轻量级超网络生成实例特定的LoRA权重适配器，从而更有效地内化列表结构并保持基础模型。实验证明，PRISMR显著降低了“解析崩溃”率，提高了排序性能，并展现出良好的跨领域和跨骨干网络泛化能力。为此，研究还构建了一个大规模多模态评论排序基准。
AI.keywords: 多模态排序, 解析崩溃, 参数化表示, LoRA, 大型多模态模型
AI.comments: PRISMR的创新之处在于通过参数化表示内化，将列表结构信息以参数化的方式融入LMM，而非依赖不稳定的上下文处理。这种方法有效解决了“解析崩溃”这一特定且重要的失败模式，提升了长上下文多模态排序的鲁棒性和性能。其引入的轻量级超网络生成LoRA权重适配器，在保持基础模型的同时实现了高效的结构学习，具有较高的实用价值。

title: Testing Theory of Truly Concurrent Processes
summary: A process is able to execute a set of actions with a predefined manner, while a truly concurrent process executes this set of actions with a manner with the flavour of true concurrency. The so-called truly concurrent process algebras bridge the true concurrency (such as Petri nets, event structures, etc), and the interleaving concurrency (such as CCS, CSP, ACP, etc). In this paper, we give truly concurrent processes testing semantics followed by Hennessy's great work, which inherits the trinity of operational semantics, axiomatic semantics and denotational semantics.

AI.title_translation: 真正并发进程的测试理论
AI.tldr: 本文基于Hennessy的工作，为真正并发进程提供了测试语义，并继承了操作语义、公理语义和指称语义的三位一体。
AI.motivation: 真正的并发进程代数旨在弥合真实并发（如Petri网、事件结构）和交错并发（如CCS、CSP、ACP）之间的鸿沟。本文的动机是为真正的并发进程提供测试语义。
AI.method: 遵循Hennessy的开创性工作，为真正并发进程提供测试语义。
AI.result: 所提出的测试语义继承了操作语义、公理语义和指称语义的三位一体。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地为真正并发进程提供了测试语义，并确保了与现有语义框架的兼容性（即继承了操作语义、公理语义和指称语义的三位一体）。
AI.translation: 进程能够以预定义的方式执行一组动作，而真正并发的进程则以具有真实并发特性的方式执行这组动作。所谓的真正并发进程代数弥合了真实并发（如Petri网、事件结构等）和交错并发（如CCS、CSP、ACP等）之间的鸿沟。在本文中，我们遵循Hennessy的伟大工作，给出了真正并发进程的测试语义，该语义继承了操作语义、公理语义和指称语义的三位一体。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了真正并发进程的测试理论。作者指出，真正的并发进程代数旨在连接真实并发模型（如Petri网）和交错并发模型（如CCS）。基于Hennessy的开创性工作，文章为真正的并发进程提供了测试语义，该语义保留了操作语义、公理语义和指称语义的统一性。
AI.keywords: 真正并发进程, 测试语义, 并发代数, Hennessy, 语义三位一体
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将Hennessy的测试语义框架应用于真正并发进程，这对于理解和分析这类进程的行为具有重要意义。通过继承操作、公理和指称语义的三位一体，该工作确保了理论的完备性和一致性。

title: Learning What to Remember: A Cognitively Grounded Multi-Factor Value Model for Agentic Memory
summary: Long-running LLM agents accumulate interaction histories far larger than any context window, forcing a standing decision: what to encode deeply, what to forget, and what to retrieve under a fixed memory budget. Production systems answer with semantic similarity or recency -- both mis-specified for the forgetting decision, which is made at consolidation time before the future query is known. We propose a multi-factor memory value function V(m)=\sum_i w_i f_i(m) over seven interpretable factors (emotional intensity, goal relevance, value alignment, self/user relevance, task utility, reliability, and usage history) drawn from cognitive psychology, whose weights are learned from a downstream objective by a gradient-free optimiser, and whose single scalar uniformly controls encoding depth, forget risk, and retrieval rank. We make a methodological point: on LongMemEval, scoring goal relevance against the held-out evaluation question saturates gold-evidence retention at \approx 0.98 -- this measures retrieval, not forgetting. In the realistic blind regime, a learned multi-factor value retains 0.770 \pm 0.011 of gold evidence across 479 usable cases, versus 0.657 for uniform weights, 0.518 for the best single factor, and 0.368 for recency; every paired gap's 95% bootstrap CI is above zero, and a neural network over the same factors ties the linear model. The learned weights are interpretable -- reliability, emotional intensity, and self/user relevance dominate, while query-time goal similarity is correctly down-weighted for the forgetting decision. A controlled synthetic task with planted confounds confirms the learner recovers a separating weighting (1.00 retention) where uniform weighting fails (0.62). The substrate is open-source; all experiments run on a single CPU with no API calls.

AI.title_translation: 学习记住什么：一种基于认知学的多因素价值模型用于智能体记忆
AI.tldr: 提出一个基于认知学的多因素价值函数来控制LLM智能体的记忆（编码深度、遗忘风险和检索排名），在现实场景中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的LLM智能体积累的交互历史远超上下文窗口限制，因此需要有效决策记忆什么、遗忘什么以及在有限记忆预算下检索什么。现有的生产系统（基于语义相似性或新近度）在遗忘决策上存在不足，因为遗忘决策是在整合时做出，而未来的查询是未知的。
AI.method: 提出一个基于认知心理学的多因素记忆价值函数 V(m)=\sum_i w_i f_i(m)，包含情感强度、目标相关性、价值对齐、自我/用户相关性、任务效用、可靠性和使用历史七个可解释因素。这些因素的权重通过无梯度优化器从下游目标学习，其单一标量统一控制记忆的编码深度、遗忘风险和检索排名。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval上，对未知查询评估目标相关性（衡量检索）可使黄金证据保留率达到约0.98。在现实盲测情境下，学习到的多因素价值模型在479个可用案例中保留了0.770 ± 0.011的黄金证据，显著优于统一权重（0.657）、最佳单一因素（0.518）和新近度（0.368）。所有成对差距的95%自举置信区间均大于零。基于相同因素的神经网络模型与线性模型表现相当。学习到的权重可解释：可靠性、情感强度和自我/用户相关性占主导，查询时目标相似性在遗忘决策中被正确降权。一个有混淆因素的合成任务证实，学习器能恢复分离权重（1.00保留率），而统一权重失败（0.62）。所有实验在单个CPU上运行，无API调用。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功开发并验证了一种基于认知学的多因素记忆价值模型，该模型通过学习权重来有效管理LLM智能体的记忆，在现实场景中表现显著优于传统方法，并提供了可解释的记忆决策机制，为解决长时运行LLM智能体的记忆瓶颈提供了有效方案。
AI.translation: 长期运行的LLM智能体积累的交互历史远大于任何上下文窗口，这迫使它们做出一个持续的决定：在固定的记忆预算下，什么应该被深度编码，什么应该被遗忘，什么应该被检索。生产系统通常使用语义相似性或新近度来回答这些问题——但这两种方法对于遗忘决策来说都是错误的，因为遗忘决策是在整合时做出的，而未来的查询是未知的。我们提出了一个基于七个可解释因素（情感强度、目标相关性、价值对齐、自我/用户相关性、任务效用、可靠性和使用历史）的多因素记忆价值函数 V(m)=\sum_i w_i f_i(m)，这些因素来源于认知心理学，其权重通过无梯度优化器从下游目标学习，并且其单一标量统一控制编码深度、遗忘风险和检索排名。我们提出了一个方法论观点：在LongMemEval上，针对保留的评估问题进行目标相关性评分可以使黄金证据保留率达到约0.98——这衡量的是检索，而非遗忘。在现实的盲测情境下，一个学习到的多因素价值模型在479个可用案例中保留了0.770 ± 0.011的黄金证据，而统一权重为0.657，最佳单一因素为0.518，新近度为0.368；每个成对差距的95%自举置信区间都大于零，并且基于相同因素的神经网络模型与线性模型表现相当。学习到的权重是可解释的——可靠性、情感强度和自我/用户相关性占主导地位，而查询时的目标相似性在遗忘决策中被正确地降权。一个植入混淆因素的受控合成任务证实，学习器恢复了一个分离权重（1.00保留率），而统一权重则失败（0.62）。底层代码是开源的；所有实验都在单个CPU上运行，没有API调用。
AI.summary: 这篇论文提出了一种基于认知心理学的多因素记忆价值模型，用于解决长时运行LLM智能体在有限记忆预算下如何有效管理记忆的问题。该模型通过学习七个可解释因素的权重，统一控制记忆的编码深度、遗忘风险和检索排名。实验结果表明，该模型在现实场景中显著优于传统的语义相似性或新近度方法，并提供了可解释的记忆决策机制，为LLM智能体的记忆管理提供了一种有效且高效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 记忆管理, 多因素价值模型, 认知心理学, 遗忘决策
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将认知心理学中的记忆理论引入到LLM智能体的记忆管理中，并提出了一个可学习的多因素价值函数。该方法不仅在性能上显著优于现有技术，更重要的是，其学习到的权重具有良好的可解释性，揭示了哪些因素对于智能体的记忆决策至关重要。此外，该研究强调了遗忘决策与检索决策的区别，并提供了一个在资源有限（单CPU、无API调用）环境下实现的开源解决方案，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Data Aphasia: An Institutional Counterfactual Study of the Stability of Academic Cognition Under Letter-Grade Evaluation Systems
summary: Does the letter-grade evaluation system, while achieving its burden-reduction goals, affect the education system's stable understanding of students' academic structures? This paper introduces the concept of "data aphasia," referring to restrictions on diagnostic information expression caused by institutionally mandated forms of data presentation. Using data from 68 mathematics examinations administered to 75 primary school students, we employ an institutional counterfactual simulation method to convert percentage scores into A/B/C/D letter grades and conduct systematic tests at the information, structural, and diagnostic levels. Results show that information entropy decreases by approximately 69% after grade conversion; under the full sample, the letter-grade system appears superficially stable (K=4), but removing a single extreme anchor student causes the optimal K to increase from 4 to 8 and individual diagnostic identity consistency to fall from 95% to 62%; temporal consistency fluctuates between 52% and 96%, far below the 93%-96% baseline of the percentage system. Mechanism analysis indicates that discretization compresses the feature space by approximately nineteenfold across 68 examinations; after standardization, it creates extensive pseudo-heterogeneity regions, flattens density gradients, and makes clustering boundaries highly sensitive to minor perturbations. Based on these findings, this paper proposes a dual-track evaluation mechanism and provides a testable analytical framework for understanding the cognitive costs of educational evaluation reform.

AI.title_translation: 数据失语症：字母等级评估系统下学术认知稳定性的制度反事实研究
AI.tldr: 字母等级评估系统在减轻负担的同时，显著降低了诊断信息表达，导致对学生学术结构理解的稳定性下降，并通过离散化压缩特征空间、创建伪异质性区域，使聚类边界对扰动高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 探讨字母等级评估系统在实现减负目标的同时，是否影响教育系统对学生学术结构稳定理解。
AI.method: 利用75名小学生的68次数学考试数据，采用制度反事实模拟方法，将百分制分数转换为A/B/C/D字母等级，并在信息、结构和诊断层面进行系统测试。
AI.result: 信息熵在等级转换后减少约69%；在全样本下，字母等级系统表面稳定（K=4），但移除一个极端锚点学生后，最佳K值从4增至8，个体诊断一致性从95%降至62%；时间一致性在52%至96%之间波动，远低于百分制系统的93%-96%基线。离散化将特征空间压缩约19倍，并产生广泛的伪异质性区域，使聚类边界对微小扰动高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 字母等级评估系统通过限制诊断信息表达，显著影响了教育系统对学生学术结构的稳定理解。论文提出了双轨评估机制和可测试的分析框架。
AI.translation: 字母等级评估系统在实现其减负目标的同时，是否会影响教育系统对学生学术结构的稳定理解？本文引入了“数据失语症”的概念，指的是由制度强制的数据呈现形式所造成的诊断信息表达限制。我们使用来自75名小学生68次数学考试的数据，采用制度反事实模拟方法，将百分制分数转换为A/B/C/D字母等级，并在信息、结构和诊断层面进行系统测试。结果显示，等级转换后信息熵减少了约69%；在全样本下，字母等级系统表面上是稳定的（K=4），但移除一个极端锚点学生会导致最佳K从4增加到8，个体诊断身份一致性从95%下降到62%；时间一致性在52%到96%之间波动，远低于百分制系统93%-96%的基线。机制分析表明，离散化在68次考试中将特征空间压缩了大约19倍；标准化后，它创建了广泛的伪异质性区域，使得密度梯度趋于平坦，并使聚类边界对微小扰动高度敏感。基于这些发现，本文提出了一种双轨评估机制，并为理解教育评估改革的认知成本提供了一个可测试的分析框架。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了字母等级评估系统对学生学术结构理解稳定性的影响。通过对小学数学考试数据进行反事实模拟，将百分制转换为字母等级，发现等级转换导致信息熵大幅下降，对学生学术结构的诊断稳定性、个体诊断一致性和时间一致性均产生负面影响。机制分析表明，离散化压缩了特征空间并产生了伪异质性区域，使得评估结果对扰动异常敏感。论文提出了双轨评估机制以应对这些认知成本。
AI.keywords: 数据失语症, 字母等级评估, 学术认知稳定性, 制度反事实, 离散化
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了“数据失语症”概念，揭示了字母等级评估系统在简化评估的同时，如何以牺牲诊断信息为代价，削弱了教育系统对学生学术结构理解的稳定性。其通过制度反事实模拟和多层面分析，量化了信息损失和结构不稳定性的程度，并深入探讨了离散化带来的机制问题。这项研究对于理解教育评估改革的潜在认知成本及其对教学实践的影响具有重要意义，提出的双轨评估机制也具有实践指导价值。

title: ViPER: Vision-based Packing-Aware Encoder for Robust Malware Detection
summary: Visualization-based malware detection maps raw binary bytes to grayscale images and applies learned visual classifiers, providing an evasion-resistant and disassembly-free alternative to conventional analysis pipelines. However, executable packing remains a critical failure mode: packed binaries produce high-entropy images that obscure the structural patterns these models rely on. Because packing is also prevalent in benign software (e.g., for compression or copy protection), packing state alone is not a reliable indicator of maliciousness, and existing approaches do not address this challenge within a unified supervised framework. We present ViPER, a Vision-based Packing-Aware Encoder for Robust malware detection. ViPER builds on a LoRA-adapted ViT-B/14 backbone with a dual-head architecture that jointly learns malware classification and packing detection. A packing-aware gating mechanism conditions malware predictions on the inferred packing state, enabling distinct decision boundaries for packed and unpacked inputs. To address packing label skew during training, we employ frequency-weighted losses with stratified sampling over joint class-packing strata. Evaluated on 200,000 Windows PE byteplot images, ViPER achieves a balanced accuracy of 0.8521, ROC-AUC of 0.9260, and AUPR of 0.9279, outperforming representative state-of-the-art baselines across all primary metrics, while attaining a packing detection AUC of 0.9949.

AI.title_translation: 基于视觉的感知打包的编码器，用于鲁棒的恶意软件检测
AI.tldr: ViPER通过结合视觉编码和打包感知机制，解决了现有恶意软件检测方法在处理被压缩的可执行文件时遇到的困难，取得了优异的检测效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于视觉的恶意软件检测方法在面对被压缩的可执行文件时效果不佳，因为压缩后的文件会生成高熵图像，掩盖了模型依赖的结构模式。然而，压缩本身并不直接指示恶意性，因此需要一个统一的监督框架来解决这个问题。
AI.method: ViPER采用了一个基于LoRA的ViT-B/14骨干网络，并设计了一个双头架构，能够同时学习恶意软件分类和压缩检测。其核心是一个压缩感知门控机制，它根据推断出的压缩状态来调整恶意软件的预测，从而为压缩和未压缩的输入建立不同的决策边界。为了解决训练过程中压缩标签的偏差问题，ViPER采用了频率加权损失和分层采样策略。
AI.result: 在20万个Windows PE的byteplot图像上进行评估，ViPER在恶意软件检测方面取得了0.8521的平衡准确率、0.9260的ROC-AUC和0.9279的AUPR，在所有主要指标上均优于代表性的最先进基线方法。同时，其压缩检测的AUC达到了0.9949。
AI.conclusion: ViPER通过引入一个能够感知压缩状态的视觉编码器，成功地提高了在面对被压缩的可执行文件时的恶意软件检测鲁棒性，并且在压缩检测方面也表现出色。
AI.translation: 基于视觉的恶意软件检测将原始二进制字节映射到灰度图像，并应用学习到的视觉分类器，为传统的分析流程提供了一种抗逃避且无需反汇编的替代方案。然而，可执行文件的压缩仍然是一个关键的失败模式：压缩后的二进制文件会产生高熵图像，掩盖了这些模型所依赖的结构模式。由于压缩在良性软件中也很普遍（例如，用于压缩或复制保护），仅压缩状态本身并不是恶意性的可靠指标，并且现有方法并未在统一的监督框架内解决这一挑战。我们提出了ViPER，一个用于鲁棒恶意软件检测的基于视觉的感知打包的编码器。ViPER基于一个LoRA适配的ViT-B/14骨干网络，具有一个双头架构，能够同时学习恶意软件分类和压缩检测。一个感知压缩的门控机制根据推断出的压缩状态来调整恶意软件预测，从而实现压缩和未压缩输入的区分决策边界。为了解决训练期间的压缩标签偏差问题，我们采用了频率加权损失和跨联合类别-压缩分层的采样。在200,000个Windows PE的byteplot图像上进行评估，ViPER实现了0.8521的平衡准确率、0.9260的ROC-AUC和0.9279的AUPR，在所有主要指标上均优于代表性的最先进基线，同时达到了0.9949的压缩检测AUC。
AI.summary: ViPER是一种新颖的视觉编码器，专门用于提高恶意软件检测的鲁棒性，特别是在处理被压缩的可执行文件时。它通过一个双头架构，同时进行恶意软件分类和压缩状态检测，并利用一个压缩感知门控机制来根据压缩状态调整检测决策。为了克服训练中的挑战，ViPER采用了频率加权损失和分层采样。实验结果表明，ViPER在准确性和AUC等关键指标上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 恶意软件检测, 视觉编码, 可执行文件压缩, ViT, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该研究有效地解决了恶意软件检测领域的一个关键挑战——处理被压缩的可执行文件。ViPER提出的压缩感知门控机制和针对训练数据偏差的解决方案具有创新性。然而，在实际部署中，该模型在计算资源和检测延迟方面的表现仍有待进一步评估。

title: Maestro: Workload-Aware Cross-Cluster Scheduling for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
comments: Accepted to the 46th IEEE International Conference on Distributed Computing Systems (ICDCS 2026). 11 pages
summary: Large Language Model based Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for tackling complex tasks by breaking them into collaborative workflows of specialized LLM-powered agents. However, deploying such multi-agent workloads at scale poses significant system challenges. Each user query spawns an iterative pipeline of LLM calls, greatly amplifying resource consumption compared to single-turn queries. In resource-constrained cloud settings, these workflows face non-deterministic and input-dependent costs at decode stage, heavy-tailed multi-model requirements with memory fragmentation and over-provisioning, and cross-cluster scheduling trade-offs. We present Maestro, a workload-aware scheduling system designed for LLM-MAS serving under strict GPU budgets. Maestro explicitly leverages agent semantics and roles: it predicts the output length and memory usage of each stage and uses this prediction to drive a hierarchical scheduler. At the node level, Maestro enables dynamic multi-model co-location via hierarchical weight caching and elastic memory provisioning. At the cluster level, it performs latency-aware routing to avoid cold-start delays and memory overloads. At the global level, it enforces workflow-aware prioritization to minimize head-of-line blocking for interactive tasks. Across prototype experiments and trace-driven simulations, Maestro reduces KV-reservation HBM by 67.2% and improves high-contention SLO attainment over EDF by 23.6 percentage points.
comment: Accepted to the 46th IEEE International Conference on Distributed Computing Systems (ICDCS 2026). 11 pages

AI.title_translation: Maestro：面向大模型多智能体系统的工作负载感知跨集群调度系统
AI.tldr: Maestro 通过预测多智能体任务的资源需求并进行分层调度，显著降低了 LLM-MAS 的 GPU 内存占用并提升了服务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）在部署时面临资源消耗巨大、非确定性成本、多模型内存碎片化以及跨集群调度困难等挑战，导致在资源受限环境下性能下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 Maestro 的 workload-aware 调度系统：在节点级实现基于分层权重缓存和弹性内存配置的动态多模型共存；在集群级进行延迟感知路由以避免冷启动和内存过载；在全局级实施工作流感知优先级排序以减少阻塞。
AI.result: 实验表明，Maestro 将 KV 缓存占用的高带宽内存（HBM）减少了 67.2%，并将高争用情况下的服务等级目标（SLO）达标率提升了 23.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Maestro 通过 workload-aware 的分层调度机制，在 GPU 资源受限的情况下显著提升了 LLM-MAS 的资源利用率和 SLO 达标率。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）已成为通过将复杂任务分解为由 LLM 驱动的协作工作流来处理复杂任务的强大范式。然而，大规模部署此类多智能体工作负载带来了严峻的系统挑战。每个用户查询都会产生一个迭代的 LLM 调用流水线，与单轮查询相比，这极大地放大了资源消耗。在资源受限的云环境中，这些工作流面临着解码阶段非确定性和输入依赖的成本、具有内存碎片化和过度配置的重尾多模型需求，以及跨集群调度的权衡。我们提出了 Maestro，这是一个专为严格 GPU 预算下的 LLM-MAS 服务而设计的负载感知调度系统。Maestro 显式利用了智能体的语义和角色：它预测每个阶段的输出长度和内存使用情况，并使用此预测来驱动分层调度程序。在节点级别，Maestro 通过分层权重缓存和弹性内存配置实现动态多模型共存。在集群级别，它执行延迟感知路由以避免冷启动延迟和内存过载。在全局级别，它强制执行工作流感知优先级排序，以最大限度地减少交互式任务的队头阻塞。通过原型实验和基于跟踪的模拟，Maestro 将 KV 预留 HBM 减少了 67.2%，并将高争用下的 SLO 达标率比 EDF 提高了 23.6 个百分点。
AI.summary: Maestro 是一个专为 LLM 多智能体系统设计的 workload-aware 调度系统，通过预测智能体任务的输出长度和内存需求，在节点、集群和全局三个层级进行优化，有效解决了资源受限环境下的内存浪费和调度延迟问题。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 多智能体系统, 任务调度, GPU 资源管理, 分层调度
AI.comments: Maestro 针对 LLM 多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）独特的资源消耗模式（非确定性、输入依赖、多模型需求），提出了一种分层调度策略。其核心创新在于利用智能体语义进行预测，并结合分层缓存和弹性配置，有效地解决了多智能体系统在资源受限环境下的调度难题。这是一个在系统领域针对新兴 AI 应用场景的典型优化工作。

title: OpenMedQ: Broad Open Pretraining for Medical Vision-Language Models
comments: Medical Imaging with Deep Learning (MIDL) 2026, Short Paper Track
summary: We present OpenMedQ, a medical vision-language model pretrained on the broadest fully-open medical mix to date: 14 datasets totaling ~3.35M pretraining samples spanning pathology, radiology, microscopy, and text-only clinical QA. OpenMedQ reaches state-of-the-art BLEU-1 on PathVQA (75.9), beating Med-PaLM M variants up to 562B parameters (~80x larger), and matches the best reported VQA-MED BLEU-1 (64.5). Its vision encoder, transferred to 8 unseen medical classification benchmarks under an identical downstream recipe, obtains the highest average macro-F1 (0.757) among BiomedCLIP (0.745), PMC-CLIP (0.745), PubMedCLIP (0.746), and a from-scratch baseline (0.616). We release our code and an interactive demo is publicly available as a reproducible baseline for the community.
comment: Medical Imaging with Deep Learning (MIDL) 2026, Short Paper Track

title: Towards Reliable Sequential Object Picking in Clutter: The Runner-up Solution to RGMC 2025
comments: First, Second and Third Coauthor contributed equally to this work
summary: As a long-standing challenge in robotic manipulation, stable and efficient grasping in cluttered environments is of great importance in industrial settings. While recent studies have achieved relatively high success rates in grasping from clutter, there remain few mature solutions for more demanding tasks such as sequential object search and sorting. This work addresses sequential object picking in cluttered environments based on the Cluttered Environment Picking Benchmark (CEPB) and presents our solution to the Pick-in-Clutter track of the 10th Robotic Grasping and Manipulation Competition (RGMC) at ICRA 2025. The task poses several key challenges. First, it requires robust and collision-aware grasping with high success rates across a diverse set of objects, including both rigid and deformable ones. Second, it demands efficient search for target objects, which places stringent requirements on the decluttering and searching strategies of the solution. To address the above challenges, we design an integrated hardware-software pipeline that combines object recognition, decluttering, and multi-modal grasping. The main contributions include the hardware design of a multifunctional gripper and novel representations for object distribution and occlusion relationships in cluttered space. This pipeline enables efficient recognition, search, and sequential grasping of objects in clutter, demonstrating strong performance in both laboratory tests and competition scenarios, and ultimately achieving second place in the Pick-in-Clutter track of the RGMC 2025.
comment: First, Second and Third Coauthor contributed equally to this work

title: Data-Driven Frequency-Selective Output Regulation of Nonlinear Systems under Almost Periodic Exosignals
summary: This paper studies output regulation for a class of unknown continuous-time nonlinear systems driven by almost periodic exosignals. The plant dynamics are assumed to be linearly parameterized over a prescribed nonlinear dictionary, while all coefficient matrices in the plant, input channel, output map, and exosignal channel are unknown. Since the plant model is unavailable, exact nonlinear output regulation would generally require model identification followed by the solution of nonlinear regulator equations. To avoid these steps, we pursue a frequency-selective regulation objective: the steady-state regulation error is allowed to be almost periodic, but its Fourier-Bohr coefficients at prescribed exosystem frequencies are guaranteed to vanish, and the residual error energy is explicitly bounded. To this end, a p-copy internal model is embedded in a dynamic controller, yielding an augmented nonlinear system whose unknown constant matrices are represented directly by measured data. A noise-robust semidefinite program is derived to synthesize the controller gain without model identification and without measuring the exosignal amplitudes or phases. The resulting closed-loop vector field is made exponentially contractive on a prescribed operating set, which implies the existence and uniqueness of a bounded and attracting trajectory. By combining contraction theory with Fourier-Bohr analysis, we prove that this steady-state trajectory is almost periodic, that the embedded-frequency components of the regulation error are eliminated, and that the unmodeled spectral components satisfy a Parseval-type time-averaged energy bound. Numerical and physics-based simulations on a quadrotor with a cable-suspended payload illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed data-driven internal-model design.

title: SERF: Spatiotemporal Environment and Robot Feature Map for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robot mobile manipulation requires continual reasoning about localization, environment changes, and task progress, all of which are challenging to infer from image observations alone. In this paper, we show that conditioning a mobile manipulation policy on a spatiotemporal feature map improves reasoning over long horizons. The map represents the environment and the articulated robot body as neural points in a shared latent space and is updated online from egocentric observations and proprioceptive state. We update the environment neural points using object-level rigid tracking and the robot neural points using forward kinematics. We use our spatiotemporal environment and robot feature (SERF) map as a state input to a vision-language-action (VLA) model by extracting map tokens from multiple reference frames and spatial scales, providing the policy with both local and global context. We demonstrate SERF on BEHAVIOR-1K, a benchmark for long-horizon mobile manipulation in household environments. Experiments show that the SERF VLA policy outperforms image-only baselines, reaches subgoals faster by following more direct trajectories, improves robustness to scene-configuration shifts, and recovers from object-drop failures.

title: YOLO-AMC: An Improved YOLO Architecture with Attention Mechanisms for Building Crack Detection
comments: 14 pages, 8 tables, 6 figures. Expanded version of IET ICETA 2025 conference paper
summary: Crack detection plays an important role in infrastructure inspection and Structural Health Monitoring (SHM). However, cracks typically appear as thin, low-contrast structures and are easily affected by background noise, posing challenges for existing object detection models. This study proposes an improved YOLO-based architecture with integrated attention mechanisms, termed YOLO-AMC (YOLO with Attention Mechanisms for Crack Detection), to enhance automated crack detection performance. Based on YOLOv11, the original C2PSA module is removed, and multiple attention mechanisms, including Global Attention Mechanism (GAM), Residual Convolutional Block Attention Module (Res-CBAM), and Shuffle Attention (SA), are introduced into the multi-scale feature fusion layers of the Neck to strengthen cross-scale feature integration. Experimental results demonstrate that YOLO-AMC consistently outperforms baseline models YOLOv11n and YOLOv8n across multiple evaluation metrics. Among the evaluated attention modules, GAM achieves the best detection performance, obtaining mAP@0.5 = 0.9917 and mAP@0.5:0.95 = 0.9506 on the test dataset, which are higher than those of YOLOv11 (0.9833 / 0.9112) and YOLOv8 (0.9707 / 0.8921). Furthermore, while maintaining a computational complexity of 7.6 GFLOPs, the proposed model achieves 110.95 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 platform and approximately 5 FPS on a Raspberry Pi 5 edge device, demonstrating a favorable trade-off between accuracy and deployment efficiency. The implementation code for this study is available on GitHub at https://github.com/CY-Tsai24/YOLO-AMC.
comment: 14 pages, 8 tables, 6 figures. Expanded version of IET ICETA 2025 conference paper

title: ScaleAcross: Designing Multi-Data-Center Infrastructure for Geo-Distributed AI Training
summary: The rapid growth of AI models and increasing data sovereignty requirements are driving the transition toward geo-distributed AI training across multiple data centers. Such deployments introduce system-level challenges arising from synchronization-intensive communication, cross-site data exchange, and wide-area latency constraints. This paper investigates EVPN--VXLAN as an infrastructure foundation for geo-distributed AI training environments and presents a scalable emulation framework for systematically studying distributed AI workloads under realistic wide-area conditions. The proposed framework combines VXLAN overlays with EVPN-based inter-data-center connectivity and is implemented using ContainerLab and FRRouting (FRR). The framework further incorporates Equal-Cost Multi-Path (ECMP) routing, Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD), and a queue-pair-aware traffic distribution mechanism designed to improve communication behavior for synchronization-intensive AI workloads while preserving compatibility with commodity infrastructure. Using realistic WAN emulation, we characterize communication and system behavior under distributed training workloads employing AllReduce and Parameter Server communication patterns. Results provide insights into traffic distribution, resilience, and infrastructure behavior in geo-distributed AI environments, highlighting the potential of reproducible multi-data-center infrastructure frameworks for scalable distributed AI training.

title: EmbodiSteer: Steering Embodiment-Agnostic Visuomotor Policies with Joint-Space Guidance for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Deployment
comments: The first two authors contribute equally
summary: Scalable robot imitation learning relies on large-scale heterogeneous data from diverse robots or body-free data, making Cartesian end-effector actions a key interface for embodiment-agnostic policy learning. However, end-effector-only abstraction leaves Cartesian policies unaware of the deployed robot body, making them brittle under robot-specific constraints such as whole-body collision avoidance. To overcome this limitation, we present EmbodiSteer, a training-free framework that steers embodiment-agnostic visuomotor policies toward zero-shot, embodiment-aware deployment. EmbodiSteer keeps policy learning in Cartesian space while efficiently lifting inference-time diffusion sampling into the target robot's joint space via forward kinematics and Jacobian-based updates. With whole-body collision-aware guidance over joint trajectories after each denoising step, the arm can be steered away from collisions while preserving learned end-effector behavior. Compared with Cartesian-only execution, EmbodiSteer reduces collision rate by 46.1% and improves task success rate by 28.5% across 9 simulated robots, and further achieves 90.0% collision rate reduction and 36.7% success rate increase on two physical robots in highly constrained scenarios. Our project page is at https://frankwang67.github.io/EmbodiSteer-Page.
comment: The first two authors contribute equally

title: Circuit Synchronization Precedes Generalization: Causal Evidence from Fourier Structure in Grokking Transformers
summary: Grokking -- where a transformer on modular arithmetic suddenly transitions from near-chance to near-perfect validation accuracy -- is attributed to a Fourier circuit, but its timing, causal structure, and controllability remain poorly understood. We introduce the Frequency Synchronization Degree (FSD), a normalised, permutation-tested metric for Fourier circuit synchronisation requiring no prior circuit knowledge. Across nine modular addition configurations (primes p in {53, 71, 97, 113, 131}, three seeds), FSD synchronises 500-3,000 steps before grokking (mean lead +1,722 steps; all nine positive, sign-test p~0.004), and precedes a restricted-logit loss baseline (Nanda et al.'s excluded loss) in all nine cases, making it the earliest available predictor. We provide direct causal evidence that the inter-phase gap is a regularisation phenomenon: forking training at the FSD-ceiling step and varying weight decay lambda produces strictly monotone earlier grokking, with Delta_t proportional to 1/lambda. This law replicates across three primes (p in {53,97,131}; R^2=1.00 and R^2=0.99 for two clean cases), captured as Delta_t ~ C/lambda, consistent with (1/lambda)*log(||W_mem||/tau). Architecture ablations show an attention-only model groks with a strong FSD precursor; an MLP-only model never groks; a single-layer model's FSD lags, confirming the precursor is a multi-block circuit property.

title: Multi-Modal Agents for Power Distribution Defect Detection: An Evaluation of Foundation Models
summary: The power distribution network is critical to reliable electricity delivery, yet traditional inspection methods face limitations in semantic understanding, generalization, and closed-loop automation. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Multi-Modal Agent framework specifically for power distribution defect detection. Central to this study is the systematic evaluation of multimodal foundation models as unified cognitive engines. We rigorously assess their integrated performance across three critical capabilities: (1) Perception, where the model must accurately identify equipment and generate expert-level descriptions of defects; (2) Reasoning, where the model interprets visual findings to diagnose causes, assess severity, and plan maintenance strategies based on domain knowledge; and (3) Tool Usage, where the model acts as an autonomous operator to execute actions -- such as querying knowledge bases or generating work orders -- to achieve closed-loop maintenance. To support this evaluation, a domain-specific evaluation dataset and a comprehensive benchmark are developed. Experimental results demonstrate the strengths and limitations of current foundation models in these three dimensions, providing empirical evidence for deploying autonomous agents in high-stakes industrial environments.

title: Binary Search Variants: A Comprehensive Analysis
summary: Binary search is deceptively simple in concept yet notoriously difficult to implement correctly. This paper presents a unified treatment of binary search: five core variants, six derived query functions, and four standard library implementations (BSD, glibc, Java, C++ STL), each with consistent notation, loop invariants, and analysis. We introduce bsearch_ultimate, a combined search that subsumes all variants in a single call. Every algorithm is provided as synchronized Python code, Dafny formal proof, and pseudocode. All implementations are validated by over 9,500 tests and 21 Dafny formal verifications; an additional six deliberately faulty implementations demonstrate common bug categories and Dafny's ability to detect them. We also provide memorable rules linking boundary choices to loop conditions and update formulas.

title: Predicting Cognitive Load from Speech and Interaction Dynamics in Dyadic Conversations
summary: Estimating cognitive load from speech has largely been studied in controlled laboratory settings, with limited understanding of its reliability in natural collaborative conversations. We investigate whether speech and interaction dynamics predict perceived cognitive load during dyadic conversations. We analyze audio from 53 dyads performing nine collaborative tasks and extract static acoustic, dynamic, and interaction features to train a two-head Gated Recurrent Unit encoder to predict cognitive load scores. Results show conversational interaction provides useful signals for predicting cognitive load related to time pressure, mental work, effort, and task performance. Temporal demand is associated with turn-taking dynamics such as overlap and speaker switch, while mental demand is linked to imbalanced participation between speakers. These findings highlight the importance of task structure and conversational interaction for modeling cognitive load in natural collaborative settings.

title: From Prompts to Preferences: An Open-Source Platform for Generative AI-Enhanced Conjoint Analysis
summary: Conjoint analysis is a widely used preference measurement method in marketing research, political science, healthcare, and human-computer interaction. Despite broad adoption, researchers without access to commercial platforms face significant barriers, as existing tools are either expensive or lack end-to-end survey infrastructure. This paper presents an open-source, self-hosted web application for designing, deploying, and analysing conjoint surveys. Beyond conventional tabular stimuli, the platform uses generative AI to produce integrated stimuli formats: textual scenario descriptions generated by a large language model, and visual stimuli by a text-to-image model. A researcher-defined base prompt is parameterised with the conjoint profile, and optional LLM-facing level annotations enrich the generation. A structured setup wizard, AI-assisted attribute suggestion, and live data analysis lower the technical barriers for researchers new to conjoint methodology. A full export bundle including all stimuli, their generating prompts, and response data facilitates transparency and reproducibility. The platform is demonstrated through a proof-of-concept study on care robot preferences for ambient assisted living (AAL, N=55) using AI-generated visual stimuli. The paper discusses the role of AI assistance in conjoint design, arguing that theoretical grounding must remain the researcher's responsibility, and outlining how genAI-generated stimuli can broaden the methodological repertoire for HCI and related fields.

title: A Robust Helmholtz-Decomposition-Based Real Compressed Layer Method for Time-Harmonic Elastic Wave Scattering
summary: Time-harmonic elastic wave scattering involves both compressional (P-) and shear (S-) waves, which propagate with different wavenumbers and polarization characteristics. The naive construction of perfectly matched layer (PML)-type methods based on complex coordinate stretching may lack robustness, or even fail, particularly when the wavenumbers are highly contrasted. The recently developed real compressed layer (RCL) technique build upon real compression transformations and explicit extraction of resulting oscillatory patterns for time-harmonic Helmholtz problems may not work, since the oscillations cannot be explicitly extracted by a single change of variables. This paper intends to bridge this gap by developing a robust RCL method for two-dimensional time-harmonic elastic wave scattering in unbounded domains with compactly supported inhomogeneities. A key observation is that, through the Helmholtz decomposition, the displacement field in the exterior homogeneous region decoupled into P-wave and S-wave and each has a distinctive separation of its oscillatory pattern and decaying behaviours in polar coordinates. We then apply the real compression coordinate transformation in the radial direction to each component. We further propose a coupled displacement-potential RCL formulation that seamlessly integrates the Helmholtz-decomposed wave components with the interior displacement field. We show that, under this framework, the essential oscillations in the layer can be effectively removed. We prove the well-posedness of the resulting coupled problem and establish the exponential convergence of the RCL solution to the original scattering solution in the truncated domain of interest. We discretize the RCL-system using high-order spectral element method and demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method through ample numerical results.

title: A Mathematical Forum Platform for Collaborative Problem Solving and Dataset Generation for AI Reasoning
summary: Sharing mathematical content in online forums remains a significant friction point for students and educators: writing raw LATEX is error-prone, standalone optical character recognition tools require platform switching, and current forum software offers no integrated path from a photograph of a formula to a rendered post. We present a unified system that eliminates this friction by embedding an image to LATEX conversion pipeline directly inside a forum posting interface. A user uploads or captures an image of a mathematical expression; the system routes it through the Mathpix OCR API, detects whether the returned output is LATEX or plain text containing inline math, applies the appropriate delimiter normalisation, and renders a live preview in either LATEX or Markdown mode before the post is committed to the database. The architecture is organized in three loosely coupled layers: image processing, rendering, and storage, and supports both desktop and mobile clients. A provisional US patent application has been filed covering the core methods. We describe the full system design, each component in detail, the data schema, and the key technical innovations, and we position the work against existing standalone tools and forum platforms to demonstrate the practical gap it closes. Beyond immediate usability, we argue that a deployed platform of this kind constitutes a continuously growing, community-validated dataset of mathematical problems and step-by-step solutions, a resource that can be used to train and benchmark AI systems for accurate mathematical reasoning

title: Efficient, Robust, and Anti-Collusion Fingerprinting of Image Diffusion Models
summary: Model fingerprinting, embedding user-specific identifiers (fingerprints) into generated outputs, has recently emerged as a popular solution to protect the intellectual property rights (IPR) of generative text-to-image (T2I) models and prevent unauthorized redistribution. In this work, we reveal a previously unexplored systematic vulnerability in existing generative model fingerprinting methods: they lack robustness against collusion attacks, where multiple attackers combine their models to remove or obscure the fingerprints. To address this issue, we take the first step towards a robust fingerprinting method for T2I models with anti-collusion capabilities. The proposed method encodes strings of bits, namely fingerprints, into the coefficients of a personalized normalization module (PNM) incorporated into T2I models, so that fingerprints can be reliably recovered from any generated image. To defend against collusion attacks and prevent unauthorized model redistribution, we introduce an anti-collusion mechanism based on lossless function-invariant parameter transformations. This mechanism significantly degrades the image generation quality of colluded models, making them effectively unusable. Moreover, our method allows developers to efficiently create multiple copies of fingerprinted T2I models by reparameterizing the PNM without the need for retraining. We also introduce a worst-case optimization strategy to improve robustness against model-level attacks. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves high fidelity and robustness across multiple T2I image generation and editing tasks, with fingerprint extraction accuracy exceeding 99.5%. Compared with existing methods, our method demonstrates, for the first time, a notable proactive robustness to collusion attacks by significantly increasing the FID of colluded models.

title: Trajectory-Level Redirection Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies bring natural language into closed-loop robot control, enabling robots to execute manipulation tasks directly from text instructions. The same interface gives text a recurring role in control because the prompt is reused at every replanning step, and each prompt-conditioned action changes the future observations on which the policy acts. Existing VLA attacks study adversarial prompts that elicit targeted low-level actions or make such actions persist across changing images. We identify a stronger trajectory-level failure mode: a prompt that still $\textit{appears}$ to specify the intended task but redirects the final physical outcome. We mathematically formalize this setting as $\textit{command-preserving trajectory redirection}$, a prompt-only threat model in which the attacker chooses one prompt before the episode, all policy and environment components remain fixed, and the prompt must stay close to the benign instruction while omitting target words and correction language. To find such prompts, we introduce an on-policy prompt search method that uses rollouts to discover perturbations whose closed-loop behavior tracks a target task while satisfying the command-preserving constraints. Experiments in simulation and on hardware show that near-benign prompt perturbations can redirect VLA rollouts to attacker-specified targets. These results expose a trajectory-level vulnerability in VLA instruction grounding: text that appears to preserve the intended command can still give an adversary control over the robot's final physical outcome. Project website: https://vla-redirection-attack.github.io/

title: EPM-JEPA: Operator-Side Experience Modulation in JEPA-Family World Models
comments: 16 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables, 5 code listings. Pre-registered experimental study with mechanism analysis
summary: JEPA-family world models use a static predictor whose weights do not adapt when test-time dynamics diverge from training. We compare two mechanisms for incorporating accumulated experience into a JEPA predictor under distribution shift: operand-side injection, where a compressed experience representation is added as a residual to the predictor's hidden state (EI-JEPA), and operator-side modulation, where the same representation generates low-rank weight deltas via LoRA applied to the predictor's weights (EPM-JEPA). On a pre-registered comparison (Moving MNIST, gravity shift), EPM-JEPA (D_shift^{n=50} = 0.7848 +/- 0.0078, three seeds) differs from EI-JEPA (0.8238) by delta = 4.74% - Outcome C: a null result - by our stated criterion, a valid outcome. As a secondary, non-pre-registered observation, EPM-JEPA improves 1.90% over a no-memory baseline (0.8000), consistently across seeds, while EI-JEPA underperforms the baseline, indicating the benefit is specific to weight-level modulation. Our primary contribution is a mechanism analysis: the D_shift^{n=50} trajectory reflects three independent dynamical processes - buffer cycling, EMA target drift, and an intrinsic LoRA settling transient of +0.021 - rather than convergence to equilibrium. These findings motivate PEM-JEPA, a physics-grounded successor addressing this dynamical-peak limitation.
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables, 5 code listings. Pre-registered experimental study with mechanism analysis

title: Camera and LiDAR BEV Fusion for Cooperative 3D Object Detection on TUMTraf V2X
summary: We describe a Camera and LiDAR fusion detector developed for the TUMTraf V2X cooperative 3D object detection track of the DriveX 2026 challenge. The detector fuses three roadside cameras with a fused infrastructure-plus-vehicle point cloud in a shared bird's-eye-view space and predicts boxes through a CenterPoint-style head with a generalized IoU regression loss and an IoU quality re-ranking head. Trained on the provided train and validation splits, the model reaches a 3D mAP of 0.85 on the public Codabench test split. While iterating on the system, we observed that 44 of the 50 test frames are also present in the released train (40) and validation (4) splits with their labels. We therefore conducted two additional studies to quantify how this overlap affects the final score: (1) a finetuning run that oversamples the 44 overlapping frames, reaching 0.89 mAP, and (2) a post-processing run that replaces predictions on those frames with the released ground truth, reaching 0.99 mAP (uploaded to our Codabench account for testing but not published on the leaderboard). All three configurations and their per-class results are reported.

title: Structured Testbench Generation for LLM-Driven HDL Design and Verification-Oriented Data Curation
summary: Automated testbench generation has become a critical bottleneck in large language model (LLM)-driven Register Transfer Level (RTL) workflows, where large numbers of candidate designs must be verified rapidly and reliably. Existing prompt-based approaches treat testbench generation as unconstrained code synthesis, yielding stochastic outputs with high token cost, low reproducibility, and insufficient coverage. To address this gap, we present STG, a Structured Testbench Generation framework that exploits the inherent structure of hardware designs to generate deterministic testbenches. As a direct verification tool, STG runs 720x faster than an iterative LLM-based testbench generation flow and higher rate of successful compilation, achieves higher coverage, and reduces false-pass verdicts on incorrect DUTs. STG also helps identify errors in RTL generation benchmarks by exposing faulty benchmark testbenches. As a data curation engine, it is 11x faster than LLM-based filtering on a single CPU core with 127x less energy, and the resulting distilled models provide state-of-the-art performance in our multi-benchmark evaluation. As a test-time scaling oracle, it reduces node count by 14-47\%. Our models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/AS-SiliconMind/siliconmind-v12.

title: SkillChain: Closing the Loop on Skill Evolution for Image-Based E-Commerce AI Assistants
summary: Image-based AI assistants are now deployed at production scale on e-commerce platforms, where a single uploaded image can trigger fundamentally different user intents: product search, style recommendation, visual encyclopedia, or utility tool calls, each demanding its own response format, tool invocation, and domain knowledge. Without per-intent behavioral constraints, LLM-based systems conflate these heterogeneous modes and fall short of domain quality standards, while the breadth and dynamism of the intent space render manual engineering infeasible. To address this, we present SkillChain, which closes the production feedback loop on Skill evolution, automating the lifecycle of Skills through three stages: Skill Creator for bootstrapping from task specs and trajectories, Route Optimizer for routing alignment, and Body Refiner for iterative Skill Body refinement via dual-path LLM-Judge evaluation.
